models.title: AlexNet
models.family_label: CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积
models.core_mech: 以 GPU、ReLU、dropout 和深卷积组合首次规模化训练 ImageNet 级深 CNN。
models.core_mech_en: First large-scale ImageNet-grade deep CNN trained end-to-end by combining dual-GPU parallelism, non-saturating ReLU activations, dropout regularization, and stacked convolutions.
models.input_desc: 224×224 RGB 图像
models.input_en: 224×224 RGB image
models.output_desc: 类别概率或倒数第二层视觉特征
models.output_en: Closed-set class probabilities or penultimate 4096-D visual feature vector

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 手工特征占主导，深 CNN 计算昂贵且易饱和或过拟合
attrs.核心想法: GPU 训练的深层卷积分类器，以 ReLU、dropout 和增强扩大可训练规模
attrs.关键改进: 5 个卷积层加 3 个全连接层，结合 GPU、ReLU、dropout 与数据增强
attrs.医学适配: 推动通用 CNN/ImageNet 表示迁移，后续被医学 2D 任务广泛采用
attrs.适用范围与证据: 历史里程碑；不再是医学强基线

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Hand-crafted features dominated vision; deep CNNs were computationally prohibitive and prone to saturating gradients or severe overfitting.
attrs_en.核心想法: End-to-end GPU-trained deep convolutional classifier scaling capacity via ReLU, dropout, and aggressive data augmentation.
attrs_en.关键改进: 5 convolutional layers + 3 fully connected layers integrating multi-GPU execution, ReLU non-linearity, dropout, and crop/color augmentations.
attrs_en.医学适配: Catalyzed transfer of generic ImageNet CNN representations across 2D medical imaging classification and detection.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Historical milestone; superseded as a competitive medical backbone.

models.paper_title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks

models.title: ResNet
models.family_label: CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积
models.core_mech: 显式 identity shortcut 与残差相加 y=x+F(x)。
models.core_mech_en: Explicit identity shortcut connections combined with additive residual learning y = x + F(x).
models.input_desc: 2D 图像或 3D 体数据特征
models.input_en: 2D image or 3D volumetric feature tensor
models.output_desc: 分类 logits、金字塔特征或下游编码表示
models.output_en: Classification logits, multi-scale feature pyramid, or downstream encoded representations

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 网络加深后出现优化退化，训练误差反而上升
attrs.核心想法: 用恒等捷径学习残差映射 y=x+F(x)
attrs.关键改进: identity shortcut 与必要时的 projection shortcut 使百层网络可优化
attrs.医学适配: 3D ResNet、Residual U-Net 与 nnU-Net ResEnc 的核心结构
attrs.适用范围与证据: 仍是必须精通的强主干和公平对照

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Deepening plain networks triggered optimization degradation where training error paradoxically increased with depth.
attrs_en.核心想法: Reformulate layers to learn residual perturbations y = x + F(x) relative to an identity reference.
attrs_en.关键改进: Parameter-free identity shortcuts and 1×1 projection shortcuts enable stable optimization beyond 100+ layers.
attrs_en.医学适配: Foundational building block for 3D ResNet, Residual U-Net, and nnU-Net ResEnc across medical modalities.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Mandatory foundational backbone and fair baseline across 2D and 3D biomedical tasks.

models.paper_title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

models.title: DenseNet
models.family_label: CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积
models.core_mech: 每层对所有前层输出做通道 concat，而非仅连接相邻层或做残差相加。
models.core_mech_en: Every layer concatenates feature maps from all preceding layers along the channel axis rather than summing adjacent residuals.
models.input_desc: 图像或前一 transition 的特征图
models.input_en: Input image or feature maps from the preceding transition block
models.output_desc: 复用全部前层表示的分类或编码特征
models.output_en: Classification logits or multi-scale concatenated dense features reusing all earlier layers

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 深层网络中特征传播与梯度传递受阻，并会重复学习相似表示
attrs.核心想法: 每层接收全部前层特征的拼接并以 growth rate 控制宽度
attrs.关键改进: 密集短路径带来显式特征复用和较少参数
attrs.医学适配: DenseNet-121 成为胸片经典主干，H-DenseUNet 用于肝肿瘤分割
attrs.适用范围与证据: 结构思想仍有价值，但 activation memory 较大

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Deep networks suffered from attenuated feature propagation and redundant re-learning of low-level representations.
attrs_en.核心想法: Feed each layer the channel-wise concatenation of all prior layers within a block while bounding width via a fixed growth rate k.
attrs_en.关键改进: Dense short paths enforce explicit multi-scale feature reuse with high parameter efficiency.
attrs_en.医学适配: DenseNet-121 became a canonical chest X-ray backbone (CheXNet); H-DenseUNet extended dense connectivity to 3D liver tumor segmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Enduring architectural principle, though channel concatenation incurs high GPU activation memory in 3D.

models.paper_title: Densely Connected Convolutional Networks

models.title: ConvNeXt
models.family_label: CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积
models.core_mech: 7×7 depthwise spatial mixer 加 inverted bottleneck 的现代纯卷积块。
models.core_mech_en: Modernized pure ConvNet block pairing a 7×7 depthwise spatial mixer with an inverted channel bottleneck.
models.input_desc: 2D 图像
models.input_en: 2D image tensor
models.output_desc: 四级层级特征或分类 logits
models.output_en: Four-stage hierarchical feature pyramid or classification logits

attrs.上一代瓶颈: Transformer 与 CNN 的比较混入了训练配方和层级设计差异
attrs.核心想法: 以现代训练配方和大核 depthwise 卷积重构纯卷积层级主干
attrs.关键改进: 7×7 depthwise conv、inverted bottleneck、LayerNorm/GELU 与 patchify stem
attrs.医学适配: 直接启发 3D MedNeXt，并作为医学 Transformer/SSM 的强 CNN 对照
attrs.适用范围与证据: 现代强 CNN 主干，适合公平架构比较

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Comparisons between Vision Transformers and CNNs conflated self-attention with modern training recipes and macro-architecture design.
attrs_en.核心想法: Modernize a pure hierarchical ConvNet using Transformer-era training recipes and large-kernel depthwise convolutions.
attrs_en.关键改进: 7×7 depthwise conv, inverted bottleneck (1×1 expansion), LayerNorm, GELU, and a 4×4 patchify stem.
attrs_en.医学适配: Directly inspired 3D MedNeXt and serves as a rigorous modern CNN control against medical Transformers and SSMs.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: State-of-the-art pure CNN backbone ideal for controlled architectural ablations.

models.paper_title: A ConvNet for the 2020s

models.title: VGG-16/19
models.family_label: CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积
models.core_mech: 以高度同质的 3×3 plain-convolution blocks 规律加深到 16/19 层，无残差连接。
models.core_mech_en: Homogeneous stacking of 3×3 plain convolutional blocks systematically deepened to 16–19 layers without residual shortcuts.
models.input_desc: 固定尺寸 RGB/医学 2D 图像
models.input_en: Fixed-size RGB or 2D grayscale medical image
models.output_desc: 分类 logits 或供下游使用的多层卷积特征
models.output_en: Classification logits or multi-stage intermediate convolutional feature maps

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 早期 CNN 使用较大卷积核且结构异质，深度扩展规律不清
attrs.核心想法: 用连续 3×3 卷积和周期性池化把网络规律地加深到 16/19 层
attrs.关键改进: 以小卷积堆叠扩大有效感受野并形成可迁移的层级特征
attrs.医学适配: 长期作为医学影像迁移学习、感知损失和编码器基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 历史主干与表征参照；参数量大、缺残差连接，现已少作首选

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Early CNNs relied on heterogeneous large kernels (11×11, 7×7) with unclear scaling rules for network depth.
attrs_en.核心想法: Replace large kernels with homogeneous stacks of 3×3 convolutions interleaved with 2×2 max-pooling up to 16–19 weight layers.
attrs_en.关键改进: Stacked 3×3 filters capture equivalent large receptive fields with fewer parameters and deeper non-linearities.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely used for early medical transfer learning, perceptual feature losses, and 2D encoder initialization.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Historical reference and perceptual loss extractor; heavy FC parameters and lack of residual paths limit modern primary use.

models.paper_title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition

models.title: GoogLeNet / Inception-v1
models.family_label: CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积
models.core_mech: 在每个 Inception module 中并行执行 1×1、降维后 3×3/5×5 和 pooling 分支，再通道拼接。
models.core_mech_en: Parallel multi-scale branches (1×1, bottlenecked 3×3, 5×5 convolutions, and pooling) concatenated within each Inception module.
models.input_desc: 2D 图像
models.input_en: 2D image tensor
models.output_desc: 全局分类 logits 与多尺度中间特征
models.output_en: Global classification logits and multi-scale intermediate representations

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 单一路径卷积难同时覆盖多尺度，直接增加宽度计算昂贵
attrs.核心想法: 在同一层并行组合 1×1、3×3、5×5 卷积和池化后拼接
attrs.关键改进: 以 1×1 bottleneck 降维并用 Inception 模块高效聚合多尺度
attrs.医学适配: 启发医学多尺度病灶检测和多分支 2D/3D 编码器
attrs.适用范围与证据: 多尺度设计仍重要；原始模块已被更简洁的残差和层级结构取代

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Single-kernel convolutional layers struggled to capture multi-scale structures simultaneously, while naively widening layers exploded FLOPs.
attrs_en.核心想法: Execute parallel 1×1, 3×3, 5×5 convolutions and pooling within each layer and concatenate their outputs channel-wise.
attrs_en.关键改进: 1×1 bottleneck projections compress channel dimensions prior to expensive spatial kernels for efficient multi-scale aggregation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Inspired multi-branch 2D/3D medical encoders and multi-scale lesion detection networks.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Multi-scale branching remains influential, though complex hand-tuned Inception topologies are largely superseded by residual/ConvNeXt blocks.

models.paper_title: Going Deeper with Convolutions

models.title: ResNeXt
models.family_label: CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积
models.core_mech: 在 residual bottleneck 中以 cardinality 控制的 grouped 3×3 convolution 聚合多个等拓扑变换。
models.core_mech_en: Aggregates multiple homogeneous residual branches via grouped 3×3 convolutions governed by a cardinality hyperparameter.
models.input_desc: 图像或上一 stage 特征
models.input_en: Input image or preceding stage feature map
models.output_desc: 分组聚合残差特征与分类/下游输出
models.output_en: Grouped aggregated residual representations and downstream task predictions

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 仅靠加深或加宽网络的计算收益递减且设计空间复杂
attrs.核心想法: 在残差块中并行聚合等拓扑分支，以 cardinality 控制表示容量
attrs.关键改进: 引入 grouped convolution 实现可扩展的 split-transform-merge
attrs.医学适配: 常用于 2D/3D 医学分类、检测和分割编码器
attrs.适用范围与证据: grouped convolution 已成现代 CNN 基础构件；原始主干不是当前唯一强基线

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Scaling depth or width alone yielded diminishing returns and required intricate per-branch hyperparameter tuning.
attrs_en.核心想法: Aggregate C parallel identical-topology transformations inside a residual bottleneck, introducing cardinality C as a third scaling axis.
attrs_en.关键改进: Formulates split–transform–merge cleanly as grouped convolution with minimal engineering overhead.
attrs_en.医学适配: Frequently adopted in 2D/3D medical classification, nodule detection, and volumetric encoder backbones.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Grouped/depthwise convolution is now a permanent staple of modern CNNs.

models.paper_title: Aggregated Residual Transformations for Deep Neural Networks

models.title: SENet
models.family_label: CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积
models.core_mech: 全局平均池化 squeeze 后经 bottleneck MLP 产生每通道 sigmoid 门，对卷积特征逐通道重标定。
models.core_mech_en: Global average pooling (Squeeze) followed by a lightweight bottleneck MLP (Excitation) producing per-channel sigmoid gates.
models.input_desc: 卷积 block 的多通道特征 X
models.input_en: Multi-channel convolutional feature tensor X
models.output_desc: 输入自适应通道重标定后的特征或任务预测
models.output_en: Input-adaptively channel-recalibrated feature tensor or classification output

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 普通卷积隐式混合通道，缺少输入自适应的通道选择
attrs.核心想法: 全局汇聚通道统计后用小型门控网络重标定各通道响应
attrs.关键改进: 以极低开销显式建模通道依赖并可插入任意主干
attrs.医学适配: 广泛用于器官分割、病灶分类和多模态通道融合
attrs.适用范围与证据: 通道注意力经典模块；解释性有限，空间定位仍需其他机制

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard convolutions fuse channels with fixed learned weights, lacking global content-aware channel selection.
attrs_en.核心想法: Squeeze global spatial statistics per channel and excite a small gating MLP to dynamically recalibrate channel responses.
attrs_en.关键改进: Models inter-channel dependencies explicitly at negligible parameter and compute overhead; plug-and-play across backbones.
attrs_en.医学适配: Ubiquitous across medical organ segmentation, lesion classification, and multi-sequence MRI channel fusion.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Canonical channel-attention module; provides global channel weighting rather than spatial localization.

models.paper_title: Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks

models.title: EfficientNet
models.family_label: CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积
models.core_mech: 以 NAS 设计的 MBConv+SE 基线配合 depth/width/resolution 三维 compound scaling。
models.core_mech_en: NAS-discovered MBConv+SE baseline scaled jointly across depth, width, and input resolution via a compound coefficient φ.
models.input_desc: 2D 图像与缩放系数 phi
models.input_en: 2D image scaled according to compound coefficient φ
models.output_desc: 效率优化的分类 logits 或层级特征
models.output_en: Compute-efficient classification logits or multi-scale feature pyramid

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 任意单独加深、加宽或提高分辨率常造成计算失衡
attrs.核心想法: 用复合系数联合缩放网络深度、宽度和输入分辨率
attrs.关键改进: 以 NAS 获得 B0 基线，并系统研究、经验确定 compound scaling 系数
attrs.医学适配: 后续被用于算力受限的医学分类、超声和移动端筛查
attrs.适用范围与证据: 仍是效率基线；高分辨率 3D 医学任务的内存瓶颈需另行处理

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Scaling network depth, width, or image resolution in isolation rapidly saturates accuracy and wastes FLOPs.
attrs_en.核心想法: Couple depth (α^φ), width (β^φ), and resolution (γ^φ) under a unified compound scaling constraint.
attrs_en.关键改进: Combines MobileInvertedBottleneck (MBConv + SE) with empirically calibrated compound scaling laws.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely deployed in resource-constrained 2D medical classification, point-of-care ultrasound, and dermatology/fundus screening.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Strong 2D efficiency baseline; depthwise separable kernels and high resolution require separate activation-memory audits in 3D.

models.paper_title: EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks

models.title: FCN
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: FC→Conv 的整图 dense prediction，加 pool3/pool4 分数级 skip fusion。
models.core_mech_en: Converts image-level FC layers into 1×1 convolutions for arbitrary-size dense prediction with pool3/pool4 skip score fusion.
models.input_desc: 任意尺寸 2D 图像
models.input_en: Arbitrary-size 2D image
models.output_desc: 与输入对齐的像素级类别 logits
models.output_en: Pixel-aligned semantic class probability map

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 分类网络只能给图级标签，逐 patch 推理低效且边界粗
attrs.核心想法: 将分类 CNN 的全连接层卷积化，端到端输出像素级预测
attrs.关键改进: learned deconvolution，并在 FCN-16s/8s 中逐步加入浅深特征 skip fusion
attrs.医学适配: 是 U-Net 等医学 encoder-decoder 分割网络的直接祖先
attrs.适用范围与证据: 范式基础；具体结构已被更强解码器替代

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Classification CNNs produced only image-level labels; sliding-window patch classification was redundant and boundary-coarse.
attrs_en.核心想法: Transform fully connected layers into convolutions and append transposed-convolution upsampling for end-to-end pixel-wise training.
attrs_en.关键改进: Learned deconvolution combined with multi-scale coarse-to-fine skip score fusion (FCN-32s → FCN-16s → FCN-8s).
attrs_en.医学适配: Direct progenitor of U-Net and all modern medical encoder–decoder segmentation networks.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational dense-prediction paradigm; asymmetric score-only upsampling is superseded by symmetric U-Net decoders.

models.paper_title: Fully Convolutional Networks for Semantic Segmentation

models.title: U-Net
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 对称 U 形多尺度解码器与 encoder–decoder 同尺度 concat long skips。
models.core_mech_en: Symmetric U-shaped multi-scale decoder coupled with same-scale encoder–decoder channel concatenation long skips.
models.input_desc: 2D 生物医学图像
models.input_en: 2D biomedical microscopy or radiological image
models.output_desc: 逐像素前景/多类别分割图
models.output_en: Pixel-accurate foreground or multi-class segmentation map

attrs.上一代瓶颈: FCN 上采样边界粗，生物医学标注稀缺
attrs.核心想法: 对称 encoder-decoder 与同尺度长跳连联合语义和精确定位
attrs.关键改进: concat skips、强弹性增强与面向少样本的 U 形多尺度拓扑
attrs.医学适配: 成为医学分割基础设施，U-shaped encoder-decoder 也被广泛复用于重建和去噪
attrs.适用范围与证据: 领域基础设施；必须从零实现和保留为强基线

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: FCN upsampling lost fine boundary localization, while annotated biomedical datasets were small.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pair a contracting semantic encoder with a symmetric expanding decoder linked by same-scale feature concatenation skips.
attrs_en.关键改进: Concatenation long skips, distance-weighted boundary loss, and elastic deformations tailored for few-shot biomedical segmentation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Universal infrastructure of biomedical segmentation; the U-shaped topology is also standard across denoising, reconstruction, and diffusion.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Cornerstone domain infrastructure; mandatory to master from scratch and retain as a primary baseline.

models.paper_title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation

models.title: 3D U-Net
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 把 U-Net 的卷积、池化、上采样和 long skip 全部扩展为原生 3D，并支持稀疏切片监督。
models.core_mech_en: Extends all U-Net convolutions, pooling, upsampling, and long skips to native 3D tensors with support for sparse slice annotations.
models.input_desc: 3D CT/MRI 子体积或完整体数据
models.input_en: 3D CT/MRI sub-volume or whole volumetric scan
models.output_desc: 稠密 3D 体素分割
models.output_en: Dense 3D voxel-wise segmentation volume

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 逐切片 2D 网络忽略层间上下文和体结构连续性
attrs.核心想法: 把 U-Net 全部算子扩展为 3D，并从稀疏标注切片学习体素级输出
attrs.关键改进: 3D 卷积、3D elastic augmentation 与体素级 dense prediction
attrs.医学适配: 奠定 CT/MRI 体分割母体，支持稀疏体标注
attrs.适用范围与证据: 经典 3D 基线；显存、patch context 与各向异性仍是瓶颈

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Slice-by-slice 2D segmentation ignores inter-slice z-axis continuity and 3D anatomical topology.
attrs_en.核心想法: Generalize U-Net operators to native 3D volumetric tensors and train with weighted loss on sparsely annotated slices.
attrs_en.关键改进: 3D convolutions, 3D batch normalization, smooth 3D elastic augmentations, and dense volumetric inference.
attrs_en.医学适配: Foundational parent of volumetric CT, MRI, and microscopy segmentation pipelines.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Canonical 3D baseline; bounded by GPU activation memory, patch field-of-view, and anisotropic slice spacing.

models.paper_title: 3D U-Net: Learning Dense Volumetric Segmentation from Sparse Annotation

models.title: V-Net
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 3D residual FCN 与直接可微 Dice overlap objective 的结合。
models.core_mech_en: Volumetric 3D residual encoder–decoder trained directly with a differentiable Dice overlap objective.
models.input_desc: 3D 医学体数据
models.input_en: 3D medical imaging volume
models.output_desc: 前景概率体或多类体素分割
models.output_en: Foreground probability volume or multi-class voxel segmentation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 3D 前景极小，交叉熵易被背景主导
attrs.核心想法: 3D residual FCN 直接优化 Dice 型目标
attrs.关键改进: 残差 3D 编解码器与面向重叠度的 Dice loss
attrs.医学适配: 推动 Dice 型目标在医学体分割中的普及
attrs.适用范围与证据: 经典强基线；并非唯一 3D 默认网络

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Small 3D anatomical targets occupy a tiny fraction of voxels, causing standard cross-entropy to collapse toward background.
attrs_en.核心想法: Combine a 3D residual convolutional encoder–decoder with a differentiable soft Dice loss.
attrs_en.关键改进: Strided 3D convolutions replacing pooling, block-wise residual shortcuts, and direct overlap optimization.
attrs_en.医学适配: Popularized Dice-family losses (Dice + CE) as the standard training objective for medical volumetric segmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Classic 3D baseline; Dice loss alone remains insensitive to boundary Hausdorff outliers and topological breaks.

models.paper_title: V-Net: Fully Convolutional Neural Networks for Volumetric Medical Image Segmentation

models.title: nnU-Net
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: dataset fingerprint 驱动的自配置、交叉验证与推理后处理闭环，而不是单一新算子。
models.core_mech_en: Dataset-fingerprint-driven self-configuration, 5-fold cross-validation ensembling, and post-processing loop rather than a new neural block.
models.input_desc: 带影像、标签与 spacing 元数据的新分割数据集
models.input_en: New medical segmentation dataset with raw images, masks, and physical voxel spacing metadata
models.output_desc: 经交叉验证选择和后处理的可复现分割系统
models.output_en: Self-configured, cross-validated, and post-processed end-to-end segmentation system

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 新数据集依赖大量专家手调，论文比较常被 pipeline 差异混淆
attrs.核心想法: 根据数据集 fingerprint 自动配置预处理、网络、采样、训练与推理
attrs.关键改进: 规则与经验结合选择 spacing、patch/batch、2D/3D/cascade、增强和后处理
attrs.医学适配: 在多器官、多模态分割中成为统一、可复现的基础设施
attrs.适用范围与证据: 在适用的数据与任务设置下，是新分割方法应比较的必做基线

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Segmentation performance was dominated by manual per-dataset tuning, confounding architectural comparisons across papers.
attrs_en.核心想法: Automate preprocessing, network topology, patch/batch sizing, sampling, training schedule, and post-processing directly from dataset statistics.
attrs_en.关键改进: Couples rule-based domain heuristics (spacing, anisotropy, modality normalization) with empirical cross-validation model selection.
attrs_en.医学适配: Serves as the undisputed reproducible infrastructure across multi-organ and multi-modality medical segmentation benchmarks.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Mandatory first-line baseline against which any newly proposed segmentation architecture must be benchmarked.

models.paper_title: nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation

models.title: UNETR
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 多深度 ViT token skips 连接到卷积 U 形解码器的 3D hybrid。
models.core_mech_en: 3D hybrid segmentation architecture connecting multi-depth Vision Transformer token representations to a convolutional U-shaped decoder.
models.input_desc: 3D 医学体数据
models.input_en: 3D medical imaging volume
models.output_desc: 高分辨率 3D 语义分割
models.output_en: High-resolution 3D volumetric semantic segmentation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 纯卷积的显式全局关系有限
attrs.核心想法: 以 3D patch token 的 ViT encoder 接 U 形 CNN decoder
attrs.关键改进: 从不同 Transformer 深度向 decoder 建立多尺度 skip
attrs.医学适配: 把全局 Transformer encoder 系统引入 3D 医学分割
attrs.适用范围与证据: 重要范式节点；从头训练和二次注意力成本明显

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure 3D CNN encoders have restricted explicit global receptive fields across large volumetric scans.
attrs_en.核心想法: Tokenize 3D volumes into non-overlapping 3D patches processed by a ViT encoder, projecting intermediate layers into a 3D CNN decoder.
attrs_en.关键改进: Multi-depth reshape-and-deconvolution skip pathways bridging sequence-level ViT tokens back to spatial voxel grids.
attrs_en.医学适配: Pioneered global Transformer encoders for 3D multi-organ CT/MRI segmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Important hybrid milestone, though flat 3D patch attention incurs high quadratic compute and data hunger from scratch.

models.paper_title: UNETR: Transformers for 3D Medical Image Segmentation

models.title: Swin UNETR (SSL)
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 3D shifted-window hierarchy 与旋转、重建、对比联合自监督的 Swin UNETR。
models.core_mech_en: 3D shifted-window hierarchical Swin encoder coupled to a U-shaped CNN decoder and pretrained with multi-task 3D self-supervision.
models.input_desc: 未标注 3D CT 子体积；微调时输入带标签体数据
models.input_en: Unlabeled 3D CT sub-volumes for pretraining; labeled 3D volumes for fine-tuning
models.output_desc: 预训练层级编码器及下游 3D 分割
models.output_en: Pretrained hierarchical 3D Swin encoder and dense downstream volumetric segmentation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 平坦 UNETR token 序列昂贵且缺自然多尺度，3D 标注有限
attrs.核心想法: 层级 shifted-window Transformer 与 U 形解码器结合，并在 5050 个 CT 上自监督预训练
attrs.关键改进: 窗口注意力、跨窗 shift、层级特征和多任务 3D 预训练
attrs.医学适配: 成为 MONAI 中重要的 3D Transformer 分割与预训练基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 预训练时有价值；同配方从头训练未必优于现代 CNN

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Flat UNETR tokens lack multi-scale spatial pyramids and scale poorly to high-resolution 3D volumes under limited labels.
attrs_en.核心想法: Replace flat ViT with a 3D shifted-window Swin pyramid and pretrain on 5,050 unlabeled volumetric CT scans.
attrs_en.关键改进: 3D W-MSA / SW-MSA window hierarchy, patch merging, and tri-objective 3D SSL (inpainting + rotation + contrastive).
attrs_en.医学适配: Standard 3D Transformer segmentation and pretraining baseline within the MONAI ecosystem.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Valuable when leveraging pretrained weights; from-scratch training under matched recipes does not consistently beat modern 3D CNNs.

models.paper_title: Self-Supervised Pre-Training of Swin Transformers for 3D Medical Image Analysis

models.title: MedNeXt
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 贯穿 encoder、decoder 和上下采样的全 3D 大核 depthwise ConvNeXt block。
models.core_mech_en: Fully 3D large-kernel depthwise ConvNeXt blocks deployed uniformly across encoder, bottleneck, decoder, and residual up/downsampling.
models.input_desc: 3D 医学影像 patch
models.input_en: 3D medical imaging patch
models.output_desc: 多尺度深监督的 3D 分割 logits
models.output_en: Multi-scale deep-supervised 3D segmentation logits

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 传统 3D U-Net block 陈旧，Transformer 数据饥渴且代价高
attrs.核心想法: 把 ConvNeXt 大核 depthwise 设计系统扩展为全 3D encoder-decoder
attrs.关键改进: 残差上下采样、inverted bottleneck 与 depth/width/kernel compound scaling
attrs.医学适配: 在统一医学分割复测中形成现代强纯卷积基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 高价值对照；大核版本训练较慢

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Legacy 3D U-Net 3×3×3 blocks had limited receptive fields, while 3D Transformers were memory-heavy and data-hungry.
attrs_en.核心想法: Generalize ConvNeXt's large-kernel depthwise inverted bottleneck into a fully 3D encoder–decoder with iterative kernel up-kernelling.
attrs_en.关键改进: Residual inverted-bottleneck resampling layers and compound scaling across depth, width, and 3D kernel size (3³ → 5³ → 7³).
attrs_en.医学适配: Establishes a top-performing pure 3D ConvNet baseline across large-scale unified medical segmentation benchmarks.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Essential modern 3D CNN baseline; large 7×7×7 kernels increase training wall-clock time.

models.paper_title: MedNeXt: Transformer-driven Scaling of ConvNets for Medical Image Segmentation

models.title: Models Genesis
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 多种 3D 变形与遮挡的统一恢复式自监督，而非从 2D ImageNet 迁移。
models.core_mech_en: Unified restorative 3D self-supervised learning from non-linear intensity, local pixel shuffling, and in-/out-painting perturbations.
models.input_desc: 未标注 3D CT 子体积
models.input_en: Unlabeled 3D CT/MRI sub-volumes
models.output_desc: 可迁移的 3D encoder 表示
models.output_en: Transferable 3D encoder-decoder representations for segmentation and classification

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 2D ImageNet 迁移无法充分覆盖 3D 医学体数据
attrs.核心想法: 通过恢复受变换的 3D CT 子体积学习通用解剖表示
attrs.关键改进: 多种恢复式自监督任务与跨多个 3D 下游任务验证
attrs.医学适配: 奠定医学 3D 自监督预训练路线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 奠基价值明确；当前与 MAE、自蒸馏等目标并存或被后者补充

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: 2D ImageNet weights fail to capture native 3D volumetric context, while 3D medical annotations are scarce.
attrs_en.核心想法: Train a 3D encoder–decoder to restore native volumes corrupted by non-linear intensity transformations, local shuffling, and masking.
attrs_en.关键改进: Combines four complementary appearance and spatial corruption tasks into a single restorative pretraining objective.
attrs_en.医学适配: Established the foundational paradigm for native 3D self-supervised pretraining in volumetric radiology.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational 3D SSL milestone; now complemented by masked autoencoding (MAE) and self-distillation.

models.paper_title: Models Genesis: Generic Autodidactic Models for 3D Medical Image Analysis

models.title: VISTA3D
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 127 类自动分支、3D 点提示分支和 supervoxel 蒸馏共存的统一 3D segmentation FM。
models.core_mech_en: Unified 3D CT segmentation foundation model integrating a 127-class automated branch, a 3D point-prompt branch, and 2D supervoxel distillation.
models.input_desc: 3D CT 与可选点提示/目标类别
models.input_en: 3D CT volume with optional 3D click coordinates or target anatomical class IDs
models.output_desc: 已知类别自动 mask 或提示条件下的 3D mask
models.output_en: Automated 127-class 3D segmentation masks or interactive point-prompted 3D masks (including zero-shot novel structures)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 自动模型难交互修正，2D SAM 对复杂 3D 解剖和标注流程不匹配
attrs.核心想法: 单一 3D 模型统一自动分割、点提示交互和提示条件下的新结构 zero-shot
attrs.关键改进: 127 类自动分割、3D prompt 接口与 supervoxel 蒸馏的 2D foundation 特征
attrs.医学适配: 面向 CT 的可复用 3D 标注与交互式修正接口
attrs.适用范围与证据: 代表 3D promptable segmentation 的实质进展，仍需前瞻跨机构验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Closed-set 3D models cannot interactively refine errors, whereas slice-wise 2D SAM loses 3D volumetric coherence.
attrs_en.核心想法: Unify automated multi-organ 3D segmentation, interactive 3D point prompting, and novel-structure zero-shot transfer in one 3D backbone.
attrs_en.关键改进: Dual class/point prompt decoder coupled with 3D supervoxel feature distillation from 2D foundation models.
attrs_en.医学适配: Provides a versatile 3D CT annotation acceleration and interactive correction interface.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Substantial step forward in 3D promptable segmentation; prospective multi-center workflow validation remains ongoing.

models.paper_title: VISTA3D: A Unified Segmentation Foundation Model for 3D Medical Imaging

models.title: Mask2Former
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 上一层预测 mask 反向约束下一层 query cross-attention 的迭代集合分割。
models.core_mech_en: Iterative set-prediction segmentation where predicted foreground masks from layer l-1 constrain query cross-attention in layer l.
models.input_desc: 二维图像
models.input_en: 2D image
models.output_desc: 一组带类别的二值 mask，可统一实例、语义与全景分割
models.output_en: Set of class-labeled binary masks unifying semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 语义、实例和全景分割依赖各自专用结构，全图 cross-attention 昂贵
attrs.核心想法: 把分割统一为一组 mask queries 的分类与掩膜预测
attrs.关键改进: masked cross-attention 只关注当前预测区域，配合多尺度 pixel decoder
attrs.医学适配: 启发医学多实例细胞、病灶和开放词汇 mask 接口
attrs.适用范围与证据: 任务接口影响持久；3D、小目标和 matching 稳定性仍是门槛

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation relied on fragmented task heads, while global cross-attention converged slowly.
attrs_en.核心想法: Formulate all segmentation tasks as mask-classification set prediction using learnable object queries and masked cross-attention.
attrs_en.关键改进: Multi-scale high-resolution pixel decoder + masked cross-attention attending strictly within each query's predicted foreground region.
attrs_en.医学适配: Inspires unified multi-instance nuclei, lesion, and open-vocabulary query segmentation in pathology and radiology.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Influential universal task interface; 3D memory scaling, tiny lesions, and bipartite matching stability remain challenging.

models.paper_title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation

models.title: U-Net++
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 以 X_i,j 嵌套稠密卷积节点重写 U-Net 跳连，并从多个顶层节点施加深监督。
models.core_mech_en: Rewrites U-Net skip pathways as a dense nested grid of intermediate convolutional nodes X_{i,j} with multi-depth deep supervision.
models.input_desc: 2D/3D 医学图像
models.input_en: 2D or 3D medical image
models.output_desc: 深监督融合或选定深度的分割概率图
models.output_en: Deeply supervised ensemble or depth-pruned segmentation probability map

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 原始 U-Net 直接拼接低层与高层特征，语义不匹配且多尺度融合粗糙
attrs.核心想法: 以嵌套稠密跳连和深监督逐步缩小 encoder 与 decoder 特征语义差距
attrs.关键改进: 在跳连路径中引入中间卷积节点并支持可剪枝的多深度输出
attrs.医学适配: 常用于器官、息肉、细胞和小病灶分割
attrs.适用范围与证据: 医学分割经典变体；复杂跳连的增益需与 nnU-Net 等强基线公平比较

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard U-Net directly concatenates raw shallow encoder features with high-level decoder features across a large semantic gap.
attrs_en.核心想法: Bridge the encoder–decoder semantic gap via dense intermediate convolutional skip pathways and multi-scale deep supervision.
attrs_en.关键改进: Nested dense skip nodes X_{i,j} progressively fuse multi-scale features and support inference-time model pruning.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely used in polyp, nuclei, liver, and small-lesion medical segmentation studies.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Classic U-Net skip variant; practical gains must always be verified against a properly configured nnU-Net baseline.

models.paper_title: UNet++: Redesigning Skip Connections to Exploit Multiscale Features in Image Segmentation

models.title: Attention U-Net
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 由粗尺度 decoder gating signal 计算空间 attention coefficients，在拼接前逐位置筛选 encoder skip。
models.core_mech_en: Computes spatial soft-attention coefficients α ∈ [0,1] from coarse decoder gating signals to filter encoder skips prior to concatenation.
models.input_desc: 医学图像
models.input_en: 2D or 3D medical image
models.output_desc: 经空间注意力门筛选 skip features 的分割图
models.output_en: Segmentation map decoded from spatially gated skip connections

attrs.上一代瓶颈: U-Net 跳连把大量背景细节无差别传给 decoder，小器官易被淹没
attrs.核心想法: 用 decoder gating 信号对 skip 特征做空间注意力筛选
attrs.关键改进: 在不额外裁剪 ROI 的情况下突出与目标相关的局部区域
attrs.医学适配: 广泛用于小器官和病灶分割以及级联定位
attrs.适用范围与证据: 注意力门控仍实用；提升通常依赖数据、损失和基线配置

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Unfiltered U-Net skip connections pass cluttered background activations to the decoder, degrading small-organ false-positive rates.
attrs_en.核心想法: Gate high-resolution encoder skip features spatially using contextual gating signals from the coarser decoder stage.
attrs_en.关键改进: Lightweight additive attention gates suppress irrelevant background regions without requiring explicit two-stage ROI localization.
attrs_en.医学适配: Frequently integrated into pancreas, small-lesion, and multi-organ segmentation networks.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Practical and lightweight spatial gating module, though improvements depend heavily on loss and pipeline setup.

models.paper_title: Attention U-Net: Learning Where to Look for the Pancreas

models.title: H-DenseUNet
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 先以 2D DenseUNet 学切片内细节，再将特征堆叠进 3D DenseUNet，并通过 hybrid feature fusion 联合预测。
models.core_mech_en: Extracts intra-slice features via a 2D DenseUNet, stacks them into a 3D DenseUNet, and fuses both via a hybrid feature fusion (HFF) layer.
models.input_desc: 高分辨率腹部 CT 体
models.input_en: High-resolution volumetric abdominal CT scan
models.output_desc: 肝脏/肿瘤 3D 分割概率体
models.output_en: 3D volumetric liver and tumor segmentation probability volume

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 纯 2D 缺跨切片信息，纯 3D 在高分辨率 CT 上显存和数据需求过高
attrs.核心想法: 先以 2D DenseUNet 提取丰富切片内特征，再用 3D DenseUNet 融合体上下文
attrs.关键改进: 混合 2D/3D 稠密连接在计算可控下同时建模纹理与体结构
attrs.医学适配: 是 Dense U-Net 系列在肝脏与肿瘤 3D 分割中的代表
attrs.适用范围与证据: 历史强基线；现代 patch-based 3D 与自动配置框架通常更易复现

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure 2D networks miss z-axis continuity, whereas pure 3D networks cannot fit deep high-resolution encoders in GPU memory.
attrs_en.核心想法: Cascade a deep 2D DenseUNet for high-resolution in-plane representation with a 3D DenseUNet for volumetric context.
attrs_en.关键改进: End-to-end joint Hybrid Feature Fusion (HFF) reconciling 2D transferability with 3D volumetric continuity.
attrs_en.医学适配: Landmark hybrid 2.5D/3D architecture for volumetric CT liver and tumor segmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Historically strong hybrid design; modern patch-based 3D nnU-Net and MedNeXt pipelines offer simpler reproducibility.

models.paper_title: H-DenseUNet: Hybrid Densely Connected UNet for Liver and Tumor Segmentation From CT Volumes

models.title: SegFormer
models.family_label: 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统
models.core_mech: 层级 MiT 编码器结合 overlap patch、K/V 缩减 attention 与含 depthwise Conv 的 Mix-FFN，再接全 MLP 轻量 decoder。
models.core_mech_en: Hierarchical Mix Transformer (MiT) encoder with overlapping patches, sequence-reduced attention, and 3×3 depthwise Mix-FFN paired with an all-MLP decoder.
models.input_desc: 任意常见分辨率的 2D 图像
models.input_en: 2D image of arbitrary test resolution
models.output_desc: 全分辨率语义分割概率图
models.output_en: Full-resolution semantic segmentation probability map

attrs.上一代瓶颈: Transformer 分割器常依赖重型 decoder 与固定位置编码，跨分辨率泛化受限
attrs.核心想法: MiT 层级编码器结合轻量全 MLP decoder 融合多尺度特征
attrs.关键改进: overlap patch embedding、efficient attention 和简洁解码器兼顾精度与效率
attrs.医学适配: 常作为 2D 医学分割、内镜和病理的 Transformer 基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 强通用密集预测基线；3D 体数据仍需专门内存设计

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Early Transformer segmenters relied on heavy decoders and fixed interpolated positional embeddings that degraded across resolutions.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pair a hierarchical multi-scale Transformer encoder (using 3×3 depthwise convolutions for positional cues) with a lightweight all-MLP decoder.
attrs_en.关键改进: Overlapping patch merging, spatial-reduction self-attention, Mix-FFN without fixed positional encodings, and MLP multi-scale fusion.
attrs_en.医学适配: Popular lightweight Transformer baseline for 2D endoscopy, dermatology, ultrasound, and histopathology segmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Strong 2D dense-prediction baseline; extending sequence-reduced attention to 3D still requires careful memory engineering.

models.paper_title: SegFormer: Simple and Efficient Design for Semantic Segmentation with Transformers

models.title: S4
models.family_label: 状态空间与 Mamba：长程传播、扫描偏置和 3D 代价
models.core_mech: 结构化 A 矩阵使线性 SSM 可在长卷积训练与递推推理间等价切换。
models.core_mech_en: Parameterizes state matrix A as Normal Plus Low-Rank (NPLR) so linear SSMs switch exact equivalence between O(N log N) convolutional training and O(1) recurrent inference.
models.input_desc: 长一维序列 x1…xN
models.input_en: Long 1D sequence x_1 … x_N
models.output_desc: 保留长程历史的序列表示 y1…yN
models.output_en: Long-range sequence representation y_1 … y_N preserving distant history

attrs.上一代瓶颈: RNN 难训练，CNN 与 Transformer 难稳定覆盖超长序列
attrs.核心想法: 用结构化状态矩阵把长程递推等价为可高效计算的长卷积
attrs.关键改进: 稳定的结构化 A 与高效 Cauchy/Vandermonde 核计算
attrs.医学适配: 为长 EEG 与波形提供直接机制基础，也启发后续 3D 序列适配
attrs.适用范围与证据: 现代 SSM 的数学基础；并行训练常为近 O(N log N) 的长卷积路径，递推推理可线性扩展

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and sequential training bottlenecks, while Transformers scale quadratically O(N²) on long sequences.
attrs_en.核心想法: Initialize state matrix A with HiPPO orthogonal polynomial projections and decompose it into diagonal plus low-rank form for fast kernel evaluation.
attrs_en.关键改进: Mathematically unifies continuous-time ODEs, O(1)-step autoregressive recurrence, and parallel FFT convolution training.
attrs_en.医学适配: Provides the mathematical foundation for long-horizon EEG, ECG, waveform modeling, and subsequent visual/3D SSMs.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational structured SSM; linear time-invariant (LTI) dynamics lack content-dependent selection until Mamba.

models.paper_title: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

models.title: Mamba
models.family_label: 状态空间与 Mamba：长程传播、扫描偏置和 3D 代价
models.core_mech: 由当前输入生成 Δ、B、C 的 selective SSM，并用硬件感知并行 scan 执行。
models.core_mech_en: Makes SSM discretization step Δ and projections B, C functions of the current input x_k, executed via a hardware-aware parallel associative scan.
models.input_desc: 长度 N 的 token/连续信号序列
models.input_en: Sequence of N tokens or continuous signal samples
models.output_desc: 内容选择后的长程序列表示
models.output_en: Content-selectively filtered long-range sequence representations

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 固定 SSM 不擅长按内容选择保留、遗忘和输出信息
attrs.核心想法: 让状态更新参数随输入变化，并以硬件感知 selective scan 线性处理序列
attrs.关键改进: input-dependent B、C、Delta 与并行 selective scan
attrs.医学适配: 吸引 3D 分割、长生理信号和视频作为低成本全局 mixer
attrs.适用范围与证据: 序列领域重要；医学中尚无普遍替代 CNN/Transformer 的证据

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Linear time-invariant SSMs (S4) use static transition matrices and cannot selectively remember or ignore tokens based on content.
attrs_en.核心想法: Parameterize (Δ_k, B_k, C_k) dynamically from input x_k and compute the resulting time-varying recurrence in SRAM via parallel prefix scan.
attrs_en.关键改进: Input-dependent selective state updates + kernel-fused GPU associative scan achieving O(N) time and memory scaling.
attrs_en.医学适配: Adopted across 3D volumetric segmentation, gigapixel WSI, and long physiological waveforms as a linear-complexity global mixer.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Major sequence modeling milestone; in 2D/3D medical imaging, standalone superiority over tuned CNNs/Transformers is not universal.

models.paper_title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces

models.title: VMamba
models.family_label: 状态空间与 Mamba：长程传播、扫描偏置和 3D 代价
models.core_mech: SS2D 将二维网格沿四个方向 selective scan 后再逆映射融合。
models.core_mech_en: 2D Selective Scan (SS2D) unfolds spatial feature maps along four directional traversal paths, applies selective SSMs, and merges them back.
models.input_desc: 2D 图像
models.input_en: 2D image tensor
models.output_desc: 层级视觉特征或分类 logits
models.output_en: Four-stage hierarchical visual feature maps or classification logits

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 将图像按单条 1D 序列展平会破坏二维拓扑
attrs.核心想法: 以四方向 2D selective scan 和层级 VSS block 建模视觉结构
attrs.关键改进: SS2D cross-scan 与多尺度层级 backbone
attrs.医学适配: 作为医学 2D SSM 的视觉初始化和对照；原生 3D 仍需改造扫描与层级结构
attrs.适用范围与证据: 重要视觉 SSM 基线；未普遍淘汰 ConvNeXt/Swin

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Flattening a 2D image into a single 1D causal raster scan destroys 2D spatial proximity along non-scan directions.
attrs_en.核心想法: Traverse 2D feature grids simultaneously along four complementary corner-to-corner paths before summing the selective scan outputs.
attrs_en.关键改进: SS2D four-way cross-scan module embedded within a hierarchical Visual State-Space (VSS) backbone.
attrs_en.医学适配: Serves as the primary 2D vision SSM backbone and initialization for medical 2D segmentation and classification.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Important visual SSM baseline; native 3D volumetric extension requires tri-axial or multi-directional scan adaptations.

models.paper_title: VMamba: Visual State Space Model

models.title: U-Mamba
models.family_label: 状态空间与 Mamba：长程传播、扫描偏置和 3D 代价
models.core_mech: 在 nnU-Net 风格 residual CNN encoder/bottleneck 中插入 selective SSM，同时保留 CNN long skips。
models.core_mech_en: Embeds flattened 1D selective Mamba blocks inside an nnU-Net-style residual CNN encoder/bottleneck while retaining CNN decoder and long skips.
models.input_desc: 2D/3D 医学影像与 nnU-Net 数据配置
models.input_en: 2D or 3D medical image within the automated nnU-Net pipeline
models.output_desc: 逐像素/体素分割
models.output_en: Dense pixel- or voxel-level segmentation map

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 3D CNN 全局依赖弱，而全局注意力成本高
attrs.核心想法: 在 nnU-Net 风格 CNN 中加入 Mamba 作为 bottleneck 或 encoder 全局建模器
attrs.关键改进: 自配置 U-Net pipeline 加 CNN-SSM hybrid block
attrs.医学适配: 覆盖多类 2D/3D 医学分割任务
attrs.适用范围与证据: 高热度研究基线；后续统一配方消融未发现稳定的 Mamba 独立增益

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure 3D CNNs have local receptive fields, whereas 3D self-attention incurs prohibitive quadratic memory on large patches.
attrs_en.核心想法: Augment residual CNN blocks with flattened Mamba layers inside the self-configuring nnU-Net framework to combine local priors with long-range mixing.
attrs_en.关键改进: Plug-and-play U-Mamba_Bot and U-Mamba_Enc hybrid architectures preserving nnU-Net preprocessing and long skip connections.
attrs_en.医学适配: Evaluated across multi-organ CT, MRI, and endoscopy segmentation benchmarks.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: High-visibility hybrid baseline, though subsequent controlled ablations show matched MedNeXt / nnU-Net ResEnc often perform comparably.

models.paper_title: U-Mamba: Enhancing Long-range Dependency for Biomedical Image Segmentation

models.title: SegMamba
models.family_label: 状态空间与 Mamba：长程传播、扫描偏置和 3D 代价
models.core_mech: GSC + Tri-oriented Mamba 的 TSMamba block，以及 FUE 过滤的多尺度 skip。
models.core_mech_en: Combines Gated Spatial Convolution (GSC) with Tri-oriented Mamba (ToM) scans along axial, coronal, and sagittal axes plus Feature Uncertainty Estimation (FUE) skips.
models.input_desc: 3D 医学体数据
models.input_en: 3D volumetric medical scan (CT / MRI)
models.output_desc: 多尺度融合的 3D 分割
models.output_en: Multi-scale fused 3D volumetric segmentation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 高分辨率全体积 Transformer 的显存成本不可承受
attrs.核心想法: 用多尺度 3D Mamba 处理 whole-volume 长序列依赖
attrs.关键改进: 线性 scan 覆盖中低分辨率 feature grid 上的数十万 token，并保留多尺度解码
attrs.医学适配: 代表同行评议的 medical Mamba 3D 分割路线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 值得复现；仍缺统一配方、多中心和边界/小病灶证据

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: High-resolution whole-volume 3D Transformers exceed GPU memory, while single-direction 3D flattening loses tri-planar anatomy.
attrs_en.核心想法: Apply gated 3D spatial convolutions followed by tri-directional Mamba scans across forward, reverse, and inter-slice axes.
attrs_en.关键改进: TSMamba block (GSC + Tri-oriented Mamba) paired with uncertainty-weighted multi-scale skip refinement.
attrs_en.医学适配: Representative peer-reviewed 3D medical Mamba architecture for brain tumor and colorectal segmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Worth reproducing as a 3D SSM reference; still requires broader multi-center and boundary-level validation.

models.paper_title: SegMamba: Long-range Sequential Modeling Mamba For 3D Medical Image Segmentation

models.title: Transformer
models.family_label: 视觉 Transformer：全局交互、层级窗口与高分辨率代价
models.core_mech: 无递归的多头 self-attention encoder 与 masked self-/cross-attention decoder。
models.core_mech_en: Recurrence-free multi-head self-attention encoder paired with a masked self- and cross-attention decoder.
models.input_desc: 源 token 序列与右移后的目标 token 序列
models.input_en: Source token sequence and right-shifted target token sequence
models.output_desc: 自回归目标 token 概率
models.output_en: Autoregressive target token probabilities or contextualized sequence embeddings

attrs.上一代瓶颈: RNN 串行且长依赖路径长，卷积需堆层获得远程交互
attrs.核心想法: 以 scaled dot-product multi-head self-attention 并行建模 token 间关系
attrs.关键改进: Q/K/V 动态全局交互、位置编码、残差和前馈网络
attrs.医学适配: 是 ViT、医学 VLM、长生理信号模型的共同基础
attrs.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级方法；高分辨 3D 仍受 O(N²) 限制

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Recurrent networks precluded parallel training across time steps and struggled with long-range dependencies.
attrs_en.核心想法: Replace recurrence and convolution entirely with parallel multi-head scaled dot-product attention and position encodings.
attrs_en.关键改进: Content-dependent Q/K/V all-pair affinity matrices, multi-head subspace projection, residual LayerNorm, and position-wise FFN.
attrs_en.医学适配: Foundational operator underlying Vision Transformers, medical VLMs, multimodal EHR fusion, and biosignal foundation models.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Universal deep learning infrastructure; direct application to dense 3D voxels is bottlenecked by O(N²) attention complexity.

models.paper_title: Attention Is All You Need

models.title: Vision Transformer (ViT)
models.family_label: 视觉 Transformer：全局交互、层级窗口与高分辨率代价
models.core_mech: 非重叠 patch 线性 token 化、CLS 汇聚与全局 Transformer encoder，完全移除卷积主干。
models.core_mech_en: Splits images into non-overlapping patches, linearly projects them into tokens with positional embeddings, and processes them via a pure global Transformer encoder.
models.input_desc: 固定分辨率二维图像
models.input_en: Fixed-resolution 2D image (or 3D sub-volume patches)
models.output_desc: CLS 全局表征或类别概率
models.output_en: Global [CLS] representation, patch token grid, or classification logits

attrs.上一代瓶颈: Transformer 缺少二维图像输入接口，视觉模型长期依赖卷积
attrs.核心想法: 把图像切成 patch token 并使用标准 Transformer encoder
attrs.关键改进: patch embedding、位置编码和 class token 形成可扩展视觉编码器
attrs.医学适配: 成为医学 foundation encoder 主流，但 3D 和小病灶需更细致 token 化
attrs.适用范围与证据: 大规模预训练时强；小数据从头训练不一定优于 CNN

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard Transformers could not directly ingest pixel grids due to quadratic cost, leaving computer vision reliant on CNNs.
attrs_en.核心想法: Treat non-overlapping 16×16 image patches as sequence tokens and apply a standard isotropic Transformer encoder.
attrs_en.关键改进: Linear patchify stem, learnable 1D positional embeddings, and global self-attention from the very first layer.
attrs_en.医学适配: Dominant backbone for large-scale self-supervised pathology (UNI, Virchow) and multimodal medical foundation models.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Excels under massive pretraining (MAE, DINOv2, CLIP); underperforms CNNs when trained from scratch on small medical cohorts.

models.paper_title: An Image Is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

models.title: Swin Transformer
models.family_label: 视觉 Transformer：全局交互、层级窗口与高分辨率代价
models.core_mech: W-MSA 与 SW-MSA 交替实现局部高效注意力和跨窗连接，并以 patch merging 形成层次金字塔。
models.core_mech_en: Alternates regular Windowed Multi-Head Self-Attention (W-MSA) with Shifted-Window Attention (SW-MSA) across a patch-merging multi-scale pyramid.
models.input_desc: 二维图像
models.input_en: 2D image (or 3D volume in Video/3D Swin)
models.output_desc: 四级层次化特征金字塔或任务预测
models.output_en: Four-stage multi-scale hierarchical feature pyramid or task predictions

attrs.上一代瓶颈: ViT 单尺度且全局注意力在高分辨率图像上二次增长
attrs.核心想法: 在局部窗口做注意力并通过 shifted windows 和 patch merging 建层级特征
attrs.关键改进: 固定窗口近线性计算、跨窗传播与 CNN 式多尺度金字塔
attrs.医学适配: 广泛用于 2D/3D 医学分割、检测和 Swin UNETR
attrs.适用范围与证据: 层级 Transformer 长期有价值；窗口与 patch 尺度仍是新超参数

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Isotropic ViT maintains a single coarse token resolution and scales quadratically with image area, hindering dense segmentation.
attrs_en.核心想法: Restrict self-attention to local non-overlapping windows for linear scaling, shifting window boundaries between consecutive layers to bridge context.
attrs_en.关键改进: Alternating W-MSA / SW-MSA, relative position bias, and 2×2 patch merging producing a CNN-like multi-scale hierarchy.
attrs_en.医学适配: Core backbone for Swin UNETR, TransMorph, MARS, and high-resolution 2D/3D medical dense prediction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Enduring hierarchical Transformer standard; window size and anisotropic voxel spacing require careful tuning.

models.paper_title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows

models.title: DeiT
models.family_label: 视觉 Transformer：全局交互、层级窗口与高分辨率代价
models.core_mech: 增加 distillation token 和专用 head，使 CNN teacher 信号通过 Transformer attention 注入 ViT。
models.core_mech_en: Augments ViT with a learnable distillation token that interacts with patch tokens via self-attention to distill inductive biases from a CNN teacher.
models.input_desc: ImageNet/医学 2D 图像与训练时 CNN teacher logits
models.input_en: 2D image (plus CNN teacher hard predictions during training)
models.output_desc: class token 与 distillation token 融合的分类预测
models.output_en: Fused class-token and distillation-token classification prediction

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 原始 ViT 依赖超大私有数据，常规数据规模下训练不稳
attrs.核心想法: 用强增强、正则化和蒸馏 token 在 ImageNet 上高效训练 ViT
attrs.关键改进: 把 CNN 教师知识通过 attention distillation 注入 Transformer
attrs.医学适配: 降低医学 ViT 从头训练或小数据微调的门槛
attrs.适用范围与证据: 训练 recipe 影响巨大；医学域仍需领域预训练与严格外部验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Original ViT required hundreds of millions of proprietary images (JFT-300M) and failed to generalize when trained on medium-sized datasets.
attrs_en.核心想法: Combine aggressive data augmentation/regularization with a dedicated distillation token that learns from a convnet teacher.
attrs_en.关键改进: Attention-based token distillation (distinct from logit averaging) + RandAugment, Mixup, CutMix, and Stochastic Depth recipe.
attrs_en.医学适配: Lowered the barrier for training and fine-tuning Vision Transformers on moderate-sized medical imaging cohorts.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Established standard ViT training recipes; in-domain medical SSL pretraining still outperforms purely supervised recipes.

models.paper_title: Training Data-Efficient Image Transformers & Distillation through Attention

models.title: PVT
models.family_label: 视觉 Transformer：全局交互、层级窗口与高分辨率代价
models.core_mech: 以逐级降低 token 分辨率的 Transformer pyramid 和 spatial-reduction attention 提供多尺度 dense-prediction backbone。
models.core_mech_en: Constructs a progressive four-stage token pyramid using Spatial-Reduction Attention (SRA) to compress K/V resolution before attention.
models.input_desc: 高分辨率 2D 图像
models.input_en: High-resolution 2D image
models.output_desc: 四级多尺度 Transformer 特征或分类/密集预测输出
models.output_en: Four-stage multi-scale feature pyramid (1/4 to 1/32 stride) for detection and segmentation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 平坦 ViT 保持固定 token 尺度，密集预测计算高且缺多尺度层级
attrs.核心想法: 逐级降低 token 分辨率并增加通道，形成 Transformer 金字塔
attrs.关键改进: 用 spatial-reduction attention 高效构建可替换 CNN 的层级主干
attrs.医学适配: 适配医学检测、分割和高分辨率病理特征金字塔
attrs.适用范围与证据: 奠定层级视觉 Transformer；后续 Swin、MiT 等结构更常用

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Columnar ViTs output single-scale low-resolution feature maps unsuitable for FPN/U-Net style dense prediction.
attrs_en.核心想法: Progressively shrink patch stride across four stages while spatially downsampling Key and Value tensors inside self-attention.
attrs_en.关键改进: Pyramid token shrinking + Spatial-Reduction Attention (SRA) reducing attention memory and compute on high-resolution grids.
attrs_en.医学适配: Frequently used as a drop-in hierarchical Transformer encoder for polyp, skin lesion, and ultrasound segmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Pioneered pyramid Vision Transformers; often succeeded by Swin or SegFormer (MiT) in recent pipelines.

models.paper_title: Pyramid Vision Transformer: A Versatile Backbone for Dense Prediction without Convolutions

models.title: SimCLR
models.family_label: 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
models.core_mech: 无动量教师或队列，以大 batch 内的两视图实例对和非线性投影头训练 NT-Xent。
models.core_mech_en: Trains an encoder and non-linear MLP projection head via in-batch NT-Xent contrastive loss across dual augmented views without momentum queues.
models.input_desc: 同一图像经两次随机增强得到的视图
models.input_en: Pair of randomly augmented views (x̃_i, x̃_j) of the same image
models.output_desc: 可迁移的图像 encoder 表征
models.output_en: Transferable visual representation h = f(x) (discarding projection head g after pretraining)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 监督预训练依赖人工标签，早期自监督常依赖手工 pretext task
attrs.核心想法: 用两种增强视图和 NT-Xent/InfoNCE 学实例级表示
attrs.关键改进: 强增强、非线性 projection head、大 batch 与长训练
attrs.医学适配: 医学中推动患者级、多视图和体数据对比学习
attrs.适用范围与证据: 对比学习基础；医学增强和正负样本定义必须重设

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Supervised pretraining required costly manual labels, while early heuristic pretext tasks learned brittle representations.
attrs_en.核心想法: Maximize agreement between differently augmented views of the same sample in a projected latent space while repelling all other batch samples.
attrs_en.关键改进: Composition of strong augmentations, learnable non-linear MLP projection head g(·), and temperature-scaled cosine contrastive loss.
attrs_en.医学适配: Sparked patient-aware, multi-view, and slice-proximity contrastive learning across radiology and pathology.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational contrastive SSL paradigm; requires large batch sizes and careful medical augmentation design to avoid false negatives.

models.paper_title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations

models.title: MoCo
models.family_label: 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
models.core_mech: 由 EMA key encoder 维护一致编码、由 FIFO queue 提供大规模跨 batch 负样本的对比字典。
models.core_mech_en: Decouples contrastive negative dictionary size from mini-batch size using a FIFO queue of encoded keys updated via a momentum (EMA) encoder.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的 query 与 key 增强视图
models.input_en: Query view x^q and key view x^k of the same image
models.output_desc: 对比预训练后的 query encoder 表征
models.output_en: Contrastively pretrained query encoder representation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: SimCLR 的负样本规模与 batch size 强绑定
attrs.核心想法: 用 momentum encoder 与 queue 构造大而一致的动态负样本字典
attrs.关键改进: EMA 更新 key encoder，把字典规模从当前 batch 解耦
attrs.医学适配: 适合医学小 batch、患者级采样和算力受限 SSL
attrs.适用范围与证据: 经典实现；其 momentum/EMA teacher 思想被后续方法继承，queue 本身并非统一模板

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: End-to-end contrastive learning (SimCLR) required massive multi-GPU batch sizes to supply sufficient negative samples.
attrs_en.核心想法: Maintain a large dynamic dictionary queue of negative embeddings encoded by a slowly progressing Exponential Moving Average (EMA) key encoder.
attrs_en.关键改进: EMA key parameter update θ_k ← m θ_k + (1−m) θ_q paired with an enqueue/dequeue FIFO memory bank.
attrs_en.医学适配: Well-suited for compute-constrained 2D/3D medical contrastive pretraining where GPU memory restricts batch size.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Classic contrastive mechanism; its EMA teacher principle directly informed BYOL, DINO, and modern SSL.

models.paper_title: Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning

models.title: MAE
models.family_label: 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
models.core_mech: 高比例随机遮蔽后仅编码可见 patch，再用轻量 decoder 重建 mask patch 的非对称自编码器。
models.core_mech_en: Asymmetric autoencoder that masks 75% of image patches, encodes only the 25% visible tokens with a heavy ViT, and reconstructs pixels via a lightweight decoder.
models.input_desc: 随机遮蔽大比例 patch 的图像
models.input_en: Image with a high proportion (e.g., 75%) of randomly masked patches
models.output_desc: 重建的被遮蔽 patch 与预训练视觉 encoder
models.output_en: Reconstructed masked patches during pretraining; high-capacity ViT encoder for downstream fine-tuning

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 对比学习依赖强增强和大 batch，ViT 预训练计算昂贵
attrs.核心想法: 高比例遮挡图像 patch，仅让重型 encoder 处理可见 token，再轻量重建
attrs.关键改进: 约 75% masking 与非对称 encoder-decoder 显著降低计算
attrs.医学适配: 成为 2D、3D MRI/CT 与病理预训练的基础方法
attrs.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级 SSL；像素重建可能偏重低层强度

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Contrastive SSL depended heavily on hand-crafted view augmentations, while full-token ViT pretraining was computationally expensive.
attrs_en.核心想法: Exploit high spatial redundancy in images by dropping 75% of patches before the encoder and reconstructing raw normalized pixels.
attrs_en.关键改进: Asymmetric encoder–decoder design (encoder processes only 25% visible tokens → >3× compute reduction) + high masking ratio.
attrs_en.医学适配: Workhorse self-supervised pretraining method for 3D CT/MRI volumes, gigapixel pathology, retinal OCT, and biosignals.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Core SSL infrastructure; pixel-level MSE emphasizes fine texture and intensity, shining brightest under downstream fine-tuning.

models.paper_title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners

models.title: DINO
models.family_label: 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
models.core_mech: 无负样本的 EMA teacher–student 跨视图概率匹配，以 centering 与 sharpening 防止塌缩。
models.core_mech_en: Negative-free self-distillation where a student ViT matches the centered, temperature-sharpened probability distribution of an EMA teacher across multi-crop views.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的多尺度全局与局部 crops
models.input_en: 2 global views and multiple local lower-resolution crops of an unlabeled image
models.output_desc: 无需标签的 ViT 图像与 patch 表征
models.output_en: Self-distilled ViT global [CLS] and dense patch representations

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 无标签 ViT 缺少稳定的语义学习目标与 collapse 控制，对比方法又依赖负样本
attrs.核心想法: student 预测 EMA teacher 在多 crop 上的锐化、居中分布，无标签无显式负样本
attrs.关键改进: self-distillation、EMA、stop-gradient、centering 与 multi-crop
attrs.医学适配: 其 patch 表示直接启发病理和放射 foundation encoder
attrs.适用范围与证据: DINOv2 的直接祖先；机制与 collapse 控制仍必须理解

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Contrastive ViTs required explicit negative pairs or memory banks, while naive self-distillation collapsed to trivial constant outputs.
attrs_en.核心想法: Train a student network to predict the output distribution of a momentum-updated teacher across global-to-local crops, preventing collapse via centering and sharpening.
attrs_en.关键改进: Multi-crop local-to-global correspondence + EMA teacher centering/sharpening yielding emergent object part segmentation in ViT attention.
attrs_en.医学适配: Directly underpins pathology tile foundation models (UNI, Virchow) and radiology self-supervised ViTs.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Essential precursor to DINOv2; emergent attention maps reflect spatial grouping but should not be over-interpreted as causal proof.

models.paper_title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers

models.title: iBOT
models.family_label: 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
models.core_mech: EMA teacher 同时充当在线视觉 tokenizer，以图像级 DINO 蒸馏和被遮 patch token 蒸馏联合训练。
models.core_mech_en: Uses the EMA teacher simultaneously as an online visual tokenizer to jointly distill masked patch tokens alongside global [CLS] self-distillation.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的多裁剪视图与随机遮蔽 patch
models.input_en: Multi-crop augmented views with random block-wise patch masking applied to the student
models.output_desc: 同时具备全局语义和局部 patch 语义的视觉表征
models.output_en: ViT representations capturing both global image semantics and fine-grained local patch semantics

attrs.上一代瓶颈: BEiT 依赖离线离散 tokenizer，局部与全局目标割裂
attrs.核心想法: 用 EMA teacher 作为在线 tokenizer，同时蒸馏 masked patch 和全局 class token
attrs.关键改进: 联合在线 tokenization、patch-level MIM 与 image-level self-distillation
attrs.医学适配: 成为病理 Phikon、TITAN 等医学 foundation 配方的重要来源
attrs.适用范围与证据: 重要训练思想；常与 DINO 系目标组合使用

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: BEiT required a separately pretrained offline discrete VAE tokenizer, decoupling local token recovery from global semantic learning.
attrs_en.核心想法: Turn the EMA teacher network itself into an online continuous/categorical tokenizer supervising masked student patch tokens.
attrs_en.关键改进: Unifies DINO-style global self-distillation with masked image modeling (MIM) in a single single-stage online teacher–student loop.
attrs_en.医学适配: Core pretraining ingredient in DINOv2, Phikon, UNI, Virchow, and TITAN pathology foundation models.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Highly effective dense + global SSL objective; standardly deployed in tandem with DINOv2 recipes.

models.paper_title: iBOT: Image BERT Pre-Training with Online Tokenizer

models.title: DINOv2
models.family_label: 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
models.core_mech: 以 LVD-142M 数据策展配合 DINO+iBOT+KoLeo 复合自监督，并通过跨尺寸蒸馏形成模型家族。
models.core_mech_en: Combines automated deduplication/retrieval curation (LVD-142M) with a composite DINO + iBOT + KoLeo objective and multi-resolution distillation.
models.input_desc: 经自动去重、检索与平衡构建的大规模无标签图像池
models.input_en: Large-scale deduplicated and rebalanced unlabeled image corpus
models.output_desc: 跨域可迁移的全局与 patch 视觉特征
models.output_en: Out-of-the-box transferable frozen global and dense patch embeddings across model scales

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 早期 SSL 的数据治理与大规模训练配方难扩展、难复现
attrs.核心想法: 在清洗的 LVD-142M 上结合 DINO、iBOT 与 KoLeo 训练可复用视觉特征
attrs.关键改进: 自动数据筛选、复合自蒸馏目标和多尺寸蒸馏
attrs.医学适配: 直接支撑 UNI、Virchow 等病理 foundation encoder
attrs.适用范围与证据: 强通用特征底座；自然图像域不能自动覆盖灰阶、3D 和微小病灶

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Prior self-supervised models degraded on uncurated web noise and often required full end-to-end fine-tuning for dense tasks.
attrs_en.核心想法: Curate a balanced, deduplicated pretraining corpus via embedding retrieval and train a scalable ViT family with composite self-distillation.
attrs_en.关键改进: Automated data curation pipeline + DINO + untied-head iBOT + KoLeo sphere uniformity regularizer + high-resolution short adaptation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Forms the direct algorithmic backbone of modern pathology foundation encoders (UNI, Virchow, Prov-GigaPath) and RAD-DINO.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Gold-standard frozen visual feature extractor; natural-image weights still benefit from in-domain medical adaptation for 3D/grayscale.

models.paper_title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision

models.title: BEiT
models.family_label: 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
models.archetype: 离散视觉词表驱动的掩码图像建模
models.core_mech: BEiT 的辨识点是预测外部 tokenizer 产生的离散视觉码，而非 MAE 式像素重建或普通对比学习。
models.core_mech_en: Pretrains Vision Transformers via BERT-style Masked Image Modeling by predicting discrete visual tokens generated by an external dVAE tokenizer.
models.input_desc: 原始图像，以及对其 patch 随机遮挡后的 token 序列
models.input_en: Raw image (for dVAE tokenizer) + block-wise masked patch sequence (for ViT encoder)
models.output_desc: 被遮挡位置的离散视觉 token 分布；微调时复用 Transformer 图像表示
models.output_en: Categorical distribution over discrete visual codes at masked positions; transferable ViT backbone

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 监督预训练依赖标签，早期图像 SSL 难直接复用 BERT 的 masked objective
attrs.核心想法: 把图像 patch 映射为离散视觉 token，随机遮挡后预测 tokenizer 码
attrs.关键改进: 以离散 VAE token 作为视觉词表实现 masked image modeling
attrs.医学适配: 启发 HeartBEiT 与医学 ViT 的 masked image modeling 预训练
attrs.适用范围与证据: MIM 关键里程碑；tokenizer 偏差和预训练数据覆盖仍决定上限

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Directly regressing raw RGB pixel values in BERT-style masked pretraining wasted model capacity on high-frequency local noise.
attrs_en.核心想法: Quantize image patches into discrete visual tokens via a discrete VAE, then train a ViT to predict the hidden token IDs of masked patches.
attrs_en.关键改进: Decouples continuous pixel array into a continuous patch embedding input view and a discrete semantic token target view.
attrs_en.医学适配: Directly inspired HeartBEiT (12-lead ECG) and LaBraM (neural VQ tokenizer for EEG) biomedical foundation pretraining.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Pioneering MIM milestone; offline tokenizer training is often simplified by MAE pixel regression or iBOT online teachers.

models.paper_title: BEiT: BERT Pre-Training of Image Transformers

models.title: BYOL
models.family_label: 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
models.archetype: 无负样本的在线网络—EMA 目标网络自蒸馏
models.core_mech: 没有负样本队列或聚类码本，核心稳定器是 stop-gradient、EMA 教师和仅在线侧存在的 predictor。
models.core_mech_en: Negative-free self-supervised representation learning stabilized by an asymmetric online predictor MLP, stop-gradient, and an EMA target encoder.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的两种随机增强视图
models.input_en: Two differently augmented views (v, v') of the same image
models.output_desc: 在线 encoder 的增强不变表示
models.output_en: Augmentation-invariant representation from the online encoder f_θ

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 对比学习依赖大批量负样本，假负例可能破坏语义
attrs.核心想法: 在线网络预测目标网络的增强视图表示，目标参数用指数滑动平均更新
attrs.关键改进: 在无显式负样本下，以不对称预测器和 EMA 教师经验上避免坍塌；其机制有多种理论解释
attrs.医学适配: 适合无标签医学图像预训练和跨增强一致性学习
attrs.适用范围与证据: 非对比 SSL 经典方法；增强策略与域内多样性对医学迁移至关重要

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Contrastive methods were sensitive to negative sample batch sizes and false-negative collisions among clinically similar scans.
attrs_en.核心想法: Train an online network (with an extra predictor head) to regress the stop-gradient representation of a momentum-updated target network.
attrs_en.关键改进: Eliminates explicit negative pairs entirely while avoiding representation collapse via architectural asymmetry and EMA dynamics.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely used for unlabeled chest X-ray, fundus, and histopathology pretraining where same-disease negatives are prevalent.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Classic non-contrastive SSL framework; requires careful normalization and domain-valid augmentations.

models.paper_title: Bootstrap Your Own Latent: A New Approach to Self-Supervised Learning

models.title: SwAV
models.family_label: 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建
models.archetype: 在线原型聚类与跨视图 swapped prediction
models.core_mech: 以在线平衡原型分配作为跨视图预测目标，区别于 BYOL 的 EMA 表示回归和 SimCLR 的实例负样本。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces pairwise instance comparisons with online Sinkhorn-Knopp balanced prototype cluster assignment and swapped cross-view prediction.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的两张全局裁剪和若干局部裁剪
models.input_en: 2 global high-resolution views + M small local crops of the same image
models.output_desc: 可迁移图像表示与在线 prototype 分配
models.output_en: Transferable visual backbone and online learnable prototype codebook

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 实例级对比需要大量负样本且把语义相近图像当作负例
attrs.核心想法: 让不同增强视图预测彼此的在线 prototype 聚类分配
attrs.关键改进: 用 balanced online clustering 与 multi-crop 训练学习可扩展表征
attrs.医学适配: 可用于大规模病理 patch 和放射影像无标签预训练
attrs.适用范围与证据: 聚类式 SSL 重要路线；prototype 数量与采样偏差需谨慎控制

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Instance discrimination treated every distinct image as a negative, ignoring shared semantic clusters and scaling poorly.
attrs_en.核心想法: Compute online soft cluster assignments over learnable prototypes using Sinkhorn-Knopp equipartition and predict view A's code from view B.
attrs_en.关键改进: Online balanced clustering + multi-crop augmentation strategy enabling memory-efficient small-batch SSL training.
attrs_en.医学适配: Applied to large-scale unlabeled histopathology patch clustering and radiographic representation learning.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational clustering-based SSL method; multi-crop strategy became standard in DINO and DINOv2.

models.paper_title: Unsupervised Learning of Visual Features by Contrasting Cluster Assignments

models.title: Segment Anything (SAM)
models.family_label: 可提示分割：把固定类别头改造成交互式纠错接口
models.core_mech: 可缓存的重型 image encoder、轻量 prompt encoder 与双向 attention mask decoder 解耦，并以动态 hypernetwork 输出多候选 mask。
models.core_mech_en: Decouples a heavy cacheable ViT image encoder from a lightweight spatial prompt encoder (points/boxes/masks) and an ambiguity-aware two-way attention mask decoder.
models.input_desc: 图像与点、框、粗 mask 或文本映射后的空间提示
models.input_en: 2D image + interactive spatial prompts (foreground/background points, bounding box, or coarse mask)
models.output_desc: 多个候选二值 mask 及其质量分数
models.output_en: Multiple candidate binary segmentation masks with predicted IoU quality scores

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 传统分割绑定固定数据集和标签集，每换目标需重新训练
attrs.核心想法: 可复用 ViT image encoder 加点、框、mask prompt encoder 与轻量 mask decoder
attrs.关键改进: promptable mask proposal、候选 mask/IoU 预测与 SA-1B 数据引擎
attrs.医学适配: 成为医学交互标注和专科适配的重要底座
attrs.适用范围与证据: 标注基础设施；原版对低对比、小结构、血管和 3D 不可靠

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Traditional segmentation networks were locked to fixed training classes and could not interactively segment arbitrary user-specified targets.
attrs_en.核心想法: Amortize heavy image feature extraction once per image, then decode masks in real time (<50 ms) conditioned on flexible spatial prompts.
attrs_en.关键改进: Decoupled ViT-H encoder + positional prompt encoder + 2-layer two-way Transformer decoder + SA-1B 1.1-billion-mask data engine.
attrs_en.医学适配: Transformed interactive medical image annotation, semi-automated contour refinement, and specialist adapter development.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Annotation infrastructure; zero-shot SAM struggles on low-contrast boundaries, thin branching vessels, and unprompted 3D volumes.

models.paper_title: Segment Anything

models.title: MedSAM
models.family_label: 可提示分割：把固定类别头改造成交互式纠错接口
models.core_mech: 在 SAM 提示式架构上以大规模多模态医学分割监督做领域适配，并将 box prompt 作为稳定的目标定位接口。
models.core_mech_en: Adapts the promptable SAM architecture across 1.57 million medical image–mask pairs spanning 10 imaging modalities using bounding-box prompts.
models.input_desc: 标准化二维医学图像与目标边界框
models.input_en: Normalized 2D medical image slice + target anatomical/lesion bounding box prompt
models.output_desc: 边界框条件下的医学目标分割 mask
models.output_en: Box-conditioned binary segmentation mask for the target medical structure

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 原 SAM 跨到医学低对比、多模态图像时 zero-shot 波动大
attrs.核心想法: 在 157 万医学 image-mask pairs 上领域微调 SAM
attrs.关键改进: 覆盖 10 种模态的大规模 box-prompt 训练和内外部任务评估
attrs.医学适配: 用于跨模态交互式医学分割与标注加速
attrs.适用范围与证据: 强领域适配证据；仍依赖 box prompt，非全自动 3D 终点

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Out-of-the-box natural-image SAM exhibited high variance and boundary leakage on low-contrast, multi-modality medical scans.
attrs_en.核心想法: Fine-tune SAM's image encoder and mask decoder on a massive multi-modality medical corpus using bounding boxes as a reliable spatial prompt.
attrs_en.关键改进: Curated 1.57M medical image–mask dataset across 10 modalities + end-to-end domain adaptation with extensive internal/external validation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Standard interactive box-prompted segmentation tool for radiology, oncology, endoscopy, and pathology annotation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Strong domain-adaptation evidence; remains reliant on manual or detector-generated bounding boxes per slice/ROI.

models.paper_title: Segment Anything in Medical Images

models.title: SAM 2
models.family_label: 可提示分割：把固定类别头改造成交互式纠错接口
models.core_mech: 在 SAM 提示式 decoder 外加入 memory attention、mask-conditioned memory encoder 和 object pointer，构成可交互的流式时序闭环。
models.core_mech_en: Extends promptable SAM with a streaming memory bank, memory cross-attention, mask-conditioned memory encoder, and occlusion score head across sequences.
models.input_desc: 图像或视频帧、当前帧提示及历史对象记忆
models.input_en: Video stream or 3D slice stack + spatial prompts (points/box/mask) on one or more reference frames
models.output_desc: 当前帧对象 mask，并更新供后续帧读取的记忆
models.output_en: Temporally/slice-propagated segmentation masks with updated object memory state

attrs.上一代瓶颈: SAM 缺少跨帧时间一致性和纠错记忆
attrs.核心想法: 用 streaming memory 在图像和视频中传播 prompt 与对象状态
attrs.关键改进: memory bank、任意帧交互纠正与大规模 SA-V 数据引擎
attrs.医学适配: 适合内镜、超声视频和 CT/MRI 切片提示传播
attrs.适用范围与证据: 交互工具潜力高；相邻切片不等于真实 3D 几何

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Static 2D SAM required re-prompting every frame or slice independently, lacking temporal or inter-slice memory propagation.
attrs_en.核心想法: Condition current-frame image features on a FIFO memory bank of past prompted frames and predicted object pointers via memory attention.
attrs_en.关键改进: Streaming memory attention + mask-conditioned memory encoder + occlusion prediction head + SA-V video data engine.
attrs_en.医学适配: Enables rapid interactive propagation of prompts across surgical endoscopy videos, echocardiography, and 3D CT/MRI slice stacks.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: High utility for interactive 3D/video annotation; sequential slice tracking does not replace native 3D volumetric topology priors.

models.paper_title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos

models.title: CLIP
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.core_mech: 完全分离的图像/文本双塔，通过批内 N×N 对称对比目标对齐，并用文本 prompt 充当开放词表分类器。
models.core_mech_en: Aligns separate image and text encoders in a shared embedding space via symmetric in-batch N×N contrastive loss, turning text prompts into zero-shot classifiers.
models.input_desc: 批量图像与自然语言文本配对
models.input_en: Mini-batch of N paired (image, natural-language caption) samples
models.output_desc: 共享嵌入空间中的图像/文本向量与零样本类别分数
models.output_en: L2-normalized shared-space image/text embeddings and cosine zero-shot classification logits

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 监督分类器只能识别固定类别，类别标签表达有限
attrs.核心想法: 双编码器以对称图文对比损失建立开放词汇共享嵌入空间
attrs.关键改进: 海量图文弱监督、prompt zero-shot 与高效检索
attrs.医学适配: 奠定 CXR-report、病理-caption 和医学 zero-shot VLM 路线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 医学 VLM 基础设施；global embedding、false negatives 与校准仍有限

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Closed-set classifiers could not generalize to unseen diagnostic categories or leverage rich free-text clinical descriptions.
attrs_en.核心想法: Train dual image and text encoders jointly on 400M image–text pairs to maximize cosine similarity of true pairs against N²−N negatives.
attrs_en.关键改进: Scalable dual-encoder contrastive pretraining + natural-language prompt templates enabling zero-shot open-vocabulary transfer.
attrs_en.医学适配: Foundational blueprint for ConVIRT, GLoRIA, BioViL, BiomedCLIP, CONCH, and multimodal radiology/pathology retrieval.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Core VLM infrastructure; global pooled vectors lack fine spatial localization and require calibration before clinical thresholding.

models.paper_title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision

models.title: BLIP-2
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.core_mech: Q-Former 的 learnable queries 作为冻结图像 encoder 与冻结 LLM 之间唯一可训练的视觉信息瓶颈。
models.core_mech_en: Bridges a frozen pretrained image encoder to a frozen LLM using a lightweight Querying Transformer (Q-Former) with learnable query tokens as an information bottleneck.
models.input_desc: 图像与文本配对，生成阶段输入图像和文本 prompt
models.input_en: Image + text caption (Stage 1) or image + natural-language instruction prompt (Stage 2)
models.output_desc: 图像条件文本或视觉语言表征
models.output_en: Fixed-length visual query embeddings and autoregressive image-conditioned text generation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 端到端训练大型视觉语言模型成本过高
attrs.核心想法: 冻结视觉 encoder 与 LLM，只训练 Q-Former 连接视觉查询和语言空间
attrs.关键改进: 两阶段图文表示与生成训练的轻量 connector
attrs.医学适配: 成为最有影响力的 connector-based 医学 MLLM、VQA 和报告生成模板之一
attrs.适用范围与证据: 架构影响持久；语言先验可能覆盖真实视觉证据

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: End-to-end joint pretraining of giant vision encoders and multi-billion-parameter LLMs was computationally prohibitive.
attrs_en.核心想法: Keep both the vision encoder and LLM frozen, training only a lightweight Q-Former bottleneck to extract language-informative visual features.
attrs_en.关键改进: Two-stage pretraining: Stage 1 vision–language representation learning (ITC + ITM + ITG) followed by Stage 2 vision-to-LLM generative alignment.
attrs_en.医学适配: Canonical connector architecture behind medical VQA, report generation, and multimodal LLM assistants.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Highly influential modular paradigm; strong frozen LLM priors can still hallucinate plausible text detached from visual query tokens.

models.paper_title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models

models.title: ConVIRT
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.core_mech: 将自然生成的医学图像–报告对输入全局双塔，通过双向跨模态对比预训练医学视觉 encoder。
models.core_mech_en: Pretrains medical visual encoders directly from naturally occurring paired radiology images and free-text reports via bidirectional contrastive loss.
models.input_desc: 医学图像与配套自由文本报告
models.input_en: Paired medical image (e.g., chest X-ray) and corresponding clinical radiology report sentence
models.output_desc: 对齐的图像与报告全局表征
models.output_en: Contrastively aligned visual encoder representation for downstream low-label classification

attrs.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet 或纯图像 SSL 对医学高类间相似度与临床语义帮助有限
attrs.核心想法: 对配对医学影像与报告做双向全局对比学习
attrs.关键改进: 用自然语言报告作为弱监督，并展示少标签迁移
attrs.医学适配: 奠定医学 CLIP 式胸片表示学习
attrs.适用范围与证据: 医学图文对齐 landmark；局部定位能力有限

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet pretraining struggled with subtle gray-scale radiographic findings, while rule-based report labelers (CheXpert) lost clinical nuance.
attrs_en.核心想法: Use naturally co-occurring clinical radiology reports as free-form weak supervision via bidirectional image–text contrastive learning.
attrs_en.关键改进: Domain-specific image and clinical text dual towers trained with symmetric InfoNCE, achieving strong label efficiency with 1%–10% labels.
attrs_en.医学适配: Pioneered the medical CLIP paradigm before or alongside general-domain CLIP, establishing report-supervised radiology pretraining.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Landmark medical VLM foundation; global pooling captures study-level semantics but remains coarse for tiny focal lesions.

models.paper_title: Contrastive Learning of Medical Visual Representations from Paired Images and Text

models.title: GLoRIA
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.core_mech: 在全局图文对比之外，以词为 query 对 CNN region grid 做软 attention 并训练局部区域–词对齐。
models.core_mech_en: Combines global image–report contrastive alignment with word-queried soft attention over local CNN image grid regions for fine-grained phrase grounding.
models.input_desc: 医学图像与对应放射报告
models.input_en: Medical image (chest X-ray) + paired free-text radiology report
models.output_desc: 全局图文对齐表征与局部区域–词语对齐特征
models.output_en: Globally aligned image/text embeddings + word-grounded local spatial attention maps

attrs.上一代瓶颈: global 图文 embedding 难定位细粒度征象
attrs.核心想法: 同时对齐整图-报告和局部影像区域-报告词语
attrs.关键改进: 基于 attention 的 global-local contrastive objectives
attrs.医学适配: 支持胸片检索、少标注分类/分割和 phrase grounding
attrs.适用范围与证据: 开启医学 local grounding 主线；attention map 不等于因果解释

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Global image–report embeddings collapse spatial coordinates, failing to localize focal findings like small pneumothoraces or nodules.
attrs_en.核心想法: Align individual report words with attention-weighted combinations of local convolutional sub-regions alongside global study alignment.
attrs_en.关键改进: Joint global contrastive loss + word-to-region attention-weighted local contrastive objective without requiring bounding-box annotations.
attrs_en.医学适配: Enables zero-shot phrase grounding, text-to-image retrieval, and label-efficient chest X-ray segmentation/classification.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Established local grounding in medical VLMs; soft attention heatmaps remain coarse and do not guarantee causal localization.

models.paper_title: GLoRIA: A Multimodal Global-Local Representation Learning Framework for Label-efficient Medical Image Recognition

models.title: BioViL
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.core_mech: 以放射报告专用 CXR-BERT 提升文本语义，再联合学习检查级图文对比与短语–视觉 patch grounding。
models.core_mech_en: Pairs a radiology-specialized text encoder (CXR-BERT with RSM masked pretraining) with joint global and local patch–phrase contrastive alignment.
models.input_desc: 胸部 X-ray 与对应放射报告/短语
models.input_en: Chest radiograph + radiology report findings/impression text
models.output_desc: 具备报告语义与局部 grounding 能力的胸片表征
models.output_en: Negation- and clinical-syntax-aware visual-linguistic embeddings and local phrase grounding maps

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 通用文本 encoder 不理解放射学否定、关系和叙述结构
attrs.核心想法: 以放射学专科语言模型增强全局图文对齐和局部 grounding
attrs.关键改进: 强化文本侧临床语义，并联合 image-text contrastive learning
attrs.医学适配: 在胸片 phrase grounding、分类、分割和检索上形成强专科模型
attrs.适用范围与证据: 证明文本建模不是附属模块；模态范围仍以 CXR 为主

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Generic BERT text encoders mishandled radiological negations ('no pleural effusion'), temporal comparisons, and clinical syntax.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pretrain a dedicated radiology language model (CXR-BERT) with radiology section matching, then align it globally and locally with chest X-rays.
attrs_en.关键改进: Domain-tailored text modeling + symmetric global/local contrastive projection + MS-CXR phrase grounding benchmark.
attrs_en.医学适配: Strong specialist baseline for chest X-ray zero-shot classification, phrase grounding, and semantic report evaluation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Proved that clinical text modeling is as critical as visual architecture; scope is primarily specialized to chest radiography.

models.paper_title: Making the Most of Text Semantics to Improve Biomedical Vision-Language Processing

models.title: BiomedCLIP
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.core_mech: 以 PMC-15M 广域生物医学 figure–caption 语料、ViT 视觉塔和 PubMedBERT 文本塔训练领域 CLIP。
models.core_mech_en: Domain-specific CLIP trained on PMC-15M (15 million biomedical figure–caption pairs from PubMed Central) using a ViT vision tower and PubMedBERT text tower.
models.input_desc: 生物医学图像/论文图与对应 caption
models.input_en: Biomedical image (radiology, pathology, microscopy, chart) + scientific figure caption
models.output_desc: 开放词汇生物医学图文共享嵌入
models.output_en: Open-vocabulary biomedical multimodal embeddings for retrieval, zero-shot classification, and VQA

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 既有医学 CLIP 多局限于胸片单一模态
attrs.核心想法: 在 PMC-15M 科学 figure-caption pairs 上训练 ViT 与 PubMedBERT 双编码器
attrs.关键改进: 扩大到多类生物医学图像和专科文本的开放预训练
attrs.医学适配: 用于跨模态检索、zero-shot 分类和 VQA
attrs.适用范围与证据: 开放权重且覆盖广；科学 figure 与真实 DICOM 分布仍不同

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Prior medical CLIP models were restricted to single modalities (mostly chest X-rays) and lacked broad biomedical taxonomy coverage.
