attrs_en.核心想法: Harvest 15M diverse biomedical figure–caption pairs from PMC open-access articles and train a ViT + PubMedBERT dual encoder with long context.
attrs_en.关键改进: Large-scale multi-specialty biomedical corpus (PMC-15M) + domain-specific PubMedBERT text encoder + patch-dropout scaling.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely used open-weight backbone for cross-modality biomedical retrieval, zero-shot triage, and VQA initialization.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Broadest open biomedical CLIP model; scientific publication figures differ in resolution and calibration from raw clinical DICOMs.

models.paper_title: BiomedCLIP: a multimodal biomedical foundation model pretrained from fifteen million scientific image-text pairs

models.title: ALIGN
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: 十亿级噪声图文对的双编码器对比对齐
models.core_mech: ALIGN 的主要贡献不是新交互模块，而是简单 EfficientNet/BERT 双塔在十亿级未精洗图文对上的规模化训练。
models.core_mech_en: Demonstrates that a simple EfficientNet + BERT dual encoder trained on over one billion noisy web image–alt-text pairs learns robust cross-modal representations.
models.input_desc: 网页图像与未经精细清洗的 alt-text 对
models.input_en: Web image + minimally filtered raw alt-text description
models.output_desc: 共享空间中的图像和文本 embedding，用于检索与零样本分类
models.output_en: Shared-space image and text embeddings for cross-modal retrieval and zero-shot classification

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 高质量人工图文配对昂贵，早期 VLM 数据规模受限
attrs.核心想法: 用双编码器在十亿级噪声网页图文对上做对比对齐
attrs.关键改进: 在其网页语料与评测条件下，以极大规模弱监督缓解标签噪声并获得零样本迁移
attrs.医学适配: 方法上启发从报告、图注和病历构建医学图文预训练数据
attrs.适用范围与证据: 规模化 VLM 里程碑；原论文不是医学验证，医学隐私、噪声和临床语义错配更突出

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Curating clean, human-verified image captions was expensive and bottlenecked dataset scale.
attrs_en.核心想法: Trade stringent manual data cleaning for sheer data scale (1.8B noisy pairs) using a simple dual-encoder contrastive objective.
attrs_en.关键改进: Proved that massive scale can empirically overcome high caption noise in web-scale vision–language pretraining.
attrs_en.医学适配: Methodologically inspired harvesting large-scale noisy hospital PACS archives and scientific figure-caption corpora.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Web-scale VLM milestone; in clinical medicine, uncurated label/report noise and privacy leakage require far stricter governance.

models.paper_title: Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision

models.title: BLIP
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: MED 多模态编码—解码与 CapFilt 数据自举
models.core_mech: 区别于纯双塔，BLIP 用共享 MED 同时承担对齐、跨注意力匹配和因果生成，并把 captioner-filter 作为数据循环的一部分。
models.core_mech_en: Unifies vision–language understanding and generation via a Multimodal Mixture of Encoder–Decoder (MED) coupled with a CapFilt data bootstrapping loop.
models.input_desc: 图像、原始网页描述及由 captioner 生成的合成描述
models.input_en: Image + noisy web caption + synthetically generated and filtered captions
models.output_desc: 图文检索/匹配表示和自回归图像描述
models.output_en: Unimodal embeddings (ITC), cross-modal matching scores (ITM), and autoregressive captions (LM)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 网页图文噪声大，理解与生成模型往往分开训练
attrs.核心想法: 以统一 encoder-decoder 架构结合图文对比、匹配和生成目标
attrs.关键改进: 用 captioner-filter 构造更干净合成描述并统一多任务预训练
attrs.医学适配: 为医学报告生成、问答与跨模态检索提供通用范式
attrs.适用范围与证据: VLM 数据清洗与多目标训练仍关键；临床事实性需独立约束

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure dual encoders (CLIP) cannot generate free text, while noisy web captions degrade generative language modeling.
attrs_en.核心想法: Share weights across a multimodal encoder–decoder trained jointly on contrastive, matching, and generative objectives while bootstrapping clean captions.
attrs_en.关键改进: Weight-shared MED architecture + CapFilt (a captioner generates synthetic descriptions while a filter removes noisy image–text pairs).
attrs_en.医学适配: Provides a versatile blueprint for joint radiology report retrieval, image-report matching verification, and caption generation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Data bootstrapping remains highly relevant; in medicine, synthetic captions must be audited against hallucinated clinical findings.

models.paper_title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation

models.title: Florence-2
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: 提示驱动的统一视觉序列到序列模型
models.core_mech: 核心不是增加多个 head，而是用任务提示和位置 token 将 caption、检测、grounding、分割全部改写为 seq2seq。
models.core_mech_en: Reformulates captioning, object detection, phrase grounding, and segmentation into a single prompt-driven sequence-to-sequence generation task with quantized coordinate tokens.
models.input_desc: 图像与任务提示，例如 caption、detect、ground 或 segment
models.input_en: 2D image + task-specific text prompt (e.g., <OD>, <CAPTION>, <REFERRING_EXPRESSION_SEGMENTATION>)
models.output_desc: 文本、类别与量化位置 token 序列，后处理为描述、框或多边形
models.output_en: Unified token sequence decoding text descriptions, class labels, and quantized 0–999 bounding-box or polygon coordinates

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 视觉任务通常需要不同 head、标签格式和专用模型
attrs.核心想法: 把检测、分割、描述与定位统一为基于提示的序列到序列任务
attrs.关键改进: 以统一文本提示和位置 token 在多任务数据上训练单一生成模型
attrs.医学适配: 可作为医学 VLM 的通用视觉接口和弱标注工具，但需领域适配
attrs.适用范围与证据: 通用视觉基础模型前沿；医学细粒度定位和安全性尚未充分验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Multi-task vision systems required separate specialized task heads, loss functions, and architectural branches for boxes, masks, and text.
attrs_en.核心想法: Represent spatial coordinates as discrete vocabulary tokens (1,000 bins) so a single DaViT + seq2seq Transformer handles all vision tasks.
attrs_en.关键改进: Unified coordinate-token sequence interface + FLD-5B (5.4B multi-task annotations across 126M images) unified pretraining.
attrs_en.医学适配: Offers a unified promptable foundation interface adaptable to medical lesion detection, grounded reporting, and polygon annotation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Frontier generalist vision interface; clinical precision on sub-millimeter boundaries and 3D volumes requires dedicated adaptation.

models.paper_title: Florence-2: Advancing a Unified Representation for a Variety of Vision Tasks

models.title: MedCLIP
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: 基于医学语义软标签的非配对图文对比学习
models.core_mech: MedCLIP 的关键不是更深双塔，而是用医学知识构造任意图像—文本间的软语义配对。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces hard binary 1-to-1 image–report pairing with a soft semantic similarity matrix derived from clinical entity extraction, enabling unpaired contrastive learning.
models.input_desc: 可分别采样的胸片与报告句子，以及图像标签和文本实体
models.input_en: Independently sampled chest radiographs and clinical report sentences with extracted UMLS/CheXpert entities
models.output_desc: 医学图像/文本共享 embedding、零样本分类与检索相似度
models.output_en: Shared medical image–text embeddings and zero-shot disease probabilities

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 医学影像与文本严格配对数据有限，CLIP 式一一对应假设过强
attrs.核心想法: 通过语义匹配把不严格配对的胸片和报告句子用于对比预训练
attrs.关键改进: 基于临床标签/语义相似度构造软配对，扩大可用监督
attrs.医学适配: 用于胸片零样本分类、检索和少样本迁移
attrs.适用范围与证据: 医学 CLIP 代表；主要受限于胸片单域、标签抽取噪声及缺少细粒度定位

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard CLIP treats other patients sharing the exact same pathology in a batch as false negatives and requires strictly paired data.
attrs_en.核心想法: Construct a soft semantic target similarity matrix between any image and any text using extracted clinical entities, training via KL divergence.
attrs_en.关键改进: Decouples contrastive training from strict 1-to-1 pairs and eliminates same-pathology false-negative penalties.
attrs_en.医学适配: Applied to label-efficient chest X-ray zero-shot classification, semantic retrieval, and unpaired pretraining.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Important medical CLIP modification; bounded by the accuracy of rule-based clinical entity extractors and chest X-ray scope.

models.paper_title: MedCLIP: Contrastive Learning from Unpaired Medical Images and Text

models.title: Med-Flamingo
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: 冻结双主干、Perceiver 压缩与门控跨注意力的医学少样本 VLM
models.core_mech: 区别于单一投影接 LLM，Med-Flamingo 用 Perceiver 固定视觉 latent，并在多层冻结 LLM 中反复注入门控跨注意力。
models.core_mech_en: Compresses variable-number medical images via a Perceiver Resampler and injects them into a frozen LLM through tanh-gated cross-attention layers for few-shot in-context learning.
models.input_desc: 交错的医学图像、文本及若干上下文示例
models.input_en: Interleaved sequence of exemplar medical images, clinical text, and a query medical image/question
models.output_desc: 条件于图像和 in-context 示例的自回归医学回答或解释
models.output_en: Autoregressive medical VQA answer or clinical rationale conditioned on in-context exemplars

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 通用多模态模型医学知识不足，专用模型又难做少样本对话
attrs.核心想法: 在冻结的语言模型中插入跨注意力层，接收交错医学图像与文本上下文
attrs.关键改进: 基于 Flamingo 进行医学图文持续预训练并支持 in-context few-shot
attrs.医学适配: 用于 few-shot 医学视觉问答与 rationale generation 原型
attrs.适用范围与证据: 早期医学 MLLM；评测规模小，语言先验可能掩盖视觉不足

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: General-purpose VLMs lacked medical domain knowledge, while task-specific medical models could not adapt on the fly from a few examples.
attrs_en.核心想法: Continue pretraining a Flamingo-style gated cross-attention architecture on interleaved biomedical textbook/article figures and text.
attrs_en.关键改进: Perceiver Resampler fixed-token visual compression + zero-initialized tanh-gated cross-attention interleaved inside a frozen LLM.
attrs_en.医学适配: Prototype for few-shot in-context medical visual question answering and clinical rationale generation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Early medical MLLM milestone; human evaluation cohorts were small and LLM priors can still generate plausible-sounding errors.

models.paper_title: Med-Flamingo: a Multimodal Medical Few-shot Learner

models.title: LLaVA-Med
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: 生物医学视觉 encoder—线性 projector—LLM 指令微调
models.core_mech: 其贡献主要是将 LLaVA 两阶段训练移到生物医学域：PMC 图注概念对齐后再做合成医学指令微调。
models.core_mech_en: Adapts the LLaVA visual-instruction-tuning paradigm to biomedicine via two-stage training: PMC figure–caption alignment followed by GPT-4-synthesized biomedical instruction tuning.
models.input_desc: 生物医学图像、图注或用户指令/问题
models.input_en: Biomedical image + user clinical question or conversational instruction
models.output_desc: 面向图像的自回归回答、描述与解释文本
models.output_en: Open-ended autoregressive biomedical explanation, visual QA response, or figure analysis

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 通用 LLaVA 缺医学术语和科研图像知识，人工指令数据昂贵
attrs.核心想法: 将生物医学视觉编码器通过投影连接到 LLM，并用合成指令数据微调
attrs.关键改进: 利用 PubMed 图注生成大规模医学多模态指令并高效训练
attrs.医学适配: 用于生物医学图像问答、解释与研究辅助
attrs.适用范围与证据: 重要开放基线；合成指令偏差和临床真实性限制直接部署

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: General LLaVA lacked biomedical terminology and figure interpretation skills, while manual clinician instruction datasets were unavailable.
attrs_en.核心想法: Project BiomedCLIP/ViT visual tokens into an LLM and fine-tune on multi-turn biomedical instructions synthesized from PubMed captions.
attrs_en.关键改进: Fast 15-hour two-stage curriculum: Stage 1 linear projection concept alignment on PMC-15M + Stage 2 end-to-end synthetic instruction tuning.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely adopted open-source baseline for biomedical VQA, conversational research assistance, and MLLM benchmarking.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational open medical MLLM; synthetic caption-derived instructions cannot substitute for verified clinical DICOM ground truth.

models.paper_title: LLaVA-Med: Training a Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for Biomedicine in One Day

models.title: RadFM
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: 统一 2D/3D 放射影像的视觉 encoder—Perceiver—LLM
models.core_mech: RadFM 的模型特异性在于统一 2D/3D 视觉 encoder 与 Perceiver 扫描聚合，再接生成式 LLM。
models.core_mech_en: Unifies 2D radiographs and 3D volumetric scans (CT/MRI) via a 2D/3D ViT + Perceiver 3D aggregator feeding into a generative radiology LLM.
models.input_desc: 一张或一组 2D 图像、3D CT/MRI 体积及文本指令
models.input_en: Single/multiple 2D radiographs or 3D CT/MRI volumes + natural-language clinical instruction
models.output_desc: 放射学自由文本回答、报告或识别结果
models.output_en: Free-text radiology report, VQA answer, abnormality diagnosis, or rationale

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 多数医学 VLM 只支持单张 2D 图像且任务和模态碎片化
attrs.核心想法: 统一编码 2D 图像、3D 体积和文本，并以自回归 LLM 完成放射学多任务
attrs.关键改进: 引入可变长度 3D visual tokens 与跨模态指令数据
attrs.医学适配: 覆盖 CT、MRI、X-ray 等问答、报告与识别任务
attrs.适用范围与证据: 通用放射模型 proof-of-concept；外部临床可靠性和幻觉仍是核心风险

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Most medical MLLMs accepted only single 2D slices, failing to ingest volumetric 3D CT/MRI studies natively.
attrs_en.核心想法: Encode both 2D images and 3D volumetric patches into unified visual tokens compressed by a Perceiver resampler before an autoregressive LLM.
attrs_en.关键改进: Unified 2D/3D visual tokenization + RadMD 16M multi-modal radiology instruction dataset + RadBench evaluation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Addresses multi-modality radiology VQA, report generation, and disease triage across X-ray, CT, and MRI.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Important 3D-capable radiology MLLM proof-of-concept; hallucination rates and external clinical calibration remain critical hurdles.

models.paper_title: Towards Generalist Foundation Model for Radiology by Leveraging Web-scale 2D&3D Medical Data

models.title: MAIRA-1
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: 胸片专用 RAD-DINO—四层适配器—完整微调 Vicuna 报告生成
models.core_mech: MAIRA-1 不是通用图文预训练模型，而是冻结胸片 RAD-DINO、使用四层 adapter，并完整微调 Vicuna-7B 的专用报告生成器。
models.core_mech_en: Specialist chest X-ray report generator pairing a frozen CXR-specific RAD-DINO visual encoder, a 4-layer MLP adapter, and a fully fine-tuned Vicuna-7B LLM.
models.input_desc: 胸部 X 光图像及可选 indication 文本
models.input_en: Frontal chest X-ray + clinical indication/history prompt
models.output_desc: 放射报告 Findings 文本
models.output_en: Structured clinical radiology Findings narrative

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 通用 VLM 报告缺结构化临床表述且易遗漏异常
attrs.核心想法: 将胸片专用视觉编码器与 Vicuna-7B 对齐并针对放射学报告生成完整微调
attrs.关键改进: 使用 CXR 专用视觉编码、文本数据增强与完整 LLM fine-tuning 强化胸片叙述
attrs.医学适配: 面向胸片 findings/impression 自动草拟与研究基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 报告生成代表模型；需逐项事实核验和放射科医生复核

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: General-purpose VLMs produced stylistically generic reports and frequently omitted subtle thoracic abnormalities.
attrs_en.核心想法: Combine a domain-pretrained chest X-ray self-supervised encoder (RAD-DINO) with full LLM fine-tuning tailored specifically to CXR reporting.
attrs_en.关键改进: Frozen high-resolution RAD-DINO ViT-B/14 (49×49 grid) + 4-layer MLP adapter + text augmentation + RadGraph/radiologist evaluation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Dedicated baseline for automated chest X-ray Findings drafting and clinical factuality evaluation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Representative specialist report generator; lacks explicit spatial bounding-box grounding (addressed in MAIRA-2).

models.paper_title: MAIRA-1: A Specialised Large Multimodal Model for Radiology Report Generation

models.title: MAIRA-2
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: 多上下文胸片输入与文本—边界框联合生成
models.core_mech: 相较 MAIRA-1，MAIRA-2 增加多视图/既往/报告上下文，并把报告句子与生成式 bounding-box token 绑定。
models.core_mech_en: Extends MAIRA-1 with multi-view (AP/PA + lateral), prior study/report longitudinal context, and interleaved quantized bounding-box tokens for grounded reporting.
models.input_desc: 当前正位/侧位胸片、既往正位胸片与报告、indication、technique、comparison 和任务提示
models.input_en: Current frontal & lateral CXR, prior CXR, prior report, indication, technique, comparison + task prompt
models.output_desc: 普通 Findings、逐句关联边界框的 grounded Findings，或短语定位框
models.output_en: Ungrounded Findings, spatially grounded Findings (linking each clinical sentence to bounding boxes), or phrase grounding

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 纯文本报告难追溯到影像证据，模型错误不易审计
attrs.核心想法: 在报告生成时同时输出与叙述实体对应的图像区域定位
attrs.关键改进: 把检测式 grounding 与长文本生成统一，并接收当前/既往胸片、既往报告、检查指征及比较信息
attrs.医学适配: 用于成人胸片的可定位报告与研究性人机复核
attrs.适用范围与证据: 可审计报告生成的重要方向；grounding 正确不等于诊断正确

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Un-grounded text reports cannot be visually audited on the image, and single-image inputs ignore longitudinal interval change.
attrs_en.核心想法: Condition the LLM on full longitudinal clinical context (multi-view + prior study/report) while emitting spatial bounding-box tokens inline with findings.
attrs_en.关键改进: Unified sequence generation of clinical prose and quantized spatial coordinates + comprehensive longitudinal chest X-ray context.
attrs_en.医学适配: Sets the standard for auditable, spatially grounded adult chest X-ray report drafting and human-in-the-loop review.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Major step toward verifiable clinical VLMs; accurate box localization still requires mandatory radiologist verification.

models.paper_title: MAIRA-2: Grounded Radiology Report Generation

models.title: BiomedGPT
models.family_label: 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义不等于视觉事实
models.archetype: 多模态 token 统一的 encoder—decoder 生物医学通才模型
models.core_mech: BiomedGPT 以模态无关、任务无关的 encoder—decoder token 化接口统一生物医学视觉、语言和多模态输出。
models.core_mech_en: Modality- and task-agnostic encoder–decoder Transformer unifying biomedical images, clinical text, and bounding boxes into a discrete token sequence interface.
models.input_desc: 文本 token、2D 图像 patch/token 及任务指令
models.input_en: 2D biomedical image patches, text tokens, and task-specifying instruction prompt
models.output_desc: 文本、类别、坐标或图像 token 等统一序列输出
models.output_en: Unified autoregressive token stream representing free text, classification labels, or spatial coordinates

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 生物医学模型按模态和任务分散，难共享知识与接口
attrs.核心想法: 以统一序列到序列框架处理生物医学图像、文本和多种输出格式
attrs.关键改进: 在多领域多任务数据上联合预训练并用任务提示统一预测
attrs.医学适配: 覆盖放射、病理、皮肤、文本理解和生成任务
attrs.适用范围与证据: generalist 医学模型代表；跨中心临床价值仍依赖专门验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Biomedical AI models were siloed by modality (radiology vs. pathology vs. text) and task head architecture.
attrs_en.核心想法: Map vision patches, text subwords, and spatial locations into a shared discrete vocabulary processed by a unified BART/OFA-style encoder–decoder.
attrs_en.关键改进: Multi-task, multi-specialty pretraining + instruction fine-tuning across vision, language, VQA, captioning, and detection.
attrs_en.医学适配: Generalist biomedical foundation baseline spanning radiology, pathology, ophthalmology, dermatology, and biomedical NLP.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Representative generalist architecture; specialist models often retain an edge on high-stakes quantitative or 3D tasks.

models.paper_title: A Generalist Vision-Language Foundation Model for Diverse Biomedical Tasks

models.title: UNI
models.family_label: 病理基础模型：从 patch encoder 到 whole-slide 多模态推理
models.fig_badge: Figure 1(b) · PDF p.Official HTML Figure 1 asset
models.core_mech: 在超过一亿病理图块上以 DINOv2 式 teacher–student 训练 ViT-L/16，向多类病理任务提供统一冻结 tile encoder。
models.core_mech_en: ViT-L/16 tile encoder pretrained via DINOv2 self-distillation and iBOT masked patch modeling on over 100 million H&E histopathology patches (Mass-100K).
models.input_desc: 全视野病理切片切出的无标签组织图块
models.input_en: 256×256 H&E histopathology tissue tiles extracted from whole-slide images (WSIs)
models.output_desc: 可冻结迁移的病理图块表征及其下游切片级聚合
models.output_en: Frozen transferable tile embeddings for ROI tasks or MIL whole-slide aggregation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet 或小规模 TCGA encoder 跨组织迁移弱
attrs.核心想法: 在超过一亿病理 patches 上用 DINOv2 训练 ViT-L 通用 tile encoder
attrs.关键改进: 大规模多组织 WSI 数据、自监督预训练与 34 个临床任务评估
attrs.医学适配: 原论文及后续比较报告较强的病理 label efficiency 和跨任务迁移
attrs.适用范围与证据: 病理 foundation model 的成熟代表；slide 聚合仍常需任务训练

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet-pretrained encoders and small TCGA-only models generalized poorly across diverse tissue types and rare cancers.
attrs_en.核心想法: Scale DINOv2 self-supervised pretraining to >100M non-public diagnostic tissue tiles across 20 major tissue types (100,000+ WSIs).
attrs_en.关键改进: Massive non-TCGA clinical tissue diversity + DINOv2/iBOT recipe evaluated systematically across 34 clinical pathology tasks.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely adopted frozen tile feature extractor for cancer subtyping, biomarker prediction, ROI retrieval, and cell segmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Mature pathology tile foundation model; slide-level diagnosis still requires training an MIL or slide aggregator on top.

models.paper_title: Towards a General-Purpose Foundation Model for Computational Pathology

models.title: CONCH
models.family_label: 病理基础模型：从 patch encoder 到 whole-slide 多模态推理
models.fig_badge: Figure 1(c) · PDF p.Official HTML Figure 1 asset
models.core_mech: 在病理领域把 CLIP 式全局对比与 CoCa 式图像条件 caption decoder 联合训练，同时服务判别与生成。
models.core_mech_en: CoCa-style computational pathology vision–language foundation model jointly trained with contrastive image–text alignment and generative caption decoding on 1.17M pairs.
models.input_desc: 组织病理图像与人工生成的病理文本描述
models.input_en: Histopathology image tile/ROI + paired pathology text description or prompt
models.output_desc: 病理图文共享表征及图像条件文本生成
models.output_en: Shared multimodal retrieval/zero-shot embeddings + autoregressive pathology caption/text generation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: vision-only 病理 encoder 缺少 zero-shot 与跨模态检索接口
attrs.核心想法: 以 117 万病理 image-caption pairs 学开放语义视觉语言表示
attrs.关键改进: 病理专科图文对齐，统一分类、检索、caption 和分割迁移
attrs.医学适配: 支持病理 zero-shot/few-shot 和文本驱动检索
attrs.适用范围与证据: 独立 benchmark 表现强；caption 构造和术语覆盖决定上限

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Vision-only pathology foundation models (UNI, Virchow) lack native text interfaces for zero-shot classification or cross-modal search.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pretrain a ViT vision encoder, text encoder, and multimodal caption decoder on 1.17M curated human histopathology image–caption pairs.
attrs_en.关键改进: Unifies CLIP-style dual-encoder retrieval/zero-shot transfer with CoCa-style generative captioning in computational pathology.
attrs_en.医学适配: Enables zero-shot cancer subtyping, text-to-tile search, WSI zero-shot MI-Zero classification, and pathology captioning.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Top-performing multimodal pathology foundation model; performance is bounded by educational/caption terminology coverage.

models.paper_title: A Visual-Language Foundation Model for Computational Pathology

models.title: Prov-GigaPath
models.family_label: 病理基础模型：从 patch encoder 到 whole-slide 多模态推理
models.core_mech: DINOv2 病理 tile encoder 与 LongNet 膨胀注意力 slide encoder 两级串联，并以 masked tile reconstruction 预训练全切片上下文。
models.core_mech_en: Two-stage gigapixel pathology foundation model pairing a DINOv2 tile encoder with a LongNet dilated-attention whole-slide encoder pretrained via masked tile reconstruction.
models.input_desc: 全视野病理切片及其组织 tile 坐标序列
models.input_en: Whole-slide image (WSI) decomposed into tens of thousands of tissue tiles with 2D spatial (x, y) coordinates
models.output_desc: 整张 WSI 的长上下文表征与病例级任务预测
models.output_en: Contextualized whole-slide representation and patient/case-level diagnostic or genomic predictions

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 独立 tile 表示无法捕获病例级、跨区域关系
attrs.核心想法: DINOv2 tile encoder 加 LongNet/MAE slide encoder 建模超长全切片上下文
attrs.关键改进: 在 13 亿 tiles 上预训练并进行 whole-slide long-context aggregation
attrs.医学适配: 面向病理病例级诊断、分型和预后迁移
attrs.适用范围与证据: whole-slide 建模是实质变化；跨国家流程仍需验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Tile-level encoders treat patches independently, while standard self-attention cannot scale to 40,000+ tiles per gigapixel WSI.
attrs_en.核心想法: Encode tiles via DINOv2, then model whole-slide spatial dependencies across all tiles using LongNet dilated attention pretrained with MAE.
attrs_en.关键改进: 1.3B-tile real-world clinical pretraining (171,189 WSIs) + LongNet linear-scaling dilated slide attention + vision-language report alignment.
attrs_en.医学适配: Targets whole-slide cancer subtyping, mutation/biomarker prediction, and prognostic modeling across health-system cohorts.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Represents true whole-slide context pretraining; external multi-institutional calibration remains essential.

models.paper_title: A Whole-Slide Foundation Model for Digital Pathology from Real-World Data

models.title: Virchow
models.family_label: 病理基础模型：从 patch encoder 到 whole-slide 多模态推理
models.archetype: 百万级 WSI tile 的 DINOv2 ViT-H 自监督病理 encoder
models.fig_badge: Figure 1(e–f) · PDF p.Official full-size Figure 1 asset
models.core_mech: Virchow 是 632M ViT-H/14 的病理 tile foundation encoder，以约 150 万临床 WSI 的 DINOv2 自监督规模取胜。
models.core_mech_en: 632M-parameter ViT-H/14 computational pathology tile foundation model pretrained with DINOv2 on 2 billion tiles from 1.5 million clinical H&E whole-slide images.
models.input_desc: H&E 全切片切出的组织 tile 及其全局/局部增强视图
models.input_en: 224×224 H&E histopathology tissue tile (with global and local crops during pretraining)
models.output_desc: tile-level 632M ViT embedding；下游可经 WSI aggregator 形成病例预测
models.output_en: 2560-D tile representation ([CLS] concatenated with mean patch token) feeding downstream WSI aggregators

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 病理监督标签稀缺且稀有癌种难覆盖，ImageNet 特征域差距大
attrs.核心想法: 在百万级全切片 patch 上自监督预训练大规模 ViT 病理编码器
attrs.关键改进: 利用海量临床 WSI 和 DINOv2 式预训练提升低样本与稀有任务迁移
attrs.医学适配: 支持 pan-cancer detection、稀有癌、细胞识别和 biomarker prediction
attrs.适用范围与证据: 病理 FM 关键里程碑；患者级去重、扫描域移位和独立比较仍重要

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Smaller pathology models struggled on rare cancer variants and cross-laboratory staining variations.
attrs_en.核心想法: Scale both model capacity (ViT-H/14, 632M) and clinical data volume (1.5M WSIs from MSKCC) under DINOv2 self-supervised learning.
attrs_en.关键改进: Institutional gigapixel scale (1.5M slides) + 632M ViT-H architecture demonstrating strong pan-cancer and rare-cancer generalization.
attrs_en.医学适配: Supports pan-cancer detection, rare tumor identification, biomarker prediction, and cell-level pathology tasks.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Landmark high-capacity pathology tile encoder; independent benchmarks show ensemble diversity with UNI/CONCH remains valuable.

models.paper_title: A Foundation Model for Clinical-Grade Computational Pathology and Rare Cancers Detection

models.title: CHIEF
models.family_label: 病理基础模型：从 patch encoder 到 whole-slide 多模态推理
models.archetype: tile 自监督与 WSI 弱监督相接的双阶段病理基础模型
models.fig_badge: Figure 1(a) · PDF p.Official full-size Figure 1 asset
models.core_mech: CHIEF 明确串联 CTransPath tile 自监督和带解剖条件的 WSI attention 弱监督，而非只发布局部 patch encoder。
models.core_mech_en: Couples self-supervised tile encoding (CTransPath) with anatomical-site-conditioned whole-slide attention aggregation trained across 60,530 WSIs.
models.input_desc: H&E WSI、tile 特征及训练时的癌症/解剖部位弱标签
models.input_en: H&E whole-slide image tiles + anatomical primary site text/categorical embedding
models.output_desc: 通用 tile embedding、WSI embedding 和诊断/预后任务输出
models.output_en: Slide-level diagnostic representation for cancer detection, tumor origin, genomic mutation, and survival prediction

attrs.上一代瓶颈: patch encoder 与 slide-level 预后模型割裂，跨癌种迁移有限
attrs.核心想法: 联合自监督图像预训练与弱监督全切片聚合学习癌症表征
attrs.关键改进: 在多中心多癌种 WSI 上学习可用于诊断和生存预测的通用表示
attrs.医学适配: 用于癌种识别、分子标志物和预后风险建模
attrs.适用范围与证据: 临床广度突出；回顾性关联不等同于前瞻性决策效益

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Standalone patch encoders lacked pre-trained slide-level aggregators conditioned on anatomical site context.
attrs_en.核心想法: Combine a pretrained hybrid CNN-Transformer tile encoder with a weakly supervised WSI attention aggregator conditioned on anatomical site.
attrs_en.关键改进: Two-stage tile + slide pretraining across 19 anatomical sites with broad multi-center external validation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Applied to cancer detection, tumor origin identification, genomic profile inference, and survival risk stratification.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Demonstrates broad multi-center retrospective validation; prognostic risk scores still require prospective trial verification.

models.paper_title: A Pathology Foundation Model for Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis Prediction

models.title: TITAN
models.family_label: 病理基础模型：从 patch encoder 到 whole-slide 多模态推理
models.archetype: iBOT 全片视觉预训练加 CoCa 多尺度图文对齐
models.core_mech: TITAN 的特异性是三阶段 whole-slide 预训练：特征网格 iBOT、ROI caption CoCa、WSI report CoCa。
models.core_mech_en: Three-stage multimodal whole-slide foundation model pretrained via iBOT on 2D tile feature grids, CoCa on synthetic ROI captions, and CoCa on whole-slide pathology reports.
models.input_desc: 预提取病理 patch 网格、ROI 合成描述和 WSI 病理报告
models.input_en: Pre-extracted 2D spatial grid of WSI patch embeddings (CONCH v1.5) + ROI descriptions / clinical pathology reports
models.output_desc: 通用 whole-slide embedding、跨模态检索分数与病理文本生成
models.output_en: General-purpose whole-slide embedding, zero-shot slide classification, cross-modal report retrieval, and slide report generation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 仅 patch 级预训练缺整片上下文，纯视觉模型难接入语言任务
attrs.核心想法: 以 slide encoder 汇聚 gigapixel WSI，并与病理报告文本进行跨模态对齐
attrs.关键改进: 在整片尺度联合视觉自监督和图文对齐，支持零样本与生成任务
attrs.医学适配: 用于 WSI 分类、检索、报告和生物标志物预测
attrs.适用范围与证据: whole-slide 多模态 FM 前沿；公开权重移除了多模态 decoder，论文报告生成功能不能完整复现

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Most pathology foundation models stopped at the tile level, requiring task-specific MIL training from scratch for every slide-level task.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pretrain a Vision Transformer slide encoder directly over spatial grids of tile embeddings using progressive visual and clinical report supervision.
attrs_en.关键改进: Progressive 3-stage slide-level curriculum (335K WSIs) bridging spatial tile grids, synthetic ROI morphology captions, and clinical reports.
attrs_en.医学适配: Enables zero-shot whole-slide subtyping, rare cancer retrieval, biomarker prediction, and slide-level representation reuse.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Frontier multimodal slide foundation model; note that the publicly released weights omit the generative text decoder.

models.paper_title: A Multimodal Whole-Slide Foundation Model for Pathology

models.title: PRISM2
models.family_label: 病理基础模型：从 patch encoder 到 whole-slide 多模态推理
models.archetype: Virchow2—Perceiver—Phi-3 的双嵌入临床对话病理模型
models.fig_badge: Figure 1(a) · PDF p.Official full-size Figure 1 asset
models.core_mech: PRISM2 明确提供双嵌入：Perceiver 的通用 base embedding，以及 Phi-3 隐状态导出的诊断 embedding。
models.core_mech_en: Pairs a Perceiver slide encoder over Virchow2 tile embeddings with a Phi-3 LLM trained on single-turn clinical dialogues derived from pathology reports, exposing dual embeddings.
models.input_desc: 一个病例的一张或多张 H&E WSI、文本提示与由报告改写的单轮临床对话
models.input_en: Multi-slide H&E case tile embeddings (Virchow2) + clinical prompt / diagnostic query
models.output_desc: 2560 维 base embedding、3072 维 diagnostic embedding、报告或问答文本
models.output_en: 2560-D base slide embedding, 3072-D LLM diagnostic embedding, or autoregressive pathology text response

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 两阶段 patch/slide/LLM 管线信息瓶颈多且难统一适配
attrs.核心想法: 将 Virchow2 tile embeddings 输入 Perceiver slide encoder，再连接 Phi-3 进行临床对话式推理
attrs.关键改进: 第一阶段训练 slide encoder，第二阶段冻结它并训练语言接口与 prompt-based inference
attrs.医学适配: 以临床对话作为监督和病理全切片推理接口，不以部署聊天代理为目标
attrs.适用范围与证据: 新近前沿；需要独立复现、病理医生盲评和部署安全证据

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Two-stage MIL + LLM pathology pipelines suffered from rigid task heads and disconnected visual vs. linguistic representations.
attrs_en.核心想法: Connect a Perceiver slide aggregator to a clinical LLM (Phi-3) via conversational report supervision, extracting both visual and LLM-contextualized embeddings.
attrs_en.关键改进: Exposes dual reusable interfaces (Perceiver base embedding + LLM last-token diagnostic embedding) alongside promptable zero-shot inference.
attrs_en.医学适配: Designed as a promptable whole-slide diagnostic representation and conversational reasoning engine rather than a patient-facing chatbot.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Emerging 2025/2026 frontier preprint; requires independent multi-center replication and pathologist workflow validation.

models.paper_title: End-to-End Multimodal Pathology Foundation Model with Clinical Dialogue

models.title: Merlin
models.family_label: CT/MRI 检查级基础模型：输入单位从切片走向完整 study
models.fig_badge: Figure 1 · PDF p.Official HTML Figure 1 asset
models.core_mech: 以 I3D ResNet-152 原生编码完整 CT，并用 EHR phenotype prediction 与 Clinical Longformer 报告对比进行多源多任务预训练。
models.core_mech_en: Native 3D abdominal CT foundation model encoding whole volumes with an I3D ResNet-152 supervised jointly by EHR diagnosis codes (phenotypes) and radiology reports.
models.input_desc: 三维 CT 体积、同检查放射报告与 EHR diagnosis codes
models.input_en: Volumetric 3D abdominal CT scan + paired free-text radiology report + longitudinal EHR ICD diagnosis codes
models.output_desc: 检查级 3D 视觉语言表征及零样本/适配后临床任务输出
models.output_en: Study-level 3D visual-linguistic representation supporting zero-shot findings, EHR phenotype prediction, and 3D segmentation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 逐切片 2D VLM 无法充分建模体积解剖和检查级上下文
attrs.核心想法: 联合 3D CT、EHR diagnosis codes 与报告学习检查级视觉语言表示
attrs.关键改进: 原生 3D encoder、多源临床监督与 44098 个外部 CT 的验证
attrs.医学适配: 代表腹部 CT 主训练域上的原生 3D VLM 与外部大规模评估
attrs.适用范围与证据: 已发表证据较强的 3D CT FM 之一；仍为回顾性且非自治报告安全证明

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Slice-wise 2D VLMs fail to capture 3D volumetric continuity, while report-only supervision misses structured longitudinal EHR outcomes.
attrs_en.核心想法: Train a native 3D convolutional encoder on 15,331 paired abdominal CTs using both free-text reports (Clinical-Longformer) and 1,692 EHR phenotypes.
attrs_en.关键改进: Synergistic dual supervision (radiology prose + structured EHR codes) on native 3D volumes, validated across 44,098 external CTs.
attrs_en.医学适配: Supports zero-shot abnormality classification, cross-modal retrieval, 5-year chronic disease risk prediction, and 3D organ segmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Among the most thoroughly externally validated 3D CT foundation models; evidence remains retrospective.

models.paper_title: Merlin: a Computed Tomography Vision-Language Foundation Model and Dataset

models.title: BME-X
models.family_label: CT/MRI 检查级基础模型：输入单位从切片走向完整 study
models.archetype: 组织标签先验驱动的双 DU-Net 脑 MRI 增强
models.fig_badge: Figure 1(a) · PDF p.Official full-size Figure 1 asset
models.core_mech: BME-X 不是通用 MRI encoder，而是先预测组织标签、再用组织感知 DU-Net 生成增强图像的两阶段恢复模型。
models.core_mech_en: Two-stage brain MRI enhancement foundation model that first estimates tissue probability maps and then conditions a Dual U-Net (DU-Net) to restore harmonized images.
models.input_desc: 受运动、低分辨率、噪声、扫描仪或场强差异影响的结构脑 MRI
models.input_en: Structural brain MRI degraded by motion, low resolution, noise, or cross-scanner field-strength shifts
models.output_desc: 高质量、组织强度更一致的增强 MRI，可供分割、配准与诊断
models.output_en: Harmonized, artifact-corrected, high-resolution brain MRI ready for downstream morphometry, registration, and diagnosis

attrs.上一代瓶颈: MRI 增强模型通常按 degradation 或扫描仪分别训练，且增强质量与下游价值脱节
attrs.核心想法: 先预测组织标签，再用 tissue-aware enhancement network 统一结构脑 MRI 的运动校正、超分、去噪和扫描仪协调化
attrs.关键改进: 以组织标签约束增强，并验证增强图像能改善后续分割、配准与诊断模型
attrs.医学适配: 面向结构脑 MRI 的多任务图像增强，而非多器官通用编码器
attrs.适用范围与证据: MRI enhancement foundation 路线代表；真实世界协议差异和前瞻证据仍有限

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: MRI restoration networks were typically trained per degradation or scanner, often smoothing tissue boundaries needed by downstream tools.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pre-estimate anatomical tissue segmentation probabilities to explicitly guide a tissue-aware enhancement network across diverse degradations.
attrs_en.关键改进: Couples anatomical tissue priors with unified motion correction, super-resolution, denoising, and multi-site scanner harmonization.
attrs_en.医学适配: Serves as a universal structural brain MRI pre-processing and harmonization front-end improving downstream FreeSurfer/segmentation consistency.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Representative restoration-oriented MRI foundation model; must be audited to ensure subtle focal lesions are not harmonized away.

models.paper_title: A Foundation Model for Enhancing Magnetic Resonance Images and Downstream Segmentation, Registration and Diagnostic Tasks

models.title: Prima
models.family_label: CT/MRI 检查级基础模型：输入单位从切片走向完整 study
models.archetype: VQ-VAE 体积 token—sequence ViT—study ViT 的层级 MRI-report CLIP
models.core_mech: Prima 的核心链路是 32×32×4 子体积 VQ-VAE token、sequence ViT、study ViT，再以神经放射报告做 CLIP 对齐。
models.core_mech_en: Hierarchical clinical brain MRI study foundation model chaining 32×32×4 sub-volume VQ-VAE tokenization, a sequence-level ViT, and a study-level ViT aligned with radiology reports.
models.input_desc: 一个真实脑 MRI study 中的多序列 3D 体积、序列名称/描述与配对报告
models.input_en: Complete clinical brain MRI study (multiple heterogeneous 3D sequences + sequence metadata) + paired neuroradiology report
models.output_desc: 完整检查级 embedding、零样本相似度及冻结特征上的 52 任务 MLP 预测
models.output_en: Study-level multimodal embedding supporting zero-shot retrieval and 52 neurological diagnostic/triage MLP probes

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 研究队列规模有限且筛选偏差大，模型难覆盖真实临床异质性
attrs.核心想法: 以 VQ-VAE 把 MRI 体积离散化，再用 sequence ViT、study ViT 和 MRI-report CLIP 学习层级检查表征
attrs.关键改进: 以报告摘要对齐层级神经影像表示，冻结表示后训练 MLP probes
attrs.医学适配: 用于 52 种诊断、优先级与转诊建议等脑 MRI 任务
attrs.适用范围与证据: 有一年 health-system-wide 与外部评估；仍主要来自单一卫生系统，尚未证明工作流结局改善

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Curated research MRI models fail on real-world hospital studies containing variable numbers of sequences, protocols, and artifacts.
attrs_en.核心想法: Tokenize 3D sub-volumes via VQ-VAE and aggregate variable multi-sequence studies through hierarchical sequence- and study-level Transformers aligned with reports.
attrs_en.关键改进: Trained on >200,000 uncurated clinical MRI series (~30,000 studies) with LLM-summarized report alignment and health-system-wide evaluation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Evaluated across 52 neuroimaging diagnoses, acuity triage, and specialist referral recommendations over a 1-year health-system cohort.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Strong health-system-scale study-level evidence; predominantly validated within a single health system and retrospective workflow.

models.paper_title: Learning Neuroimaging Models from Health System-Scale Data

models.title: MARS
models.family_label: CT/MRI 检查级基础模型：输入单位从切片走向完整 study
models.archetype: 3D Swin 的结构—序列解耦多目标 MRI 预训练
models.core_mech: MARS 用 3D Swin 加结构/序列双支路、元数据与对比约束，并通过重建/合成把 anatomy-invariant 与 sequence-specific 信息解耦。
models.core_mech_en: Multi-sequence 3D MRI foundation model pairing a 3D Swin backbone with dual structure/sequence branches and acquisition metadata to disentangle anatomy from contrast.
models.input_desc: 跨 10 个解剖区、多 MRI 序列的 3D volume 及其遮挡/跨序列变体
models.input_en: Multi-sequence 3D MRI volumes across 10 anatomical regions with sequence metadata and cross-sequence masking
models.output_desc: 可迁移 3D Swin 表示，以及供分割、分类、配准、预测和报告任务使用的权重
models.output_en: Disentangled anatomical and sequence representations transferable across 44 segmentation, classification, registration, and report tasks

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 单序列、单器官预训练难处理临床 MRI 协议和对比度异质性
attrs.核心想法: 在大规模多序列 MRI 上解耦 anatomy-invariant 表征与 sequence-specific variation
attrs.关键改进: 以 sequence-disentangled pretraining 迁移到 44 个分割、分类、配准、进展预测和报告生成任务
attrs.医学适配: 适配多器官 MRI 分割、诊断、配准、进展预测与报告生成
attrs.适用范围与证据: 原作者在 44 个任务中报告 41 个第一；不等于独立或前瞻验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Single-sequence or single-organ MRI models brittlely fail when clinical pulse sequences, TR/TE parameters, or contrasts vary.
attrs_en.核心想法: Explicitly factorize 3D MRI representations into an anatomy-invariant structural branch and a sequence-specific contrast branch guided by acquisition metadata.
attrs_en.关键改进: Pretrained on ~160,000 3D MRI scans via cross-sequence synthesis, masked reconstruction, and contrastive disentanglement.
attrs_en.医学适配: Adapts across 44 diverse downstream MRI tasks spanning segmentation, diagnosis, deformable registration, progression, and reporting.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Broad multi-task scope reported by authors; independent external replication under standardized baselines remains necessary.

models.paper_title: Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Pretraining for Generalizable MRI Analysis in Versatile Clinical Applications

models.title: Decipher-MR
models.family_label: CT/MRI 检查级基础模型：输入单位从切片走向完整 study
models.archetype: 3D DINOv2/iBOT 视觉自监督加 PubMedBERT 报告对比对齐
models.fig_badge: Figure 1 with enlarged Figure 1(b) · PDF p.3
models.core_mech: Decipher-MR 明确采用 8³ patch 的 3D ViT-Base、DINOv2/iBOT 视觉预训练、PubMedBERT MLM，再做器官感知的 MRI-report CLIP 对齐。
models.core_mech_en: 3D MRI vision–language foundation model combining an 8³-patch 3D ViT-Base (pretrained via 3D DINOv2/iBOT) with PubMedBERT MLM and organ-aware MRI–report CLIP alignment.
models.input_desc: 单个 3D MRI series 与同 study 的器官级报告文本
models.input_en: 3D MRI series volume + paired study-level organ-parsed radiology report text
models.output_desc: 512 维共享 MRI—文本 embedding、冻结视觉特征及轻量下游 decoder 输出
models.output_en: 512-D shared 3D MRI–text embedding and frozen 3D visual features for lightweight downstream decoders

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 3D MRI 标签稀缺且传统视觉预训练难吸收放射学语义
attrs.核心想法: 先以 DINOv2 式视觉自监督学习 3D MRI 表示，再做 report-guided contrastive alignment
attrs.关键改进: 在约 200000 个 MRI series、22000 余个 studies 上连接体积级视觉 token、多序列 MRI 与临床文本
attrs.医学适配: 用于 3D MRI 检索、分类和跨任务迁移
attrs.适用范围与证据: 新近 3D 医学 VLM；数据覆盖、文本泄漏和独立复现仍需检验，专属预训练代码/权重未开放

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: 3D MRI lacks massive manual labels, while naive global report alignment ignores which series or organ corresponds to which report sentence.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pretrain a 3D ViT via self-distillation on ~200,000 MRI series, then align series embeddings with organ-parsed radiology report segments.
attrs_en.关键改进: Native 8×8×8 3D patch ViT + 3D DINOv2/iBOT visual SSL + organ-gated cross-modal contrastive learning.
attrs_en.医学适配: Supports zero-shot 3D MRI retrieval, disease classification, and label-efficient segmentation/grading across organs.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Recent 3D MRI VLM preprint; pretraining weights/code are not fully public, requiring independent verification.

models.paper_title: Decipher-MR: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D MRI Representations

models.title: Deep Autoencoder
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 逐层 RBM 生成式预训练初始化深层对称 encoder–decoder，再以全局重建误差微调非线性 bottleneck。
models.core_mech_en: Layer-by-layer Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) generative pretraining initializing a deep symmetric encoder–decoder fine-tuned via global reconstruction error.
models.input_desc: 高维数据向量或展平图像
models.input_en: High-dimensional input vector or flattened image patch
models.output_desc: 低维 bottleneck 表征与输入重建
models.output_en: Low-dimensional non-linear bottleneck code z and reconstructed input x̂

attrs.上一代瓶颈: PCA 与手工字典只能表达线性或预设结构
attrs.核心想法: 用深层 encoder-decoder 学非线性低维 latent 并重建输入
attrs.关键改进: 可学习的 bottleneck 表征与逐层预训练
attrs.医学适配: 奠定医学去噪、异常检测、压缩和 latent generative 接口
attrs.适用范围与证据: 思想基础；普通 AE 的采样、不确定性和 L2 模糊有限

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Linear PCA could not capture curved data manifolds, while deep non-linear autoencoders failed to optimize from random initialization.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pretrain stacked RBMs greedily layer-by-layer, then unfold into a symmetric encoder–decoder fine-tuned by backpropagation.
attrs_en.关键改进: Demonstrated that deep non-linear bottleneck manifolds could be stably optimized to compress high-dimensional perceptual data.
attrs_en.医学适配: Conceptual ancestor of medical denoising autoencoders, unsupervised anomaly detection, and latent-space compression.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Historical foundation; deterministic L2 autoencoders blur high-frequency details and lack a tractable generative sampling density.

models.paper_title: Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks

models.title: GAN
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 生成器与判别器通过同一 value function 对抗优化，以数据驱动判别器替代固定重建损失。
models.core_mech_en: Generator and discriminator networks engage in a two-player minimax game, replacing hand-crafted pixel reconstruction losses with a learned adversarial critic.
models.input_desc: 先验噪声 z 与真实数据样本 x
models.input_en: Latent noise vector z ~ p_z(z) and real data samples x ~ p_data(x)
models.output_desc: 逼近真实数据分布的生成样本
models.output_en: Synthesized samples G(z) approximating the real data distribution

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 显式 likelihood 生成模型难训练且样本常过度平滑
attrs.核心想法: generator 与 discriminator 进行对抗式分布学习
attrs.关键改进: min-max 学习可直接产生锐利样本而无需显式密度
attrs.医学适配: 推动 MR-CT 翻译、低剂量增强和合成数据
attrs.适用范围与证据: 历史基础；mode collapse、训练不稳和 hallucination 风险突出

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Pixel-wise L1/L2 and maximum-likelihood generative models averaged over uncertain modes, producing blurry textures.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pit a generator G against an adversarial discriminator D trained to distinguish real samples from synthesized ones.
attrs_en.关键改进: Implicit density learning via Jensen-Shannon divergence minimization yielding sharp, high-frequency visual samples.
attrs_en.医学适配: Catalyzed medical cross-modality synthesis (MR-to-CT), low-dose perceptual enhancement, and synthetic cohort augmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational generative paradigm; training instability, mode collapse, and anatomically unfaithful hallucinations pose severe clinical risks.

models.paper_title: Generative Adversarial Nets

models.title: pix2pix
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 以 U-Net 生成器保持逐像素空间对应，70×70 conditional PatchGAN 学局部真实感，并用配对 L1 锚定结构。
models.core_mech_en: Pairs a U-Net generator (preserving pixel-level spatial alignment) with a 70×70 conditional PatchGAN discriminator and paired L1 structural anchoring.
models.input_desc: 空间配准的成对源域图像 x 与目标域图像 y
models.input_en: Spatially co-registered paired source image x and target ground-truth image y
models.output_desc: 与 x 对齐的目标域预测 G(x)
models.output_en: Spatially aligned translated target-domain image G(x)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 纯 L1/L2 输出过平滑，普通 GAN 不保证输入输出对应
attrs.核心想法: 以输入为条件训练 PatchGAN，并以 L1 保持配对结构
attrs.关键改进: paired fidelity 与 learned local texture loss 结合，常用 U-Net generator
attrs.医学适配: 用于 paired 低剂量、PET、MR-CT 和骨抑制映射
attrs.适用范围与证据: 强 mapping 基线；不保证测量一致，可能生成逼真但错误结构

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure L1/L2 regression blurs high-frequency textures, while unconditional GANs do not preserve patient-specific spatial anatomy.
attrs_en.核心想法: Condition both U-Net generator and patch-level discriminator on the input image x while anchoring low-frequency structure via L1 loss.
attrs_en.关键改进: U-Net skip generator + 70×70 Markovian PatchGAN critic + λ||y − G(x)||_1 structural constraint.
attrs_en.医学适配: Workhorse baseline for paired low-dose-to-full-dose PET/CT, MR-to-synthetic-CT radiation planning, and virtual histological staining.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Strong paired image-translation baseline; remains an image-domain mapping without physical sensor consistency guarantees.

models.paper_title: Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks

models.title: CycleGAN
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 双生成器、双 PatchGAN 与 X→Y→X / Y→X→Y 两个 cycle L1 闭环，使不成对域转换可训练。
models.core_mech_en: Couples dual generators (G: X→Y, F: Y→X) and dual PatchGAN discriminators with forward and backward L1 cycle-consistency loops for unpaired translation.
models.input_desc: 两组不成对的域 X 与域 Y 图像
models.input_en: Two unpaired collections of images from source domain X and target domain Y
models.output_desc: X→Y 与 Y→X 两个方向的域转换图像
models.output_en: Bi-directional domain-translated images G(x) ∈ Y and F(y) ∈ X

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 医学跨模态病例常不成对，pix2pix 无法直接训练
attrs.核心想法: 用双向生成器、两个判别器和 cycle consistency 学无配对域转换
attrs.关键改进: cycle loss 缩小任意 domain mapping 的解空间
attrs.医学适配: 用于 MR-CT、MRI contrast 和 scanner harmonization
attrs.适用范围与证据: 探索与 style transfer 仍有用；cycle 不保证解剖或定量值保持

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Acquiring perfectly co-registered paired multi-modality scans (e.g., same-patient paired MR and CT) is often clinically infeasible.
attrs_en.核心想法: Constrain unpaired cross-domain mapping by requiring that translating X→Y and back Y→X recovers the original input image.
attrs_en.关键改进: Dual adversarial critics + forward/backward cycle-consistency L1 loss + identity mapping regularizer.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely used for unpaired MR-to-CT synthesis, stain normalization in pathology, and cross-vendor scanner style harmonization.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Useful for exploratory domain adaptation, but cycle consistency is under-constrained and can hallucinate or erase lesions when pathology prevalence differs across domains.

models.paper_title: Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation using Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks

models.title: DDPM
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 预设离散高斯前向链，加训练稳定的 epsilon/score 网络，再按学习到的随机逆链逐步采样。
models.core_mech_en: Defines a fixed discrete Markov Gaussian forward noising chain and trains a noise-prediction U-Net (ε_θ) across all noise scales for iterative reverse sampling.
models.input_desc: 训练时的干净样本 x0；生成时的高斯噪声 xT
models.input_en: Clean training image x_0 (during training); pure Gaussian noise x_T ~ N(0,I) (during sampling)
models.output_desc: 经 T 步随机逆扩散得到的样本 x0_hat
models.output_en: Sample x̂_0 synthesized via T iterative stochastic reverse denoising steps

attrs.上一代瓶颈: GAN min-max 训练不稳、mode coverage 差，VAE 高频模糊
attrs.核心想法: 通过逐步高斯加噪并训练网络在各噪声尺度预测噪声来生成数据
attrs.关键改进: 稳定的多噪声尺度监督回归与可解释逆扩散链
attrs.医学适配: 成为医学重建、生成、去噪和跨模态 diffusion 的基础
attrs.适用范围与证据: 生成建模基础设施；原始数百至千步采样不适合常规部署

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: GANs suffered from adversarial instability and mode dropping, while likelihood-based flows and VAEs struggled with sample sharpness.
attrs_en.核心想法: Destroy data structure gradually via a fixed Gaussian diffusion process and learn the reverse Markov transition via stable multi-scale L2 noise regression.
attrs_en.关键改进: Re-weighted ε-prediction objective + time-conditioned U-Net achieving stable optimization and high mode coverage.
attrs_en.医学适配: Foundational prior for medical image synthesis, counterfactual generation, denoising, and diffusion-based inverse problem solvers.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Core generative infrastructure; standard 1,000-step ancestral sampling is too slow for real-time clinical workflows without acceleration.

models.paper_title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models

models.title: DDIM
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 在相同 DDPM 训练边缘下采用隐式非 Markov、可确定性的跳步轨迹。
models.core_mech_en: Constructs non-Markovian, deterministic reverse sampling trajectories that share the exact same marginal training distributions as DDPM.
models.input_desc: 与 DDPM 相同目标训练的 epsilon 网络和初始噪声 xT
models.input_en: Pretrained DDPM noise-prediction network ε_θ and initial Gaussian noise x_T
models.output_desc: 少步确定性或可控随机性的生成样本 x0_hat
models.output_en: Sample x̂_0 generated in 10–50 deterministic (or tunable-stochasticity) subsequence steps

attrs.上一代瓶颈: DDPM 需要大量逐步逆扩散
attrs.核心想法: 在相同训练目标下构造 non-Markov、可确定性采样轨迹
attrs.关键改进: 无需重训即可大幅减少 time steps，并支持 deterministic ODE-like sampling
attrs.医学适配: 用于加速医学 diffusion reconstruction 与生成实验
attrs.适用范围与证据: 部署研究必需；大步长离散误差会先损害细小结构

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: DDPM required hundreds to thousands of sequential network evaluations, making inference prohibitively slow.
attrs_en.核心想法: Reformulate the forward process as non-Markovian while preserving marginal distributions p(x_t|x_0), enabling exact reuse of pretrained DDPM weights with strided step schedules.
attrs_en.关键改进: 10×–50× sampling acceleration without retraining + deterministic latent-to-image invertible mapping (DDIM inversion).
attrs_en.医学适配: Standard sampler for accelerating medical diffusion reconstruction, counterfactual editing, and latent interpolation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Essential deployment accelerator; overly coarse step strides first degrade fine anatomical vessels and micro-calcifications.

models.paper_title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models

models.title: Score-SDE
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 以连续 score field 同时定义 reverse-time SDE、predictor-corrector sampler 与同边缘的 probability-flow ODE。
models.core_mech_en: Unifies discrete diffusion and score matching into a continuous-time Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) with a corresponding deterministic Probability-Flow ODE.
models.input_desc: 数据样本 x(0)；生成时的先验噪声 x(T)
models.input_en: Continuous data sample x(0); prior noise distribution x(T) at terminal time T
models.output_desc: 经 reverse SDE 或 probability-flow ODE 得到的样本
models.output_en: Samples generated via Predictor-Corrector reverse SDE or exact likelihoods via Probability-Flow ODE

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 离散 diffusion 和 score matching 缺少统一连续框架
attrs.核心想法: 以连续时间 score network 统一 reverse SDE、probability-flow ODE 与采样器
attrs.关键改进: 反向 SDE、predictor-corrector 与同边缘分布的确定性 PF-ODE
attrs.医学适配: 为 MRI/CT posterior sampling 和 likelihood guidance 提供理论接口
attrs.适用范围与证据: 核心数学基础；posterior 与采样仍受 score/likelihood mismatch 影响

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: SMLD (score matching) and DDPM (diffusion) were developed as separate discrete heuristics lacking a unified continuous mathematical theory.
attrs_en.核心想法: Cast forward corruption as a continuous Itô SDE whose reverse-time SDE and deterministic PF-ODE depend solely on the time-dependent score ∇_x log p_t(x).
attrs_en.关键改进: Unified VE/VP/sub-VP SDE taxonomy + Predictor-Corrector (PC) samplers + exact log-likelihood computation + controllable inverse conditional sampling.
attrs_en.医学适配: Provides the rigorous continuous-time mathematical foundation for MRI/CT score-based posterior reconstruction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational mathematical framework; practical medical inverse solving still depends on accurate likelihood score approximations.

models.paper_title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations

models.title: Latent Diffusion
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 先以 autoencoder 压缩图像，再在 latent grid 上运行可 cross-attention 条件化的 diffusion。
models.core_mech_en: Perceptually compresses high-resolution images into a lower-dimensional spatial latent grid via a VQ/KL autoencoder before running cross-attention-conditioned diffusion.
models.input_desc: 图像 x 与可选条件 c；生成时为 latent 高斯噪声 zT
models.input_en: High-resolution image x (encoded to z_0 = E(x)) + optional multimodal conditioning c (text, mask, layout)
models.output_desc: 由解码器还原的高分辨率图像 x_hat
models.output_en: High-resolution synthesized image x̂ = D(ẑ_0) decoded from denoised latent grid

attrs.上一代瓶颈: pixel-space diffusion 在高分辨率和 3D 上计算过重
attrs.核心想法: 先用 autoencoder 压缩图像，再在 latent grid 上扩散并以 cross-attention 条件化
attrs.关键改进: 用较小空间网格建模语义，支持更大 backbone 与多模态条件
attrs.医学适配: 用于医学合成、跨模态 translation 和高分辨生成
attrs.适用范围与证据: 现实的大模型路线；autoencoder ceiling 可能丢微钙化、小血管和定量强度

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Pixel-space diffusion scaled poorly in compute and VRAM on high-resolution 2D images and 3D medical volumes.
attrs_en.核心想法: Separate perceptual high-frequency compression (autoencoder) from semantic generative modeling (diffusion U-Net in latent space) with cross-attention conditioning.
attrs_en.关键改进: Dramatic spatial token reduction (e.g., 8× downsampling per axis) + flexible cross-attention conditioning mechanism.
attrs_en.医学适配: Dominant architecture for high-resolution 2D/3D medical image synthesis, report-to-image generation, and synthetic data augmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Pragmatic scaling route; the frozen first-stage autoencoder sets an upper bound on fidelity and can bottleneck tiny micro-lesions or quantitative HU values.

models.paper_title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models

models.title: DDRM
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 在退化算子 SVD 基中把预训练 diffusion prior 与线性观测条件分量逐时间步耦合。
models.core_mech_en: Couples an unconditional pretrained diffusion prior with a linear forward operator y = Hx + z by running conditional reverse diffusion in the SVD spectral domain of H.
models.input_desc: 线性退化测量 y=A x+n、已知 A 及预训练无条件 diffusion prior
models.input_en: Linearly degraded measurement y = Hx + z, known SVD of operator H, and an unconditional pretrained diffusion model
models.output_desc: 满足线性测量约束的恢复样本 x_hat
models.output_en: Restored image x̂ consistent with both linear measurements y and the pretrained diffusion prior

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 每种线性退化都需重新训练专用模型
attrs.核心想法: 利用线性退化算子 A 的 SVD 构造 diffusion restoration posterior
attrs.关键改进: 将无条件 diffusion prior 与已知线性 forward model 解耦
attrs.医学适配: 同一 prior 可研究 MRI、去模糊、超分辨和部分 CT 线性逆问题
attrs.适用范围与证据: inverse solver 重要节点；大规模 CT 的 SVD 和非线性 likelihood 不便

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Supervised restoration required retraining a separate model whenever the degradation operator, blur kernel, or undersampling mask changed.
attrs_en.核心想法: Transform the reverse diffusion process into the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) basis of H, conditioning spectral coefficients directly on observed measurements and noise level.
attrs_en.关键改进: Zero-shot plug-and-play linear inverse solver requiring only 20 DDIM-style steps and zero task-specific retraining.
attrs_en.医学适配: Applicable to super-resolution, deblurring, inpainting, and compressed sensing MRI where the forward operator admits tractable spectral decomposition.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Important zero-shot inverse solver milestone; computing explicit full SVD is intractable for large 3D cone-beam CT or non-linear forward operators.

models.paper_title: Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models

models.title: DPS
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 在每个 diffusion 逆时间步，把预训练先验 score 与经 x0 估计反传的测量 likelihood gradient 相加。
models.core_mech_en: Approximates intractable time-dependent measurement likelihood scores ∇_{x_t} log p_t(y|x_t) via backpropagation through the Tweedie posterior mean estimate x̂_0(x_t).
models.input_desc: 噪声测量 y、可微前向模型 A 与预训练 diffusion score prior
models.input_en: Corrupted measurement y, general differentiable forward operator A(·), and pretrained unconditional score network s_θ
models.output_desc: 近似后验样本 x_hat ~ p(x|y)
models.output_en: Posterior sample x̂ ~ p(x|y) satisfying noisy linear or non-linear measurement constraints

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 早期 diffusion inverse 方法难处理 noisy 或 nonlinear operators
attrs.核心想法: 把 learned score prior 与可微 measurement likelihood gradient 结合
attrs.关键改进: 通过 x0 估计近似 posterior score guidance，支持通用 differentiable A
attrs.医学适配: 可用于 MRI、CT、PET 等测量模型耦合的 posterior sampling
attrs.适用范围与证据: 研究主干；guidance 调参、NFE 和 posterior calibration 仍是限制

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Projection-based diffusion solvers failed under heavy measurement noise or non-linear operators without closed-form SVD.
attrs_en.核心想法: Approximate p(y|x_t) ≈ p(y | x̂_0(x_t)) using Tweedie's formula and take a gradient step ∇_{x_t} ||y − A(x̂_0(x_t))||² at every reverse diffusion step.
attrs_en.关键改进: Handles general noisy linear and non-linear differentiable forward operators without SVD or task-specific retraining.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely used in accelerated multi-coil MRI, sparse-view CT, phase retrieval, and PET posterior sampling research.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Core diffusion inverse baseline; requires backpropagation through the score network at every step (high memory/latency) and sensitive guidance-scale tuning.

models.paper_title: Diffusion Posterior Sampling for General Noisy Inverse Problems

models.title: DiffusionMBIR
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 把预训练 2D diffusion slice prior 嵌入 3D MBIR/data-consistency 外循环，并显式加跨切片约束。
models.core_mech_en: Embeds a pretrained 2D slice diffusion score prior into an alternating 3D Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction (MBIR) loop with explicit z-axis total variation regularization.
models.input_desc: 3D 测量 y、体成像算子 A/A* 与预训练 2D diffusion prior
models.input_en: 3D tomographic measurements y, 3D forward/adjoint operators A/A*, and a pretrained 2D axial diffusion model
models.output_desc: 数据一致且具跨切片约束的 3D 体 x_hat
models.output_en: Volumetric 3D reconstruction x̂ maintaining 3D measurement fidelity and inter-slice smoothness

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 训练真正 3D diffusion 的数据与显存成本很高
attrs.核心想法: 以预训练 2D diffusion prior 配合 3D measurement fidelity/MBIR
attrs.关键改进: 跨切片/体积一致性正则把 2D prior 复用于 3D inverse tasks
attrs.医学适配: 用于 sparse/limited-angle CT 与 compressed-sensing MRI
attrs.适用范围与证据: 有代表性的 3D 折中；2D slice prior 不等于真实 3D anatomy

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Training native whole-volume high-resolution 3D diffusion models is bottlenecked by scarce 3D cohorts and extreme GPU memory.
attrs_en.核心想法: Apply a data-efficient pretrained 2D axial score prior slice-by-slice while enforcing 3D physical data consistency and z-axis TV continuity in an outer splitting loop.
attrs_en.关键改进: Pragmatically bridges 2D generative score priors to 3D cone-beam/helical CT and 3D MRI reconstruction without 3D diffusion training.
attrs_en.医学适配: Used for sparse-view CT, limited-angle CT, and volumetric compressed-sensing reconstruction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Practical 2D-to-3D reconstruction compromise; slice-wise 2D priors plus z-TV still cannot fully capture complex 3D non-local anatomical priors.

models.paper_title: Solving 3D Inverse Problems using Pre-trained 2D Diffusion Models

models.title: Flow Matching
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 在已知 probability path 上回归 velocity（而非 score），再直接积分神经 ODE 完成分布运输。
models.core_mech_en: Trains continuous normalizing flows without ODE simulation by directly regressing the marginal vector field u_t(x) along conditional probability paths.
models.input_desc: 源分布样本 x0（通常高斯噪声）与数据样本 x1
models.input_en: Source prior sample x_0 ~ p_0 and target data sample x_1 ~ p_1 interpolated along a conditional path x_t
models.output_desc: 沿学习 ODE 从源分布运输得到的生成样本
models.output_en: Samples generated by integrating the learned velocity field dx/dt = v_θ(x_t, t) from t=0 to t=1

attrs.上一代瓶颈: normalizing flow 受可逆层和 Jacobian 限制，diffusion 采样步骤多
attrs.核心想法: 在选定概率路径上回归条件 velocity field，再解 ODE 从 source transport 到 data
attrs.关键改进: 普通 U-Net/DiT 即可训练，无需 exact invertibility；直路径可少步积分
attrs.医学适配: 启发 operator-conditioned 医学 inverse solver 与少步跨模态生成
attrs.适用范围与证据: 高速发展；医学 coupling、likelihood 耦合与临床 superiority 尚未解决

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Continuous Normalizing Flows required costly backpropagation through ODE solvers, while diffusion models relied on curved stochastic paths.
attrs_en.核心想法: Construct conditional probability paths (e.g., optimal transport straight lines) with closed-form conditional velocities and train v_θ via simple L2 regression.
attrs_en.关键改进: Simulation-free training with unconstrained U-Net/DiT backbones + straight optimal-transport paths enabling fast few-step ODE integration.
attrs_en.医学适配: Rapidly adopted for fast medical image synthesis, cross-modality translation, and operator-conditioned inverse reconstruction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: High-momentum generative paradigm; clinical superiority and calibrated posterior uncertainty over unrolled/diffusion baselines remain open research.

models.paper_title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling

models.title: Rectified Flow
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 以直线端点路径训练 velocity，并通过 reflow 重新耦合端点以进一步拉直 ODE 轨迹。
models.core_mech_en: Learns an ODE velocity field along straight linear interpolations x_t = (1−t)x_0 + t x_1 and iteratively straightens trajectories via reflow recoupling.
models.input_desc: 源噪声 z0 与目标数据 x1 的 coupling
models.input_en: Coupled pairs (x_0, x_1) from source distribution π_0 and target distribution π_1
models.output_desc: 沿近直线 ODE 少步运输得到的样本 x_hat
models.output_en: Nearly straight-line ODE transport trajectories enabling high-fidelity 1-to-few-step Euler generation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 弯曲生成轨迹需要更多 ODE steps 才能准确积分
attrs.核心想法: 从 source-target coupling 学直线速度场，并用 reflow 进一步拉直轨迹
attrs.关键改进: 优化 trajectory straightness，降低 coarse-step integration error
attrs.医学适配: 为少步医学生成与 translation 提供速度路线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 少步潜力真实；高频和病灶 fidelity、uncertainty 仍需专门验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Curved ODE transport trajectories accumulate high discretization error under large Euler step sizes.
attrs_en.核心想法: Drive transport paths as close to straight lines as possible by regressing the constant displacement (x_1 − x_0) and iteratively re-pairing (z_0, ẑ_1) via reflow.
attrs_en.关键改进: Simple ODE velocity formulation + Reflow procedure that provably reduces transport cost and straightens trajectories for 1-step distillation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Provides a principled mathematical route for real-time few-step medical domain translation and generative modeling.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Genuine algorithmic speed advantage; reflow distillation can subtly smooth high-frequency diagnostic textures if not audited.

models.paper_title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow

models.title: Consistency Models
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 学习沿 PF-ODE 轨迹不变的 endpoint map，使任意噪声尺度可直接一步映射到 clean sample。
models.core_mech_en: Learns a self-consistent function f_θ(x_t, t) = x_ε that maps any point along a Probability-Flow ODE trajectory directly to its clean origin in a single step.
models.input_desc: 噪声状态 x_t；蒸馏模式下还需预训练 diffusion score teacher
models.input_en: Noisy state x_t along a PF-ODE trajectory (distilled from a pretrained score model or trained standalone)
models.output_desc: 一次或少数几次函数调用得到的 clean sample
models.output_en: One-step or few-step clean sample estimate x̂_0

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 高质量 diffusion 需要许多 solver steps
attrs.核心想法: 把同一 probability-flow ODE 轨迹上的任意点直接映射到相同 clean endpoint
attrs.关键改进: 可由预训练 diffusion 蒸馏或独立训练，实现 one/few-step generation
attrs.医学适配: 对实时医学重建和交互生成有直接吸引力
attrs.适用范围与证据: 速度方向重要；医学 raw-data benchmark 和校准证据不足

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Even accelerated ODE/DDIM samplers required 10–50 sequential neural evaluations, limiting real-time intraoperative or streaming use.
attrs_en.核心想法: Enforce that any two adjacent points on the same PF-ODE trajectory map to the exact same clean endpoint under an EMA target network.
attrs_en.关键改进: Supports single-step generation (1 NFE) as well as zero-shot multi-step iterative refinement trading compute for quality.
attrs_en.医学适配: Highly attractive for real-time medical reconstruction, interactive synthesis, and low-latency clinical workflows.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Important speed frontier; raw-data medical inverse benchmarks and quantitative bias audits at 1–2 NFEs remain limited.

models.paper_title: Consistency Models

models.title: DiT
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.core_mech: 把 noisy latent patch 化，以 adaLN-Zero 条件化的 Transformer blocks 作为 diffusion score/velocity backbone。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces the convolutional U-Net backbone in Latent Diffusion with an isotropic Vision Transformer over latent patches conditioned via Adaptive LayerNorm-Zero (adaLN-Zero).
models.input_desc: 加噪 latent 图像 z_t、时间 t 与可选类别/条件 c
models.input_en: Noisy latent tensor z_t, diffusion timestep t, and conditioning embedding c
models.output_desc: epsilon/score 参数与可选方差预测，经逆扩散得到并解码的图像
models.output_en: Predicted noise ε_θ, diagonal covariance Σ_θ, or velocity v_θ on the latent token grid

attrs.上一代瓶颈: U-Net diffusion 的扩展规律和多模态 token 接口有限
attrs.核心想法: 将 latent image patch 化，用 Transformer blocks 与 adaptive LayerNorm 做 diffusion backbone
attrs.关键改进: 以模型规模和计算量系统提升生成质量，条件以 adaLN 注入
attrs.医学适配: 适合医学多模态、3D patch 和 report/image cross-attention 研究
attrs.适用范围与证据: 生成 backbone 重要演化；3D token、数据规模和微小结构仍是风险

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Convolutional U-Net inductive biases plateaued under massive compute scaling and lacked a uniform token interface across modalities.
attrs_en.核心想法: Tokenize latent feature maps into patches and process them through standard Transformer blocks modulated by scale/shift/gate parameters regressed from (t, c).
attrs_en.关键改进: adaLN-Zero initialization (initializing each residual block as exact identity) + predictable Gflops scaling laws improving FID monotonically with compute.
attrs_en.医学适配: Backbone of choice for scalable 3D volumetric latent diffusion, spatio-temporal video generation, and multimodal medical synthesis.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Major generative backbone shift; requires well-trained 3D/2D VAEs and large training cohorts to justify Transformer compute.

models.paper_title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers

models.title: DDNM
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.archetype: 扩散先验中的范围空间替换与零空间生成
models.core_mech: DDNM 用 A†y 固定 range-space 信息，只让 diffusion denoiser 生成 null-space 分量。
models.core_mech_en: Decomposes reverse diffusion intermediate estimates x̂_{0|t} via the Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse A† into a fixed measurement range-space component A†y and a generated null-space component (I − A†A)x̂_{0|t}.
models.input_desc: 线性退化测量 y=Ax+n、已知 A 及伪逆 A†、预训练无条件扩散模型
models.input_en: Linear measurement y = Ax + n, known operator A with pseudoinverse A†, and a pretrained unconditional diffusion model
models.output_desc: 满足或近似满足测量约束的恢复图像样本
models.output_en: Zero-shot restored image satisfying A x̂ = y while filling null-space details via the diffusion prior

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 通用扩散先验直接采样不满足观测，任务专用训练成本高
attrs.核心想法: 把扩散采样分解为满足线性测量的范围空间部分与可生成的零空间部分
attrs.关键改进: 利用伪逆投影在每步注入数据一致性，实现零样本多退化恢复
attrs.医学适配: 可用于 MRI、CT、去模糊和缺失数据的扩散逆问题研究
attrs.适用范围与证据: 零样本基线重要；依赖已知线性算子与准确噪声模型

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Unconditional diffusion samples violate measurement constraints, whereas backpropagating likelihood gradients through U-Nets (DPS) is memory-heavy.
attrs_en.核心想法: Directly replace the range-space component of each step's denoised estimate x̂_{0|t} with A†y, leaving the diffusion model to synthesize only the null-space component.
attrs_en.关键改进: Backpropagation-free zero-shot linear inverse solver with a noise-aware extension (DDNM+) handling additive measurement noise.
attrs_en.医学适配: Used in zero-shot MRI reconstruction, sparse CT restoration, super-resolution, and inpainting.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Clean mathematical decomposition of range vs. null space; highlights directly that null-space anatomy is synthesized purely by the prior.

models.paper_title: Zero-Shot Image Restoration Using Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Model

models.title: RealNVP
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.archetype: 仿射 coupling 与多尺度 split 的精确似然 normalizing flow
models.core_mech: RealNVP 以三角 Jacobian 的 affine coupling 获得同时精确可逆、可采样且可算 log-likelihood 的映射。
models.core_mech_en: Constructs an exactly invertible normalizing flow using stacked affine coupling layers whose triangular Jacobians permit O(D) log-determinant and exact likelihood evaluation.
models.input_desc: 连续化图像 x
models.input_en: Continuous-valued image or feature vector x
models.output_desc: 潜变量 z、精确 log-likelihood，或由 z 反演生成的图像
models.output_en: Latent variable z = f(x), exact log-density log p_X(x), or exact inverse sample x = f^{-1}(z)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 一般生成网络缺精确似然，早期 flow 的可扩展性和可逆设计有限
attrs.核心想法: 用仿射 coupling layers 构造可逆网络并精确计算 log-determinant
attrs.关键改进: 通过三角 Jacobian 实现高效双向变换、采样与精确密度估计
attrs.医学适配: 用于医学图像生成、异常检测和可逆重建先验
attrs.适用范围与证据: normalizing flow 基础；coupling 表达受限且高维似然未必对应临床异常

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: GANs and VAEs lacked exact tractable likelihood evaluation, while autoregressive density models were slow to sample.
attrs_en.核心想法: Split dimensions in each coupling layer so half remain unchanged while scaling and translating the other half via unconstrained neural networks s(·), t(·).
attrs_en.关键改进: Triangular Jacobian with closed-form sum-of-logs determinant + exact single-pass forward density estimation and inverse sampling.
attrs_en.医学适配: Applied to invertible medical image priors, exact-likelihood out-of-distribution detection, and bijective registration.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational normalizing flow; coupling layers require deep stacking for expressivity and raw pixel likelihoods often mis-score semantic OOD anomalies.

models.paper_title: Density Estimation Using Real NVP

models.title: Glow
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.archetype: ActNorm—可逆 1×1 卷积—仿射 coupling 的多尺度 flow
models.core_mech: Glow 在 RealNVP coupling 上加入数据依赖 ActNorm 和可学习可逆 1×1 通道卷积。
models.core_mech_en: Enhances multi-scale affine coupling flows with activation normalization (ActNorm) and learnable invertible 1×1 channel convolutions parameterized via LU decomposition.
models.input_desc: 连续化图像
models.input_en: Continuous-valued image x
models.output_desc: 精确似然和层级潜变量，或由潜变量反演的生成图像
models.output_en: Hierarchical latent variables z, exact log-likelihood log p(x), and exact latent-to-image synthesis

attrs.上一代瓶颈: RealNVP 固定通道置换限制特征混合，深层训练初始化不稳
attrs.核心想法: 在多尺度 flow 中用 actnorm、可逆 1×1 卷积和仿射 coupling 学习精确似然
attrs.关键改进: 可学习可逆通道混合与数据依赖归一化提升生成质量
attrs.医学适配: 常作医学 normalizing-flow 生成和异常检测结构基础
attrs.适用范围与证据: 经典 flow 架构；内存与似然语义问题限制临床直接应用

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Fixed channel permutations in RealNVP restricted cross-channel mixing, and small-batch flow training suffered from activation instability.
attrs_en.核心想法: Replace fixed channel reversals with a learnable invertible 1×1 convolution and stabilize deep flow training via data-dependent ActNorm.
attrs_en.关键改进: ActNorm (scale/bias per channel) + LU-factored invertible 1×1 convolution reducing log-det cost from O(C³) to O(C).
attrs_en.医学适配: Used as an exact-likelihood generative prior for medical inverse problems and unsupervised brain MRI anomaly scoring.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Classic flow milestone; bijective dimensionality preservation makes high-resolution 3D flows memory-intensive compared to latent diffusion.

models.paper_title: Glow: Generative Flow with Invertible 1×1 Convolutions

models.title: PFGM++
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.archetype: 增广空间 Poisson 电场与 diffusion 连续统一的生成 flow
models.core_mech: PFGM++ 用可调增广维度 D 的 Poisson 电场统一 PFGM 与 diffusion，而不是固定高斯前向噪声过程。
models.core_mech_en: Embeds N-dimensional data on the z=0 hyperplane of an N+D augmented space and learns the high-dimensional Poisson electric field lines, unifying PFGM (D=1) and Diffusion (D→∞).
models.input_desc: 训练数据 x∈R^N；采样时为 N+D 维简单先验状态
models.input_en: Training data x ∈ R^N embedded in R^{N+D}; hemispherical prior samples at large radius r_max during generation
models.output_desc: 沿学习电场 ODE 流回数据超平面的生成样本
models.output_en: Samples generated by integrating the learned augmented electric field ODE back to the z=0 hyperplane

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 原始 PFGM 与 diffusion 的关系和可扩展调节机制不清
attrs.核心想法: 在增广空间用高维电场/Poisson flow 连接数据分布与简单先验
attrs.关键改进: 以增广维度 D 连续统一 Poisson flow 与 diffusion，并改善鲁棒性和采样
attrs.医学适配: 提供医学生成与逆问题的新型 score/flow 先验选择
attrs.适用范围与证据: 有理论吸引力但医学实证有限；仍需与强 diffusion 公平比较

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Diffusion models rely on Gaussian kernels with thin tails, whereas original PFGM (D=1) was difficult to scale to large conditional architectures.
attrs_en.核心想法: Generalize the augmented electrostatic dimension from D=1 to arbitrary D, proving that as D→∞ and r=σ√D, the Poisson kernel converges to Gaussian diffusion.
attrs_en.关键改进: Provides a tunable robustness–rigidity knob D (e.g., D=64 or 2048) that improves ODE integration stability and error tolerance over standard EDM diffusion.
attrs_en.医学适配: Evaluated on low-dose CT denoising and medical image generation as a more perturbation-robust drop-in alternative to score models.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Theoretically elegant unification of electrostatic flows and diffusion; clinical adoption remains at an early research stage.

models.paper_title: PFGM++: Unlocking the Potential of Physics-Inspired Generative Models

models.title: SiT
models.family_label: 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency
models.archetype: stochastic interpolant 上的可扩展 Transformer flow/diffusion
models.core_mech: SiT 将 DiT 放入 stochastic interpolant 框架，用统一模型显式比较 velocity、score 和 diffusion 参数化。
models.core_mech_en: Places the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone inside a continuous-time Stochastic Interpolant framework to systematically decouple interpolation schedules, model targets, and samplers.
models.input_desc: 数据样本 x0、噪声 ε、连续时间 t 和可选类别条件
models.input_en: Data sample x_0 (or latent), Gaussian noise ε, continuous time t ∈ [0,1], and conditioning label c
models.output_desc: 学习到的 velocity/score/noise 场及 ODE/SDE 生成样本
models.output_en: Samples generated via configurable deterministic ODE or stochastic SDE integrators from the same SiT backbone

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 扩散与流匹配实现分散，目标和采样路径的关系难系统比较
attrs.核心想法: 以 stochastic interpolants 统一 diffusion 与 flow objectives，并用 Transformer 扩展生成
attrs.关键改进: 在统一连续时间框架中选择插值、预测参数化和损失权重
attrs.医学适配: 适合比较医学 latent/3D diffusion 与 flow matching 的训练设计
attrs.适用范围与证据: 生成建模重要统一视角；医学保真和逆问题证据仍早期

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Comparisons between diffusion and flow matching conflated backbone architecture (U-Net vs. DiT), noise schedules, and ODE vs. SDE sampling.
attrs_en.核心想法: Use the Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT) to modularly ablate path interpolants (linear vs. trig), prediction targets (velocity vs. score), and diffusion coefficients.
attrs_en.关键改进: Demonstrates that linear stochastic interpolants with velocity prediction and tunable SDE diffusion coefficients consistently outperform rigid DDPM schedules.
attrs_en.医学适配: Provides a clean modern recipe for training 2D/3D medical latent transformers across both ODE flow and SDE diffusion regimes.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Important unifying generative framework; medical inverse-problem conditioning and quantitative audits remain active extensions.

models.paper_title: SiT: Exploring Flow and Diffusion-Based Generative Models with Scalable Interpolant Transformers

models.title: FBPConvNet
models.family_label: 物理约束重建：从后处理到展开优化与测量一致性
models.core_mech: 解析 FBP 与单次残差 U-Net 串联，而非端到端替代投影算子或进行 unrolled data consistency。
models.core_mech_en: Cascades analytical Filtered Backprojection (FBP) with a multi-scale residual U-Net in the image domain to remove sparse-view streaking artifacts.
models.input_desc: 稀疏视角 CT 投影 y（sinogram）与已知扫描几何
models.input_en: Sparse-view CT sinogram measurements y with known acquisition geometry
models.output_desc: 伪影抑制后的 CT 图像 x_hat
models.output_en: Artifact-suppressed CT image x̂ = x_FBP + R_θ(x_FBP)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 解析稀疏 CT 重建存在条纹，而直接端到端学习难扩展
attrs.核心想法: 先做解析 FBP，再用 residual U-Net/CNN 去除稀疏视角伪影
attrs.关键改进: 保留快速成熟的 FBP，并只学习 image-domain artifact residual
attrs.医学适配: 成为 sparse-view CT 极强 post-processing 基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 历史与实用价值高；推理后无 projection data consistency

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Analytical FBP suffers from severe streaking under sparse views, while traditional iterative MBIR takes minutes to hours per volume.
attrs_en.核心想法: Exploit the fact that normal-operator streaking artifacts in 2D CT have a translational convolutional structure well matched to a multi-scale residual U-Net.
attrs_en.关键改进: Fast analytical FBP inversion + residual U-Net learning the difference between streaked FBP and full-view ground truth.
attrs_en.医学适配: Canonical, fast image-domain post-processing baseline for sparse-view and low-dose CT reconstruction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: High practical speed and historical impact, but enforces zero projection-domain data consistency at inference—risking hallucinated or smoothed subtle lesions.

models.paper_title: Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Inverse Problems in Imaging

models.title: Learned Primal-Dual
models.family_label: 物理约束重建：从后处理到展开优化与测量一致性
models.core_mech: 同时学习 measurement-domain dual 与 image-domain primal 更新，并在每个 unrolled stage 显式调用 A 和 A*。
models.core_mech_en: Unrolls primal–dual proximal optimization into K stages of paired measurement-domain (dual) and image-domain (primal) residual CNNs calling A and A* at every stage.
models.input_desc: 测量 y、前向算子 A 与伴随算子 A*
models.input_en: Raw tomographic measurements y, forward projection operator A, and adjoint backprojection operator A*
models.output_desc: K 级展开后的图像域 primal 重建 x_hat
models.output_en: Reconstructed image x^{(K)} after K unrolled primal–dual iterations

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 仅在图像域学习 proximal 难利用 sinogram/k-space 结构
attrs.核心想法: 在展开迭代中同时学习 measurement-domain dual 与 image-domain primal 更新
attrs.关键改进: 每个 stage 显式调用 A 与 A*，保留 measurement residual
attrs.医学适配: 在 CT 上建立网络作为可解释优化算法的范式
attrs.适用范围与证据: 仍值得复现；3D projector、operator mismatch 与内存是限制

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Image-domain post-processing discards sinogram residuals, while hand-crafted TV primal–dual algorithms require ratusan iterations and produce patchy cartoons.
attrs_en.核心想法: Replace both the dual proximal operator in measurement space and the primal proximal operator in image space with small multi-channel residual CNNs across K≈10 stages.
attrs_en.关键改进: Explicitly embeds forward operator A and adjoint A* inside every unrolled layer with multi-channel memory states in both primal and dual spaces.
attrs_en.医学适配: Established the gold-standard paradigm for physics-informed unrolled CT and tomographic reconstruction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Strong measurement-consistent baseline; requires storing K stages of 2D/3D activations during backpropagation and accurate projector calibration.

models.paper_title: Learned Primal-Dual Reconstruction

models.title: Variational Network
models.family_label: 物理约束重建：从后处理到展开优化与测量一致性
models.core_mech: 把多线圈 MRI 的变分梯度下降展开，并联合学习卷积滤波器、势函数与每级更新权重。
models.core_mech_en: Unrolls K steps of gradient descent on a generalized Fields-of-Experts variational energy for multi-coil MRI, jointly learning convolutional filters, non-linear potentials, and data weights.
models.input_desc: 欠采样多线圈 k-space y、采样掩膜 P 与线圈灵敏度 S
models.input_en: Undersampled multi-coil k-space data y, sampling mask P, and pre-estimated coil sensitivity maps S
models.output_desc: K 次变分更新后的复数 MRI 图像 x_hat
