models.output_en: Complex-valued reconstructed MRI image x^{(K)} after K unrolled variational steps

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 手工 regularizer 和 potential 表达能力有限
attrs.核心想法: 展开变分梯度下降，学习滤波器、势函数并显式使用多线圈 forward model
attrs.关键改进: 端到端学习每步 variational update 与数据项
attrs.医学适配: 在 accelerated MRI 中已有临床工作流速度和质量证据
attrs.适用范围与证据: unrolled MRI 的核心祖型；序列与厂商迁移仍有限

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Compressed-sensing MRI with fixed wavelet/TV regularizers reconstructed slowly and introduced staircasing or over-smoothing.
attrs_en.核心想法: Unfold K=10 gradient descent steps of a variational energy combining learned convolutional filter-bank potentials with exact multi-coil k-space data consistency.
attrs_en.关键改进: End-to-end training of stage-specific filter kernels, spline activation derivatives (potentials), and data-consistency step weights.
attrs_en.医学适配: First unrolled MRI reconstruction architecture validated in clinical reader studies to achieve 4× accelerated knee MRI acquisition.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational clinical unrolled MRI milestone; shallow Fields-of-Experts regularizers were later deepened into U-Net cascades in E2E-VarNet.

models.paper_title: Learning a Variational Network for Reconstruction of Accelerated MRI Data

models.title: MoDL
models.family_label: 物理约束重建：从后处理到展开优化与测量一致性
models.core_mech: 共享 CNN prior 与可微共轭梯度 data-consistency 子问题交替展开。
models.core_mech_en: Alternates a weight-shared multi-layer CNN denoiser prior D_θ with a differentiable numerical Conjugate Gradient (CG) solver enforcing exact data consistency (A*A + λI)^{-1}.
models.input_desc: 测量 y、已知前向算子 A 与伴随 A*
models.input_en: Undersampled multi-coil k-space measurements b, forward operator A (incorporating coil maps + FFT + mask), and adjoint A*
models.output_desc: K 次共享权重迭代后的重建 x_hat
models.output_en: Reconstructed MRI image x_K after K weight-shared alternating minimization stages

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 各展开 stage 独立参数导致模型大且数据需求高
attrs.核心想法: 共享 CNN denoiser，并用有限次共轭梯度近似求解每步 data-consistency 子问题
attrs.关键改进: 跨迭代共享 learned prior，加 A* A 线性系统的 CG 更新
attrs.医学适配: 成为多线圈 MRI 和 CT model-based deep learning 强基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级方法；依赖 operator/coil maps 且迭代计算较重

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Gradient-step unrolled networks converged slowly for complex multi-coil forward operators A whose normal operator A*A is not diagonally invertible.
attrs_en.核心想法: Share a single CNN denoiser across all K unrolled stages to reduce parameters, and solve the quadratic data-consistency sub-problem accurately via internal CG iterations.
attrs_en.关键改进: Weight-shared plug-and-play regularizer + backpropagation through numerical Conjugate Gradient steps handling arbitrary linear operators A.
attrs_en.医学适配: Core infrastructure baseline for multi-coil parallel MRI, dynamic cardiac MRI, and physics-based CT reconstruction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Mandatory unrolled baseline; depends on accurate coil sensitivity maps and incurs inner-loop CG compute cost.

models.paper_title: MoDL: Model-Based Deep Learning Architecture for Inverse Problems

models.title: VarNet
models.family_label: 物理约束重建：从后处理到展开优化与测量一致性
models.core_mech: 灵敏度估计网络加多级 k-space variational cascades，将图像正则与采样点 DC 工程化为统一流程。
models.core_mech_en: End-to-End Variational Network combining a joint U-Net coil sensitivity estimation module (SME) with K k-space variational cascades using U-Net image regularizers.
models.input_desc: 欠采样多线圈 k-space y 与采样掩膜 M
models.input_en: Raw undersampled multi-coil k-space y and Cartesian undersampling mask M (including auto-calibration lines)
models.output_desc: 灵敏度组合后的 MRI 幅度图 x_hat
models.output_en: Root-sum-of-squares or coil-combined MRI magnitude image x̂

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 多线圈 benchmark、coil handling 和训练流程碎片化
attrs.核心想法: 多级 learned regularizer 与 k-space data consistency 交替，并估计 coil sensitivity maps
attrs.关键改进: 把 variational cascade 工程化到 fastMRI 原始 k-space 标准评测
attrs.医学适配: 形成公开 MRI 重建基线；同类变分/展开式 AI reconstruction 另有前瞻膝 MRI 诊断等效证据
attrs.适用范围与证据: 长期价值已证明；前瞻证据不等同于公开 VarNet 本身，且显存、采样 mask 和厂商域移位仍需验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Prior unrolled MRI methods depended on external offline ESPIRiT coil maps that broke down under narrow calibration regions or motion.
attrs_en.核心想法: Estimate smooth coil sensitivity maps end-to-end from low-frequency ACS k-space via a dedicated U-Net, feeding directly into K k-space variational U-Net cascades.
attrs_en.关键改进: Self-contained raw-k-space-to-image pipeline standardized on the public fastMRI multi-coil benchmark.
attrs_en.医学适配: De facto public benchmark champion and baseline for accelerated multi-coil knee and brain MRI reconstruction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Proven long-term value; high GPU memory during unrolled training and sensitivity to out-of-distribution k-space sampling patterns remain key considerations.

models.paper_title: End-to-End Variational Networks for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction

models.title: AUTOMAP
models.family_label: 物理约束重建：从后处理到展开优化与测量一致性
models.archetype: 测量域到图像域的全连接流形域变换
models.core_mech: AUTOMAP 的标志是大规模全连接层直接承担 domain transform，而非先做 FBP/IFFT 再用 CNN 后处理。
models.core_mech_en: Learns the sensor-to-image domain transform directly via large fully connected layers mapping flattened raw measurements to an image grid followed by sparse convolutional refinement.
models.input_desc: MRI k-space、CT 投影等序列化测量向量
models.input_en: Flattened raw sensor measurement vector (e.g., k-space samples or Radon projections)
models.output_desc: 重建图像
models.output_en: Reconstructed spatial-domain image

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 传统重建需手工推导逆算子且难联合优化所有处理步骤
attrs.核心想法: 以全连接域变换层加卷积网络端到端学习测量域到图像域映射
attrs.关键改进: 首次展示跨 MRI、CT 等成像问题直接学习重建映射的统一思路
attrs.医学适配: 奠定端到端医学重建范式并推动 learned reconstruction
attrs.适用范围与证据: 历史里程碑；全连接层参数巨大、算子迁移和物理一致性较弱

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Conventional pipelines treated Fourier/Radon inversion as fixed analytical steps separate from downstream denoising.
attrs_en.核心想法: Frame tomographic reconstruction as a data-driven manifold mapping between sensor and image domains parameterized by dense fully connected layers.
attrs_en.关键改进: Unified end-to-end neural domain transformation across arbitrary k-space trajectories and projection geometries on small grids.
attrs_en.医学适配: Historically provocative demonstration of learned sensor-to-image inversion in low-resolution MRI and PET.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Historical curiosity rather than a scalable baseline: O(N⁴) fully connected parameters cannot scale to clinical 512²/3D grids and discard known Fourier/Radon physics.

models.paper_title: Image Reconstruction by Domain-Transform Manifold Learning

models.title: LEARN
models.family_label: 物理约束重建：从后处理到展开优化与测量一致性
models.archetype: CT 数据保真梯度与迭代特异 CNN 正则梯度的展开网络
models.fig_badge: Figure 2 · PDF p.Official PMC Figure 2 full-size asset
models.core_mech: LEARN 每个展开阶段并行计算 CT 数据梯度和 learned experts CNN 正则梯度，再做残差更新。
models.core_mech_en: Unrolls K iterative sparse-view CT reconstruction stages where each stage combines an explicit projection residual gradient A^T(Ax^t − y) with a stage-specific 3-layer CNN regularizer.
models.input_desc: 稀疏视角 CT 投影 y、系统矩阵 A/Aᵀ 和初始图像 x0
models.input_en: Sparse-view CT sinogram y, system projection matrix A / backprojection A^T, and initial image x^0
models.output_desc: 固定阶段后的 CT 重建 xN
models.output_en: Reconstructed CT image x^K after K≈50 unrolled expert stages

attrs.上一代瓶颈: FBP 后处理忽略投影域一致性，传统迭代正则设计耗时且手工
attrs.核心想法: 把 CT 数据保真梯度和学习到的正则梯度交替展开为固定阶段网络
attrs.关键改进: 显式嵌入系统矩阵并学习每阶段正则更新，实现端到端 sparse-view CT
attrs.医学适配: 是 CT model-based deep learning 和 unrolling 的早期代表
attrs.适用范围与证据: 仍具方法论价值；固定几何和训练分布限制跨扫描器泛化

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Post-processing FBP ignored sinogram data consistency, while classical Fields-of-Experts required slow iterative convergence.
attrs_en.核心想法: Unfold a fixed number of gradient descent steps on a variational CT objective, replacing hand-crafted regularizer gradients with stage-specific 3-layer CNNs.
attrs_en.关键改进: Direct integration of CT projection/backprojection operators into an end-to-end trainable unrolled residual cascade.
attrs_en.医学适配: Early foundational milestone for model-based deep learning in sparse-view and low-dose CT reconstruction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Methodologically important unrolled CT baseline; fixed system matrices and stage-specific parameters require significant memory.

models.paper_title: LEARN: Learned Experts' Assessment-Based Reconstruction Network for Sparse-Data CT

models.title: DnCNN
models.family_label: 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界
models.core_mech: 深 CNN 回归噪声残差，再与输入显式相减，而非直接回归 clean image。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a deep plain CNN with BatchNorm and ReLU to regress the additive noise residual R_θ(y) ≈ n rather than the clean image, recovering x̂ = y − R_θ(y).
models.input_desc: 含噪图像 y=x+n
models.input_en: Noisy observation y = x + n
models.output_desc: 去噪图像 x_hat=y-R_theta(y)
models.output_en: Denoised image estimate x̂ = y − R_θ(y)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 直接回归 clean image 还需复制大部分解剖信号
attrs.核心想法: 预测噪声残差 r(y)，以 xhat=y-r(y) 保留 identity path
attrs.关键改进: 深残差噪声学习和可扩展的 noise-level 训练
attrs.医学适配: 广泛作为低剂量 CT、PET、X-ray 和 MRI 去噪基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级 baseline；原版 AWGN 与 BatchNorm 假设不匹配真实医学噪声

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Directly mapping a noisy image to a clean image forced deep networks to re-synthesize all low-frequency anatomical structures.
attrs_en.核心想法: Predict only the zero-mean noise residual R_θ(y) so the target mapping is much closer to zero than to the identity image.
attrs_en.关键改进: Synergy between residual noise learning and batch normalization, supporting single-model blind Gaussian denoising across noise levels.
attrs_en.医学适配: Universal lightweight baseline for low-dose CT, planar X-ray, ultrasound, and MRI image-space denoising.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational restoration baseline; i.i.d. AWGN assumptions fail on spatially correlated CT sinogram streaks or Poisson PET noise without domain adaptation.

models.paper_title: Beyond a Gaussian Denoiser: Residual Learning of Deep CNN for Image Denoising

models.title: Noise2Noise
models.family_label: 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界
models.fig_badge: Official repository network.py, lines 59–114 · PDF p.Repository source lines 59–114
models.core_mech: 使用同一信号的两次独立无偏噪声实现进行 noisy-to-noisy 监督，训练阶段不需要干净靶图。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a denoising network using pairs of independent noisy realizations (y_1, y_2) of the same underlying anatomy without ever observing clean ground truth.
models.input_desc: 同一潜在图像 x 的两次独立含噪观测 y1、y2
models.input_en: Two independent noisy observations (y_1, y_2) of the exact same underlying clean signal x
models.output_desc: 以单次含噪观测为输入的条件均值估计 x_hat
models.output_en: Clean conditional expectation estimate x̂ = f_θ(y_1)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: clean target 昂贵或无法采集
attrs.核心想法: 用同一潜在图像的两次独立、条件无偏 noisy observations 进行监督
attrs.关键改进: 证明 noisy-to-noisy MSE 与 clean-target MSE 具有相同最优条件均值
attrs.医学适配: 可用于拆分 PET counts、MRI k-space 或可重复低剂量测量
attrs.适用范围与证据: 长期有用；独立性、运动和 uptake mismatch 会造成目标偏差

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Acquiring noiseless ground-truth scans (e.g., high-dose CT or long-exposure microscopy) is often clinically unethical or physically impossible.
attrs_en.核心想法: Exploit the statistical property that replacing a clean L2 regression target x with an independent zero-mean noisy target y_2 leaves the optimal Bayes estimator unchanged.
attrs_en.关键改进: Eliminates the need for clean training targets whenever two independent noisy measurements of static anatomy can be acquired or split.
attrs_en.医学适配: Directly applicable to splitting list-mode PET counts, multi-NEX MRI averages, dose-split CT projections, and cryo-EM / fluorescence microscopy.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Enduring mathematical principle; breaks down if inter-scan patient motion occurs or if noise realizations share correlated bias.

models.paper_title: Noise2Noise: Learning Image Restoration without Clean Data

models.title: Noise2Self
models.family_label: 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界
models.core_mech: 通过 J-invariant 遮挡使单幅 noisy image 同时提供输入与 held-out 监督目标。
models.core_mech_en: Formalizes single-image self-supervised denoising via J-invariant functions whose prediction for pixel subset J does not depend on the observed noisy values in J.
models.input_desc: 单幅含噪图像 y
models.input_en: Single noisy image y (no paired second scan and no clean ground truth)
models.output_desc: 由多次 J-invariant 预测聚合的去噪图像 x_hat
models.output_en: Denoised image x̂ predicted from J-invariant masked neighborhoods

attrs.上一代瓶颈: Noise2Noise 仍需同一解剖的第二个独立观测
attrs.核心想法: 以 J-invariance 让预测某像素集合时不能读取该集合输入
attrs.关键改进: 在条件独立零均值噪声下将单幅 noisy image 变成自监督风险
attrs.医学适配: 可用于显微、PET、MRI 等无 clean target 场景
attrs.适用范围与证据: 方法基础重要；空间相关噪声和孤立病灶可能被错误去除

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Noise2Noise still required two independent co-registered noisy acquisitions of the same patient or specimen.
attrs_en.核心想法: Partition pixels into subsets J and train a J-invariant network to predict pixels in J strictly from their complement J^c under pixel-wise independent noise.
attrs_en.关键改进: Provides the rigorous statistical proof and optimal combination theorem for blind-spot single-image self-supervised denoising.
attrs_en.医学适配: Used in single-shot fluorescence microscopy, low-count nuclear medicine, and unrepeatable dynamic medical acquisitions.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Theoretical cornerstone of blind-spot denoising; fails when noise is spatially correlated (e.g., FBP CT streaks) and can erase isolated 1-pixel micro-structures.

models.paper_title: Noise2Self: Blind Denoising by Self-Supervision

models.title: Noise2Void
models.family_label: 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界
models.archetype: 单张噪声图像上的 blind-spot 自监督去噪
models.core_mech: Noise2Void 通过输入操纵构造 blind spot，只从单张 noisy 图像回归其被隐藏中心，而非需要成对噪声或 clean target。
models.core_mech_en: Implements practical single-image blind-spot denoising by randomly masking center pixels via neighborhood replacement so a standard U-Net predicts held-out pixels.
models.input_desc: 一张噪声图像；训练时随机选取中心像素并用邻域值替换
models.input_en: Single noisy image (with random center pixels replaced by neighboring values during training)
models.output_desc: 每个像素的条件期望估计形成的去噪图像
models.output_en: Denoised image estimate x̂ from a single forward pass

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 监督去噪需要干净目标，Noise2Noise 仍需独立噪声配对
attrs.核心想法: 通过 blind-spot 预测遮挡中心像素，仅用单张噪声图像训练去噪网络
attrs.关键改进: 利用条件独立、零均值噪声假设从同一图像构造自监督目标
attrs.医学适配: 用于显微、低剂量和无法重复采集的医学图像去噪
attrs.适用范围与证据: 自监督去噪经典方法；结构化噪声和相关噪声会违反假设

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Exact J-invariant mask-by-mask forward passes were computationally slow, while supervised denoising required unavailable clean targets.
attrs_en.核心想法: Create a receptive-field blind spot via a simple input masking scheme (replacing target pixels with a random neighbor) so gradients flow only through surrounding context.
attrs_en.关键改进: Efficient multi-pixel blind-spot training recipe applicable to any standard U-Net without paired or clean training data.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely used in biomedical microscopy, OCT speckle reduction, and single-acquisition low-dose imaging.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Classic self-supervised denoiser; structured/correlated noise violates pixel-wise independence and gets preserved as signal.

models.paper_title: Noise2Void - Learning Denoising From Single Noisy Images

models.title: RED-Net
models.family_label: 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界
models.archetype: 对称卷积—反卷积深层图像恢复网络
models.core_mech: 相较普通 autoencoder，RED-Net 在每个镜像卷积—反卷积层之间建立对称加法 skip，而不只保留少数 U-Net 尺度跳连。
models.core_mech_en: Deep symmetric convolutional–deconvolutional autoencoder connected by layer-by-layer additive residual skip connections at every mirrored depth.
models.input_desc: 含噪、压缩或受退化影响的图像
models.input_en: Noisy, blurry, or low-dose degraded image
models.output_desc: 恢复后的高质量图像或残差校正图
models.output_en: Restored clean image recovered via multi-depth additive residual shortcuts

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 早期浅层去噪/超分模型感受野有限，深层编解码器易丢局部信息
attrs.核心想法: 深卷积 encoder-decoder 通过对称 skip 连接重建高频图像细节
attrs.关键改进: 把卷积与反卷积层镜像连接，改善梯度和细节传递
attrs.医学适配: 启发 CT/MRI 去噪、低剂量恢复和残差式重建网络
attrs.适用范围与证据: 历史恢复基线；缺显式成像物理与现代注意力建模

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Deep convolutional autoencoders lost fine spatial details through bottleneck compression and suffered from vanishing gradients.
attrs_en.核心想法: Pair every convolutional encoding layer with a mirrored deconvolutional decoding layer linked by an element-wise additive residual skip.
attrs_en.关键改进: Preserves full spatial resolution options and shortens backpropagation paths across 10–30+ layer restoration autoencoders.
attrs_en.医学适配: Popularized residual encoder–decoder (RED-CNN) architectures as a primary baseline for low-dose CT image-domain denoising.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Historically influential in low-dose CT denoising; purely image-domain L2 training can still over-smooth low-contrast liver lesions.

models.paper_title: Image Restoration Using Very Deep Convolutional Encoder-Decoder Networks with Symmetric Skip Connections

models.title: SwinIR
models.family_label: 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界
models.archetype: 浅层卷积—残差 Swin Transformer—任务重建头
models.core_mech: SwinIR 把多个带卷积残差的 RSTB 置于浅层卷积和任务重建头之间，以移窗注意力服务高分辨率恢复。
models.core_mech_en: Sandwiches multiple Residual Swin Transformer Blocks (RSTBs, each ending in a 3×3 convolutional residual) between a shallow CNN extractor and a reconstruction head.
models.input_desc: 低分辨率、含噪或受压缩伪影影响的图像
models.input_en: Low-resolution, noisy, or artifact-corrupted image
models.output_desc: 超分、去噪或 JPEG artifact reduction 后的图像
models.output_en: Super-resolved, denoised, or artifact-restored high-resolution image

attrs.上一代瓶颈: CNN 恢复网络局部感受野限制长程依赖，全局 attention 成本过高
attrs.核心想法: 以浅层卷积、深层残差 Swin blocks 和重建 head 统一多类图像恢复
attrs.关键改进: 用 shifted-window attention 在高分辨率下高效建模非局部结构
attrs.医学适配: 常用于低剂量 CT、MRI、显微图像去噪与超分辨率迁移
attrs.适用范围与证据: 强恢复 backbone；未显式保证数据一致性或病灶保真

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Pure CNN restoration networks had content-independent local kernels, while naive ViTs lost fine pixel boundaries and translation equivariance.
attrs_en.核心想法: Combine local shifted-window self-attention (for content-adaptive long-range self-similarity) with residual convolutional layers for translational stability.
attrs_en.关键改进: Shallow feature CNN + deep RSTB cascade + long global skip connection achieving state-of-the-art PSNR across restoration benchmarks.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely adopted backbone for MRI super-resolution, low-dose CT/PET denoising, and microscopy image restoration.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Strong modern restoration backbone; remains an image-space mapping unless embedded inside an unrolled physics data-consistency loop.

models.paper_title: SwinIR: Image Restoration Using Swin Transformer

models.title: Restormer
models.family_label: 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界
models.archetype: 层级 encoder-decoder 中的通道转置注意力与门控深度卷积 FFN
models.core_mech: Restormer 用 MDTA 在通道维做转置注意力，并以 GDFN 门控深度卷积替代普通 Transformer FFN。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces spatial N×N self-attention with Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention (MDTA) across channels (C×C) paired with a Gated-Dconv Feed-Forward Network (GDFN).
models.input_desc: 高分辨率受退化图像
models.input_en: High-resolution degraded image
models.output_desc: 去噪、去雨、去模糊等恢复图像
models.output_en: Restored high-resolution image

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 标准自注意力对像素数呈二次复杂度，难处理大图
attrs.核心想法: 用通道维 transposed attention 和门控深度卷积前馈网络恢复高分辨率图像
attrs.关键改进: 在线性空间复杂度下兼顾全局通道交互与局部空间建模
attrs.医学适配: 适合高分辨率病理、CT/MRI 去噪和运动伪影校正
attrs.适用范围与证据: 高效 restoration 基线；医学成像算子和不确定性仍需额外约束

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Even windowed spatial self-attention restricted receptive fields or incurred heavy memory overhead on megapixel medical scans.
attrs_en.核心想法: Compute cross-covariance attention across feature channels (C×C instead of HW×HW) after applying 3×3 depthwise convolutions for local spatial context.
attrs_en.关键改进: O(HW · C²) linear spatial scaling via MDTA + element-wise gated depthwise convolutional FFN controlling fine detail propagation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Well-suited for high-resolution digital pathology restoration, whole-slice MRI motion correction, and low-dose CT denoising.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Compute-efficient high-resolution Transformer restorer; must be audited for quantitative intensity preservation.

models.paper_title: Restormer: Efficient Transformer for High-Resolution Image Restoration

models.title: Spatial Transformer Network
models.family_label: 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
models.core_mech: 定位网络预测变换参数，grid generator 与可微 sampler 将任务梯度传回几何坐标。
models.core_mech_en: Predicts geometric transformation parameters θ via a localization network, generates a transformed sampling grid, and warps feature maps via a differentiable sampler.
models.input_desc: 输入特征图/图像 U
models.input_en: Input image or feature map U
models.output_desc: 按学习变换重采样后的 V
models.output_en: Spatially warped feature map V resampled over learned coordinates T_θ(G)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 普通 CNN 无法对采样坐标和几何变换端到端求导
attrs.核心想法: 用 localization network、grid generator 与可微 sampler 学习空间变换
attrs.关键改进: 把重采样写成可微算子，使下游 loss 可反传到变换参数
attrs.医学适配: 成为 VoxelMorph、可微配准和 2D/3D warping 的算子基础
attrs.适用范围与证据: 基础设施；本身不保证变换平滑、可逆或物理合理

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Standard CNN pooling offered only tiny local translation invariance and could not differentiate through spatial coordinate warping.
attrs_en.核心想法: Formulate coordinate transformation and sub-pixel bilinear/trilinear interpolation as an explicit, sub-differentiable neural module.
attrs_en.关键改进: Sub-gradients with respect to sampling grid coordinates allow upstream networks to learn affine, projective, or thin-plate-spline warps end-to-end.
attrs_en.医学适配: Provides the foundational differentiable warping operator (`grid_sample`) underlying VoxelMorph and all modern learned medical registration.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Essential differentiable geometry primitive; requires explicit regularization when generalized from low-DOF affine to dense displacement fields.

models.paper_title: Spatial Transformer Networks

models.title: VoxelMorph
models.family_label: 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
models.core_mech: 3D U-Net 一次前向预测 dense displacement，并用可微 warping、图像相似度和平滑项无监督训练。
models.core_mech_en: Amortizes pairwise 3D deformable registration into a single U-Net forward pass predicting a dense displacement field u trained unsupervised via image similarity and diffusion smoothness.
models.input_desc: 移动图像 m 与固定图像 f
models.input_en: Pair of 3D moving volume m and fixed volume f
models.output_desc: 稠密形变 phi 及配准图像 m∘phi
models.output_en: Dense 3D deformation field φ = Id + u (or velocity field integrated via scaling-and-squaring) and warped volume m ∘ φ

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 经典 deformable registration 每对病例都需迭代优化，速度慢
attrs.核心想法: 3D U-Net 接收固定/移动图像并一次 forward 预测 dense displacement
attrs.关键改进: 以图像相似度加平滑正则做无监督 amortized registration
attrs.医学适配: 成为 CT/MRI 快速配准最常用的学习式基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 基础设施级 baseline；跨域、相似度选择和 folding 仍是问题

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Classical iterative deformable registration (ANTs/SyN, Elastix) optimized every image pair from scratch, taking minutes to hours on CPU.
attrs_en.核心想法: Train a 3D convolutional U-Net over a population of scans to predict the dense deformation field in sub-second GPU inference without ground-truth warps.
attrs_en.关键改进: Amortized U-Net displacement/velocity prediction + Spatial Transformer warping + unsupervised LNCC/MSE + anatomical segmentation Dice auxiliary loss.
attrs_en.医学适配: Foundational fast learning-based baseline for brain MRI, chest CT inspiration–expiration, and longitudinal registration.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Core registration infrastructure; simple gradient smoothing does not strictly prevent topological folding (|J_φ| ≤ 0) under large deformations.

models.paper_title: VoxelMorph: A Learning Framework for Deformable Medical Image Registration

models.title: GradICON
models.family_label: 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
models.core_mech: 通过双向预测与复合映射 Jacobian 的 gradient inverse-consistency 正则获得近似微分同胚。
models.core_mech_en: Enforces diffeomorphic regularity without tuning sensitive multi-scale smoothness weights by penalizing the Frobenius norm of the composed forward–backward Jacobian deviation from identity.
models.input_desc: 图像 A 与图像 B
models.input_en: Ordered pairs (I^A, I^B) and (I^B, I^A) fed symmetrically to a registration network
models.output_desc: 近似互逆、规则的双向配准映射 Phi_AB 与 Phi_BA
models.output_en: Approximately diffeomorphic, inverse-consistent forward map Φ^AB and backward map Φ^BA

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 单纯平滑位移会过度平滑，直接 inverse-consistency 优化不稳
attrs.核心想法: 同时预测正反变换并惩罚复合映射 Jacobian 偏离单位阵
attrs.关键改进: 用逆一致性的梯度结构获得规则、近似微分同胚的变换
attrs.医学适配: 在多数据集统一 protocol 上提供强通用配准基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 比单纯换 encoder 更具长期价值；仍需病理保持和极端域移位验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Penalizing displacement norm ||Φ^AB(Φ^BA(x)) − x||² required tedious hyperparameter schedules and still permitted local Jacobian folding.
attrs_en.核心想法: Penalize the spatial gradient (Jacobian) of the composed forward–backward transformation relative to the identity matrix I via first-order Taylor expansion.
attrs_en.关键改进: First-order Gradient Inverse Consistency (GradICON) loss yielding near-zero folding and fast convergence across multi-step cascades.
attrs_en.医学适配: Provides a highly regular, topology-preserving 3D registration baseline across brain MRI, lung CT, and abdominal scans.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Superior theoretical and empirical regularity over raw smoothness penalties; space-occupying tumors without topological correspondence still require special handling.

models.paper_title: GradICON: Approximate Diffeomorphisms via Gradient Inverse Consistency

models.title: uniGradICON
models.family_label: 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
models.fig_badge: Official repository src/unigradicon/__init__.py, lines 218–232 · PDF p.Repository source lines 218–232
models.core_mech: 将 GradICON 在异质多数据集上联合训练为单一通用注册器，支持 zero-shot 与目标域微调。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a single multi-step GradICON architecture jointly across heterogeneous multi-organ, multi-modality datasets to serve as a zero-shot registration foundation model.
models.input_desc: 来自多解剖、多模态、多数据集的 moving/fixed 图像对
models.input_en: 3D fixed/moving volume pair from any anatomical region or modality (zero-shot or rapid fine-tuning)
models.output_desc: 新任务上的 zero-shot 或微调双向形变
models.output_en: Diffeomorphic bidirectional deformation fields Φ^AB, Φ^BA

attrs.上一代瓶颈: task-specific registration 网络迁移到新器官或模态时脆弱
attrs.核心想法: 在多解剖、多模态、多数据集联合训练 GradICON，支持 zero-shot 与微调
attrs.关键改进: 共享跨任务的对应特征与形变先验，同时保留 inverse consistency
attrs.医学适配: 是 registration foundation model 的早期可信实例
attrs.适用范围与证据: 高速发展；尚未覆盖所有临床域和细结构

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Conventional learning-based registration required training a separate network for every organ, modality, and FOV.
attrs_en.核心想法: Unify diverse public 3D registration cohorts (brain, lung, abdomen, knee; CT & MRI) under a single GradICON training objective.
attrs_en.关键改进: Demonstrates that a single frozen registration weight set achieves strong out-of-the-box zero-shot accuracy on unseen anatomical domains and fast one-shot adaptation.
attrs_en.医学适配: First credible, open-weight foundation model for 3D medical deformable image registration.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Rapidly advancing registration foundation baseline; extreme cross-modality contrasts (e.g., ultrasound-to-MRI) still benefit from domain adaptation.

models.paper_title: uniGradICON: A Foundation Model for Medical Image Registration

models.title: DiffPose
models.family_label: 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
models.core_mech: 合成 DRR 训练的 pose initializer 与可微 X-ray renderer 驱动的 SE(3) 测试时优化闭环结合。
models.core_mech_en: Couples a patient-specific SE(3) pose initializer (trained self-supervised on synthetic DRRs) with test-time gradient optimization through a differentiable X-ray ray-casting renderer.
models.input_desc: 术前 CT 体 V、术中 2D X-ray y、投影标定参数
models.input_en: Preoperative 3D CT volume V, intraoperative 2D X-ray fluoroscopy image y, and C-arm intrinsic calibration
models.output_desc: CT 到 X-ray 的刚体 SE(3) 位姿 T_hat
models.output_en: Sub-millimeter 6-DoF rigid pose T̂ ∈ SE(3) aligning preoperative CT to intraoperative X-ray

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 直接 pose regression 跨病人/视角泛化差，纯优化捕获范围有限
attrs.核心想法: 用合成 DRR 自监督 pose regressor 初始化，再以可微 X-ray renderer 和 SE(3) 几何测试时优化
attrs.关键改进: 学习初始化、真实投影 forward model、geodesic pose 与 sparse multiscale LNCC 闭环
attrs.医学适配: 用于术中 X-ray 到术前 CT 的 2D/3D 配准
attrs.适用范围与证据: 几何融合范式价值高；标定、散射、金属和外部设备仍会致败

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Direct CNN pose regression generalized poorly outside training poses, while pure gradient-based DRR optimization had a narrow capture range.
attrs_en.核心想法: Generate synthetic DRRs across SE(3) for a patient's preoperative CT to train a rapid pose regressor, then refine the estimate at test time via differentiable DRR gradients.
attrs_en.关键改进: Double-geodesic SE(3) loss + sparse patch-based differentiable rendering accelerating test-time optimization to sub-second latency.
attrs_en.医学适配: Enables accurate intraoperative 2D X-ray to 3D CT registration for orthopedic, spinal, and endovascular image-guided surgery.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Exemplary hybrid learning + projective physics loop; requires accurate C-arm calibration and robustness to surgical tool occlusion.

models.paper_title: Intraoperative 2D/3D Image Registration via Differentiable X-ray Rendering

models.title: LapIRN
models.family_label: 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
models.archetype: Laplacian 金字塔上的粗到细残差形变场级联
models.core_mech: LapIRN 把配准写成 Laplacian 金字塔上的三层残差流：每层先 warp，再让下一层只修正剩余误差。
models.core_mech_en: Decomposes large-deformation 3D registration into a 3-level coarse-to-fine Laplacian image pyramid where each level warps the previous estimate and refines only the residual displacement.
models.input_desc: moving 体积 Im 与 fixed 体积 If
models.input_en: 3D moving volume I_m and fixed volume I_f decomposed into a 3-level Gaussian/Laplacian pyramid
models.output_desc: 组合位移场、形变后的 moving 图像与可选 diffeomorphic 场
models.output_en: Composed full-resolution deformation field (or stationary velocity diffeomorphism) and warped volume

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 单尺度配准捕获范围有限，大形变时易落入局部最优
attrs.核心想法: 在由粗到细的图像金字塔上逐级预测并组合位移场
attrs.关键改进: 每级以前一级形变为初始化，兼顾大位移捕获和局部精化
attrs.医学适配: 用于 3D 脑、腹部和胸部 CT/MRI 快速无监督配准
attrs.适用范围与证据: 经典 coarse-to-fine 学习式基线；可逆性与拓扑保持仍需额外约束

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Single-scale 3D registration networks failed on large respiratory or inter-subject displacements due to local minima and limited receptive fields.
attrs_en.核心想法: Solve registration progressively from 1/4 → 1/2 → 1/1 resolution using feature-skip pyramid networks that predict incremental residual warps.
attrs_en.关键改进: Coarse-to-fine residual warping + warm-start curriculum training + optional scaling-and-squaring diffeomorphic parameterization.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely used benchmark baseline for large-deformation lung CT inspiration–expiration and brain MRI registration.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Classic multi-scale registration architecture; subsequent GradICON/uniGradICON offer stronger inverse-consistency guarantees.

models.paper_title: Laplacian Pyramid Networks for Fast Deformable Registration of Large Deformation

models.title: TransMorph
models.family_label: 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
models.archetype: 层级 Swin Transformer 编码与卷积解码的无监督形变配准
models.core_mech: TransMorph 用层级 Swin encoder 取代纯 CNN 配准编码器，同时保留 U-Net 式 decoder 和可微 warping。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces the convolutional encoder in VoxelMorph with a 3D hierarchical Swin Transformer encoder while retaining a convolutional U-Net decoder and Spatial Transformer warping.
models.input_desc: moving 图像 Im 与 fixed 图像 If
models.input_en: Concatenated 3D moving and fixed volumes (I_m, I_f)
models.output_desc: 稠密位移场 φ、warped moving 图像及可选不确定性估计
models.output_en: Dense 3D displacement field φ, warped moving image I_m ∘ φ, and optional Bayesian uncertainty

attrs.上一代瓶颈: CNN 配准局部感受野难处理远距离解剖对应
attrs.核心想法: 用 Swin Transformer 编码固定/移动图像的长程对应，再由卷积 decoder 输出形变
attrs.关键改进: 层级窗口注意力结合 U-Net 式多尺度解码增强全局匹配
attrs.医学适配: 成为脑 MRI 和腹部 CT Transformer 配准的常用基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 重要架构基线；长程 attention 本身不保证拓扑、对称或跨域稳健

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Small 3×3×3 CNN kernels in early encoder stages struggled to establish long-range spatial correspondence across large anatomical displacements.
attrs_en.核心想法: Leverage 3D Swin Transformer blocks in the encoder to capture larger effective receptive fields for cross-volume matching.
attrs_en.关键改进: Hybrid 3D Swin encoder + CNN skip decoder + diffeomorphic/Bayesian variants benchmarked across brain MRI and CT.
attrs_en.医学适配: Standard Transformer-based 3D medical image registration baseline.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Important architectural comparison point; attention in the encoder does not automatically prevent folding without GradICON/diffeomorphic constraints.

models.paper_title: TransMorph: Transformer for Unsupervised Medical Image Registration

models.title: IDIR
models.family_label: 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
models.archetype: 逐病例优化的坐标 MLP 连续形变表示
models.core_mech: IDIR 将位移场本身作为坐标神经场，并在测试图像对上直接优化，而不是由训练好的网络一次预测 flow。
models.core_mech_en: Parameterizes the continuous 3D deformation field φ(x) = x + u_θ(x) for a single image pair directly as a coordinate-based Implicit Neural Representation (SIREN MLP) optimized at test time.
models.input_desc: 一对 fixed/moving 图像及在图像域采样的连续坐标 x
models.input_en: Continuous 3D spatial coordinates x ∈ [-1,1]³ sampled over a fixed/moving volume pair (I_f, I_m)
models.output_desc: 可在任意坐标查询的连续位移场 uθ(x) 和 warped moving 图像
models.output_en: Resolution-independent continuous deformation field φ_θ(x) with exact autograd spatial derivatives

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 离散位移网格受分辨率限制，学习式配准受训练分布约束
attrs.核心想法: 以坐标 MLP 连续表示单对图像的位移场，并按相似度逐病例优化
attrs.关键改进: 连续可微形变表示无需预训练，可在任意坐标查询并正则化
attrs.医学适配: 用于 MRI/CT 个体化配准和连续形变建模
attrs.适用范围与证据: INR 配准代表；逐病例优化较慢且相似度仍可能歧义

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Discrete voxel-grid registration is tied to grid resolution, relies on finite-difference derivative approximations, and suffers from training-cohort bias.
attrs_en.核心想法: Represent the displacement vector field u_θ(x) as a periodic-activation coordinate MLP optimized directly on the test pair via stochastic coordinate sampling.
attrs_en.关键改进: Grid-free continuous parameterization + exact analytical Jacobian/hyperelastic/bending-energy derivatives via automatic differentiation.
attrs_en.医学适配: Used for high-precision lung 4D-CT landmark tracking and patient-specific registration without training datasets.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Representative implicit neural registration method; per-case optimization takes seconds to minutes rather than milliseconds.

models.paper_title: Implicit Neural Representations for Deformable Image Registration

models.title: DeepDRR
models.family_label: 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环
models.archetype: 学习材料/散射模块与解析 X-ray forward model 的混合模拟器
models.core_mech: DeepDRR 不是纯 GAN 渲染器，而是 3D 材料分解网络、解析材料/能谱 ray tracing、学习散射和解析噪声的组合 forward model。
models.core_mech_en: Physics-based X-ray fluoroscopy simulator combining CNN 3D tissue material decomposition, analytical energy-dependent Beer–Lambert ray-casting, learned Rayleigh/Compton scatter, and quantum noise.
models.input_desc: 患者 CT、X-ray 源—探测器几何、能谱和曝光参数
models.input_en: Volumetric 3D CT scan, C-arm source–detector geometry, X-ray spectrum E, and photon flux
models.output_desc: 含材料衰减、散射和噪声的逼真数字重建 X-ray/fluoroscopy
models.output_en: Photorealistic synthetic fluoroscopy / Digitally Reconstructed Radiograph (DRR) with physical scatter and noise

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 简单线积分 DRR 与真实透视在散射、噪声和设备响应上差距大
attrs.核心想法: 结合 CT 材料分解、解析射线追踪与学习散射/噪声模型生成逼真 DRR
attrs.关键改进: 把物理 forward model 与深度学习散射估计结合，缩小合成到真实域差
attrs.医学适配: 为 2D/3D 配准、器械定位和术中导航生成训练数据
attrs.适用范围与证据: 医学 X-ray 合成基础设施；仿真质量仍取决于扫描与设备标定

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Naive monochrome line-integral DRRs lacked polychromatic beam hardening, Compton scatter, and quantum noise, creating a severe sim-to-real gap.
attrs_en.核心想法: Decompose CT voxels into air/soft-tissue/bone/metal via a 3D CNN, integrate analytical mass attenuation across energy spectra, and add CNN-estimated scatter + Poisson noise.
attrs_en.关键改进: Hybrid physics + deep learning forward model that allows models trained purely on synthetic CT projections to transfer zero-shot to real clinical C-arm X-rays.
attrs_en.医学适配: Foundational simulation engine for training intraoperative 2D/3D registration, surgical tool tracking, and pelvic/spinal landmark detection.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Core medical projective simulation infrastructure; fidelity still depends on CT slice thickness and accurate C-arm spectrum modeling.

models.paper_title: DeepDRR: A Catalyst for Machine Learning in Fluoroscopy-Guided Procedures

models.title: X2CT-GAN
models.family_label: 2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性
models.core_mech: 双正交 2D 编码器将特征提升并融合到 3D，再以体素重建和 3D adversarial loss 联合监督。
models.core_mech_en: Lifts features from two orthogonal (bi-planar PA + lateral) 2D chest X-rays into 3D via backprojection-inspired feature expansion and cross-view fusion supervised by 3D voxel + GAN losses.
models.input_desc: 正位与侧位两幅正交 X-ray
models.input_en: Pair of orthogonal posterior–anterior (PA) and lateral 2D chest radiographs
models.output_desc: 端到端生成的 3D CT 体
models.output_en: Synthesized 3D volumetric chest CT tensor

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 2D 投影到 3D 体积高度欠定，早期方法缺统一端到端表示
attrs.核心想法: 将双正交 X-ray 的 2D 特征 reshape/fuse 为 3D CT，并联合 MSE 与 adversarial loss
attrs.关键改进: 双视图 encoder、2D-to-3D generation 与跨视图 feature fusion
attrs.医学适配: 奠定深度 2D-to-3D CT 生成的历史基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 重要但不唯一；逼真纹理不等于患者真实 anatomy

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Reconstructing a 3D volume from 1–2 planar X-ray projections is severely ill-posed, and standard 2D networks lack a 3D spatial bottleneck.
attrs_en.核心想法: Encode PA and lateral radiographs via parallel 2D DenseNet-like encoders, expand 2D feature maps along the orthogonal depth axes, and fuse them inside a 3D decoder.
attrs_en.关键改进: View-specific 2D-to-3D feature liftingconnections + bi-planar orthogonal fusion + 3D PatchGAN + projection consistency losses.
attrs_en.医学适配: Canonical baseline for bi-planar 2D X-ray to 3D CT volumetric lifting.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Historically important 2D-to-3D baseline; must never be treated as a diagnostic replacement for true CT acquisition due to null-space hallucination.

models.paper_title: X2CT-GAN: Reconstructing CT from Biplanar X-Rays with Generative Adversarial Networks

models.title: NeRF
models.family_label: 2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性
models.core_mech: 位置编码坐标 MLP 预测连续密度与视角相关颜色，再沿相机射线做可微体渲染。
models.core_mech_en: Represents a continuous 3D scene as a 5D coordinate MLP (x,y,z,θ,φ) → (σ, c) with Fourier positional encoding, optimized via differentiable emission–absorption volume rendering.
models.input_desc: 带相机内外参的多视角 RGB 图像与采样射线
models.input_en: 3D spatial coordinates x=(x,y,z) and 2D viewing direction d=(θ,φ) along calibrated camera rays
models.output_desc: 新视角渲染图像及连续密度/颜色场
models.output_en: Volume density σ(x), view-dependent RGB radiance c(x,d), and rendered 2D novel views

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 离散 voxel/mesh 分辨率固定，novel-view fidelity 受限
attrs.核心想法: 连续坐标 MLP 表示密度和视角相关颜色，并沿射线可微体渲染
attrs.关键改进: positional encoding、per-scene optimization 与连续 volumetric rendering
attrs.医学适配: 启发稀疏投影 attenuation fields、内镜场建模和医学 INR
attrs.适用范围与证据: 场表示基础；原始可见光 alpha-compositing 不能直接当 X-ray 物理

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Discrete voxel grids scaled cubically in memory, while triangle meshes struggled to optimize complex topology via gradient descent.
attrs_en.核心想法: Encode continuous spatial coordinates with high-frequency sinusoids so a compact MLP memorizes a continuous volumetric density and radiance field.
attrs_en.关键改进: Fourier positional encoding overcoming MLP spectral bias + hierarchical coarse-to-fine stratified ray sampling.
attrs_en.医学适配: Catalyzed medical Implicit Neural Representations (INRs), sparse-view CBCT attenuation fields (NAF), and surgical endoscopy scene reconstruction.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational neural field paradigm; visible-light occlusion/emission rendering must be rewritten into Beer–Lambert transmission for X-ray/CT.

models.paper_title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis

models.title: NAF
models.family_label: 2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性
models.core_mech: 以 hash-encoded 坐标网络表示 X-ray attenuation，并用 Beer–Lambert 重投影误差逐病例优化。
models.core_mech_en: Rewrites NeRF for cone-beam CT by replacing view-dependent emission–absorption with an isotropic X-ray linear attenuation field μ(x) optimized via Beer–Lambert reprojection error and hash encoding.
models.input_desc: 稀疏视角 CBCT 投影 y、每幅投影的射线几何
models.input_en: 3D spatial coordinates x along calibrated X-ray source-to-detector rays and sparse 2D CBCT projections y
models.output_desc: 连续 X-ray attenuation field mu(x) 与可查询 3D 重建
models.output_en: Continuous 3D X-ray attenuation coefficient field μ_θ(x) queried at arbitrary voxel grids

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 稀疏 CBCT 重建缺细节，监督网络需大量成对训练数据
attrs.核心想法: 用坐标网络表示 X-ray attenuation，并最小化输入投影的重投影误差
attrs.关键改进: 将 NeRF 改为符合 Beer-Lambert 的 attenuation field，并用 hash encoding 加速
attrs.医学适配: 适用于 phantom/人体 sparse-view CBCT 的自监督 per-case reconstruction；需区分模拟投影与真实 acquisition
attrs.适用范围与证据: 正确的医学 NeRF 改写；无外部 prior 时仍不能创造缺失信息

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Applying RGB NeRF directly to X-ray projections violated transmission physics, while Fourier MLP encodings took hours to optimize per patient.
attrs_en.核心想法: Model a view-independent scalar attenuation field μ(x) using multi-resolution hash grid encoding (Instant-NGP) supervised purely by line-integral projection residuals.
attrs_en.关键改进: Physically faithful Beer–Lambert line integral + multi-resolution learnable hash table reducing self-supervised 3D CBCT reconstruction to minutes.
attrs_en.医学适配: Fast, self-supervised per-patient sparse-view CBCT reconstruction requiring zero external training datasets.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Correct physics adaptation of NeRF to tomography; without an external population prior, extreme view sparsity still exhibits null-space streaks.

models.paper_title: Neural Attenuation Fields for Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction

models.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting
models.family_label: 2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性
models.core_mech: 显式优化各向异性 3D Gaussians，并通过屏幕空间 splatting 与自适应增密实现实时 radiance rendering。
models.core_mech_en: Represents 3D scenes explicitly as millions of anisotropic 3D Gaussians (position, covariance, opacity, spherical harmonics) rendered in real time via differentiable tile-based rasterization.
models.input_desc: 带标定多视角 RGB 图像与 SfM/点云初始化
models.input_en: Calibrated multi-view images and initial sparse point cloud
models.output_desc: 可实时新视角渲染的显式 3D Gaussian 集合
models.output_en: Explicit set of anisotropic 3D Gaussians supporting >100 FPS real-time novel-view synthesis

attrs.上一代瓶颈: NeRF 每射线 MLP 查询使训练与渲染较慢
attrs.核心想法: 以显式各向异性 3D Gaussians 和 visibility-aware splatting 表示场景
attrs.关键改进: 直接优化 Gaussian 位置、协方差、不透明度和颜色，实现实时渲染
attrs.医学适配: 启发 X-ray radiative Gaussian splatting 和动态 tomography
attrs.适用范围与证据: 实时渲染优势真实；不自动保证 HU、解剖或成像物理

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Continuous coordinate MLPs in NeRF required querying hundreds of points along every ray, bottlenecking real-time rendering and interactive editing.
attrs_en.核心想法: Replace implicit continuous MLPs with explicit 3D Gaussian primitives projected directly to 2D screen space via closed-form EWA covariance splatting.
attrs_en.关键改进: Anisotropic 3D covariance optimization (R S S^T R^T) + adaptive clone/split/prune density control + fast tile-based GPU sorting rasterizer.
attrs_en.医学适配: Rapidly adapted to surgical endoscopy 3D reconstruction (EndoGaussian) and radiative X-ray Gaussian tomography (R2-Gaussian).
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Genuine real-time rendering breakthrough; discrete Gaussian primitives can still produce needle-like artifacts under sparse views.

models.paper_title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering

models.title: pixelNeRF
models.family_label: 2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性
models.archetype: 像素对齐图像特征条件化的跨场景 NeRF
models.core_mech: pixelNeRF 将每个 3D 点与其投影像素的 CNN 特征绑定，使 NeRF 从单场景优化器变为跨场景条件模型。
models.core_mech_en: Conditions a coordinate NeRF MLP on pixel-aligned 2D CNN feature vectors projected from 1 or a few input views, turning NeRF from a per-scene optimizer into a feed-forward cross-scene prior.
models.input_desc: 一张或少量带相机位姿的参考图像，以及目标相机射线
models.input_en: 1 to K calibrated input images + query 3D point x projected into each input view's camera coordinates
models.output_desc: 目标视角 RGB 图像和隐式密度/辐射场
models.output_en: Feed-forward novel-view rendering and 3D volumetric density field from sparse views

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 原始 NeRF 每个场景都需多视图和长时间优化
attrs.核心想法: 从输入图像提取像素对齐特征并条件化 NeRF，使其跨场景推断新对象
attrs.关键改进: 学习跨场景先验，实现单张或少量视图的前馈条件化重建
attrs.医学适配: 启发 sparse-view X-ray、内镜和解剖场的患者先验建模
attrs.适用范围与证据: 少视图 NeRF 基础；自然图像辐射假设不能直接替代医学投影物理

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Original NeRF had no cross-scene prior and collapsed completely when given only 1–3 input views.
attrs_en.核心想法: Extract a spatial CNN feature pyramid from each input view, project any 3D query point x onto the 2D image planes via camera intrinsics/extrinsics, and feed the bilinearly sampled features into the NeRF MLP.
attrs_en.关键改进: Preserves explicit projective geometry via pixel-aligned local features rather than compressing the input into a single global latent vector.
attrs_en.医学适配: Directly inspires sparse-view dual/single X-ray to 3D CT neural field priors (e.g., PerX2CT, DIF-Net).
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Foundational few-view conditional neural field; projective feature occlusion must be adapted for transmission X-ray imaging.

models.paper_title: pixelNeRF: Neural Radiance Fields from One or Few Images

models.title: Instant-NGP
models.family_label: 2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性
models.archetype: 多分辨率哈希网格编码的小型神经场
models.core_mech: Instant-NGP 的速度来自可学习多分辨率 hash-grid encoding 和空空间跳跃，而不是更深的 NeRF MLP。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces fixed sinusoidal positional encodings with a multi-resolution hierarchy of learnable hash tables paired with a tiny fused-CUDA MLP, accelerating neural fields by 100×–1000×.
models.input_desc: 3D 坐标、观察方向及训练相机射线
models.input_en: Continuous 3D coordinate x ∈ R³ mapped across L resolution grids via spatial hashing
models.output_desc: 快速优化的 density/color 场与实时新视角渲染
models.output_en: Concatenated L×F interpolated feature vector decoded in microseconds into density/attenuation/SDF

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 坐标 MLP 的 Fourier features 训练慢，细节与速度难兼顾
attrs.核心想法: 用多分辨率哈希网格编码坐标并以小 MLP 表示场景
attrs.关键改进: 可学习哈希表在不同尺度存储局部特征，使 NeRF 训练缩短到秒/分钟级
attrs.医学适配: 加速 CBCT attenuation fields、医学 INR 和配准场优化
attrs.适用范围与证据: 高效坐标编码基础；哈希碰撞和显存参数需按医学分辨率调节

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Deep coordinate MLPs (8 layers × 256 channels) were computationally expensive to evaluate millions of times per optimization step.
attrs_en.核心想法: Store trainable feature vectors directly in compact multi-resolution hash tables indexed by voxel corners, letting a tiny 2-layer MLP resolve hash collisions.
attrs_en.关键改进: O(1) multi-scale hash lookup + implicit gradient-based collision resolution + occupancy grid empty-space skipping.
attrs_en.医学适配: Core acceleration engine inside NAF (CBCT), implicit deformable registration, and real-time surgical scene neural fields.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Essential coordinate-encoding infrastructure; high-frequency hash levels can fit measurement noise if not regularized.

models.paper_title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding

models.title: MedNeRF
models.family_label: 2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性
models.archetype: 以形状/外观潜变量条件化的生成式医学 NeRF
models.core_mech: MedNeRF 把 NeRF 置于 GAN 式跨病例生成先验中，以 shape/appearance latent 从单 X-ray 合成视角，而非逐场景多视图优化。
models.core_mech_en: Adapts GIRAFFE/GRAF 3D-aware generative radiance fields to X-ray projections, disentangling 3D shape and appearance latents to synthesize continuous-angle CT projections from a single X-ray.
models.input_desc: 训练时为未配对的 2D X-ray 与采样相机位姿；推理时以单张 X-ray 约束患者潜变量
models.input_en: Unpaired 2D DRR/X-ray projections during GAN training; a single 2D X-ray during test-time latent inversion
models.output_desc: 视角可控的 3D-aware CT projection 合成
models.output_en: Continuous-angle 3D-aware X-ray projection synthesis across 360° viewpoints

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 单视图到 3D 高度欠定，原始 NeRF 依赖多视图且建模可见光
attrs.核心想法: 以 GAN 条件先验和 NeRF 式场表示从单张 X-ray 生成视角可控的 CT 投影
attrs.关键改进: 学习跨病例生成先验并引入医学投影数据生成新视角
attrs.医学适配: 直接任务是单 X-ray 的 3D-aware projection synthesis；数据增强与表示学习属于潜在用途
attrs.适用范围与证据: 概念性医学 NeRF；生成投影不等价于患者真实 3D 解剖重建

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Single-view X-ray to 3D reconstruction lacked multi-view supervision, while 2D GANs could not enforce 3D viewpoint consistency.
attrs_en.核心想法: Train a 3D-aware conditional generative radiance field on 2D X-ray projections with a multi-scale PatchGAN discriminator, then invert latent codes (z_s, z_a) from a single test X-ray.
attrs_en.关键改进: Disentangled shape/appearance conditioning + volumetric feature rendering + test-time latent + generator fine-tuning.
attrs_en.医学适配: Explored for single-view chest and knee X-ray 3D-aware view synthesis and data augmentation.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Conceptual proof-of-concept; synthesized projections reflect a population GAN prior rather than guaranteed patient-specific 3D tomography.

models.paper_title: MedNeRF: Medical Neural Radiance Fields for Reconstructing 3D-Aware CT-Projections from a Single X-Ray

models.title: EndoNeRF
models.family_label: 2D→3D 与神经场：表示能力、投影一致性和不可辨识性
models.archetype: 时间形变场与 canonical radiance field 的动态内镜 NeRF
models.core_mech: EndoNeRF 以时间条件 deformation MLP 把动态组织映射到 canonical NeRF，并显式利用手术器械 mask。
models.core_mech_en: Reconstructs deformable soft-tissue scenes from single-viewpoint stereo robotic endoscopy by pairing a canonical static NeRF with a time-conditioned deformation field and tool occlusion masks.
models.input_desc: 双目/视频内镜帧、相机位姿、时间戳及手术器械二值 mask
models.input_en: Robotic stereo endoscopy video frames, estimated stereo depth maps, timestamps t, and binary surgical tool masks
models.output_desc: 动态软组织的 canonical 几何、深度和新视角内镜图像
models.output_en: Tool-free dynamic 3D soft-tissue surface geometry, depth maps, and novel-view renderings

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 静态 NeRF 无法处理组织形变、器械遮挡和稀疏内镜视角
attrs.核心想法: 用可变形 NeRF 联合建模内镜场景外观、几何和手术组织动态
attrs.关键改进: 通过时间条件形变场与遮挡掩膜合成动态手术新视角
attrs.医学适配: 用于微创手术场景重建、导航和动态视图合成
attrs.适用范围与证据: 动态内镜 NeRF 早期代表；拓扑变化、镜面反射和临床标定仍困难

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Robotic surgical scenes violate static NeRF assumptions due to non-rigid tissue deformation, smoke/specularities, and severe surgical instrument occlusion.
attrs_en.核心想法: Warp 3D points at time t via a displacement MLP Δx(x, t) into a shared canonical radiance field while masking out rays occluded by surgical instruments.
attrs_en.关键改进: Tool-mask-guided importance ray sampling + stereo depth cue supervision + canonical-plus-deformation spatiotemporal factorization.
attrs_en.医学适配: Pioneered neural field 3D soft-tissue reconstruction for DaVinci robotic prostatectomy and minimally invasive surgery.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Landmark surgical NeRF baseline; cannot handle topological tissue cutting/resection and requires minutes of offline optimization (later accelerated by EndoGaussian).

models.paper_title: EndoNeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Endoscopic View Synthesis

models.title: GCN
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.family_label: 图神经网络：当边、拓扑和关系本身就是医学信息
models.core_mech: 以加自环的对称归一化邻接执行共享线性变换后的固定权重邻居聚合。
models.core_mech_en: First-order spectral graph convolution approximation that aggregates 1-hop neighbor features weighted by the symmetrically normalized adjacency matrix with self-loops.
models.input_desc: 图 G=(V,E)、节点特征 X 与邻接矩阵 A
models.input_en: Graph G=(V,E) with node feature matrix X ∈ R^{N×C} and adjacency matrix A
models.output_desc: 节点级或图级预测
models.output_en: Updated node embeddings H^{(L)} for node classification, link prediction, or pooled graph classification

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 谱图卷积需特征分解，难扩展且参数不易共享
attrs.核心想法: 用归一化邻接矩阵的一阶谱近似做邻居特征聚合
attrs.关键改进: 局部 message passing 的简单可训练形式
attrs.医学适配: 用于 population graph、血管/气道树和解剖 mesh
attrs.适用范围与证据: GNN 基础；深层 over-smoothing 与构图泄漏需警惕

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Exact spectral graph CNNs required O(N³) Laplacian eigendecomposition and could not transfer across graphs of varying topology.
attrs_en.核心想法: Truncate Chebyshev spectral polynomials to first order, yielding a localized spatial 1-hop neighborhood averaging operator with shared linear weights.
attrs_en.关键改进: Simple, parameter-efficient message passing scaling linearly with number of graph edges O(|E|).
attrs_en.医学适配: Foundational GNN used across brain connectomes (fMRI/DTI), vascular/airway trees, cortical surface meshes, and spatial cell graphs.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Core GNN baseline; stacking many GCN layers causes over-smoothing, and transductive patient-similarity graphs risk severe cohort leakage.

models.paper_title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks

models.title: GAT
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.family_label: 图神经网络：当边、拓扑和关系本身就是医学信息
models.core_mech: 对预定义邻域内的边计算 masked multi-head attention，再以数据依赖权重聚合邻居特征。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces fixed degree-normalized edge weights with content-dependent multi-head masked self-attention coefficients α_{ij} computed over 1-hop graph neighborhoods.
models.input_desc: 图 G=(V,E) 与节点特征 X
models.input_en: Graph G=(V,E) and node feature vectors {h_i}
models.output_desc: 注意力聚合后的节点或图级预测
models.output_en: Anisotropically aggregated node representations h'_i and attention edge weights α_{ij}

attrs.上一代瓶颈: GCN 对邻居使用固定归一化权重，难表达异质关系
attrs.核心想法: 以 masked attention 为不同邻居自适应分配权重
attrs.关键改进: 多头图注意力仍需预定义 adjacency/neighborhood，但不需预设已有边的权重
attrs.医学适配: 适合血管分支、病人关系和细胞相互作用图
attrs.适用范围与证据: 重要图模型；attention 权重不自动等于医学解释

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: GCN weighted neighbors solely by static node degrees, preventing the network from prioritizing diagnostically critical neighbors.
attrs_en.核心想法: Compute learnable attention scores e_{ij} = a^T [W h_i || W h_j] normalized via softmax over each node's 1-hop neighborhood N_i.
attrs_en.关键改进: Inductive, degree-agnostic anisotropic neighborhood weighting + multi-head stabilization.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely applied to histopathology cell- microenvironment graphs, brain functional connectivity, and multimodal patient networks.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Standard anisotropic GNN; learned attention weights α_{ij} aid inspection but do not guarantee causal biological importance.

models.paper_title: Graph Attention Networks

models.title: GraphSAGE
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.family_label: 图神经网络：当边、拓扑和关系本身就是医学信息
models.archetype: 邻居采样与可学习聚合的归纳式 GNN
models.core_mech: GraphSAGE 学的是可应用到新节点的聚合器，并用固定邻居采样实现归纳式 mini-batch GNN。
models.core_mech_en: Inductive graph representation learning that samples fixed-size K-hop neighborhoods and applies learnable aggregator functions (mean, LSTM, pooling) to generalize to unseen nodes.
models.input_desc: 图 G=(V,E)、节点特征和待编码节点批次
models.input_en: Graph G=(V,E), node attribute features x_v, and mini-batch of target nodes
models.output_desc: 可泛化到未见节点的 node embeddings 或节点预测
models.output_en: Inductive node embeddings z_v generalizable to newly arriving unseen nodes or whole slides

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 谱 GCN 偏传导式且全邻居计算难扩展到新节点和大图
attrs.核心想法: 通过采样固定数量邻居并聚合其特征生成节点嵌入
attrs.关键改进: 可学习聚合器支持 mini-batch、归纳迁移与未见节点
attrs.医学适配: 用于患者相似图、细胞图、血管树和大规模病理图
attrs.适用范围与证据: 归纳 GNN 基础；邻居采样和构图偏差会直接影响医学结论

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Full-batch transductive GCNs required holding the entire graph Laplacian in memory and could not embed unseen test nodes without retraining.
attrs_en.核心想法: Learn aggregator functions over uniformly sampled fixed-size k-hop neighborhoods while explicitly concatenating a node's own previous state with its aggregated neighborhood.
attrs_en.关键改进: Mini-batch neighborhood sampling bounding memory footprint + explicit self-feature concatenation preserving node identity against over-smoothing.
attrs_en.医学适配: Enables scalable inductive training on million-cell whole-slide pathology graphs and dynamic clinical EHR cohorts.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Essential scalable inductive GNN; uniform random neighbor sampling can miss rare diagnostic hub cells if degree distributions are skewed.

models.paper_title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs

models.title: Graphormer
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.family_label: 图神经网络：当边、拓扑和关系本身就是医学信息
models.archetype: 以中心性、最短路径和边编码注入结构偏置的全局图 Transformer
models.core_mech: Graphormer 不做局部消息传递堆叠，而在全局 attention logits 中显式加入最短路径和边特征偏置。
models.core_mech_en: Enables global all-pair Transformer self-attention over graphs by injecting degree centrality encodings into nodes and shortest-path spatial + edge-feature biases into attention logits.
models.input_desc: 带节点属性和边属性的图
models.input_en: Attributed graph G=(V,E) with node features, edge features, node degrees, and all-pair shortest-path distances
models.output_desc: 节点上下文表示与 graph-level prediction
models.output_en: Globally contextualized node representations and graph-level predictions

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 普通 Transformer 忽略图拓扑，消息传递 GNN 长程传播易过平滑
attrs.核心想法: 把最短路径距离、节点中心性和边特征作为 attention bias 注入 Transformer
attrs.关键改进: 以结构编码让全局 self-attention 保留图归纳偏置
attrs.医学适配: 适用于分子、细胞相互作用、脑网络和患者关系图
attrs.适用范围与证据: 图 Transformer 代表；O(N²) 成本和拓扑构造限制大医学图扩展

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Message-passing GNNs are bounded by the 1-WL isomorphism test and suffer from over-squashing across long graph bottlenecks.
attrs_en.核心想法: Allow every node to attend to every other node globally while encoding graph topology directly as additive biases inside the softmax attention matrix.
attrs_en.关键改进: Centrality encoding + Shortest-Path Distance (SPD) spatial bias + multi-hop edge feature encoding along shortest paths.
attrs_en.医学适配: Excels on molecular property prediction, drug discovery, protein structure, and compact brain region connectome graphs (~100–500 ROIs).
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Leading Graph Transformer; O(N²) all-pair attention and shortest-path computation prohibit direct application to 100,000-node WSI cell graphs.

models.paper_title: Do Transformers Really Perform Bad for Graph Representation?

models.title: Voxel2Mesh
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.family_label: 图神经网络：当边、拓扑和关系本身就是医学信息
models.archetype: 3D 体素特征驱动的显式网格形变与自适应细分
models.core_mech: Voxel2Mesh 不先分割再 marching cubes，而由 3D 体素特征逐级驱动球形模板的 GCN 形变和细分。
models.core_mech_en: Deforms a sphere template mesh progressively into a target 3D anatomical surface via Graph Convolutions conditioned on 3D CNN voxel features sampled at mesh vertices.
models.input_desc: 3D 医学体积与初始球形模板 mesh
models.input_en: 3D medical imaging volume (CT/MRI/EM) + initial genus-0 spherical template mesh
models.output_desc: 器官表面的顶点、三角面与可选体素分割
models.output_en: Explicit 3D anatomical triangle mesh (vertices V, faces F) and auxiliary voxel segmentation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 体素分割边界台阶化且高分辨率 3D 预测内存昂贵
attrs.核心想法: 从球形初始网格出发，用体素特征引导图卷积逐级形变和加密 mesh
attrs.关键改进: 联合体素编码与显式 mesh 顶点/拓扑学习直接输出表面
attrs.医学适配: 用于心脏、肝脏等器官可解释表面重建
attrs.适用范围与证据: 医学 mesh 深度学习代表；固定拓扑难处理孔洞和复杂拓扑变化

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Voxel segmentation followed by Marching Cubes produced staircase artifacts, topological holes, and disconnected floating islands.
attrs_en.核心想法: Sample multi-scale 3D U-Net encoder/decoder features directly at current 3D vertex coordinates and deform the mesh coarse-to-fine via GCN blocks.
attrs_en.关键改进: Learned neighborhood voxel sampling + adaptive edge subdivision (unpooling) + normal/Laplacian/edge-length geometric regularizers.
attrs_en.医学适配: Produces smooth, genus-zero topological meshes for liver, hippocampus, synaptic junctions, and cardiac chambers.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Strong explicit 3D surface baseline; fixed sphere topology cannot model organs with holes or variable branching without template modification.

models.paper_title: Voxel2Mesh: 3D Mesh Model Generation from Volumetric Data

models.title: Vox2Cortex
models.family_short: 图神经网络与医学拓扑
models.family_label: 图神经网络：当边、拓扑和关系本身就是医学信息
models.archetype: 3D MRI 体特征与图卷积联合的多皮层表面形变
models.core_mech: Vox2Cortex 将 3D U-Net 特征在顶点处采样，并以 GCN 同时形变四个互相关联的皮层表面。
models.core_mech_en: Jointly deforms four topologically coupled brain cortical hemisphere templates (left/right white and pial surfaces) in seconds using 3D U-Net voxel features and Residual GCNs.
models.input_desc: 3D T1-weighted brain MRI 与四个初始皮层模板表面
models.input_en: 3D T1-weighted brain MRI + 4 initialized template meshes (~168,000 total vertices)
models.output_desc: 左右半球 white 与 pial 四个显式 cortical meshes
models.output_en: 4 high-resolution, topologically genus-zero cortical meshes (LH/RH white matter and pial surfaces)

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 传统皮层重建流程耗时且多阶段，通用 mesh 模型难满足嵌套皮层拓扑
attrs.核心想法: 由 3D MRI 体素特征驱动多表面 mesh deformation，同时预测皮层内外表面
attrs.关键改进: 联合 U-Net 体特征、图卷积和表面正则快速重建多层皮层
attrs.医学适配: 用于脑 MRI white/pial cortical surface extraction
attrs.适用范围与证据: 显式神经解剖表面强基线；异常 anatomy 与跨扫描协议仍具挑战

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Classical FreeSurfer cortical surface reconstruction required 4–8 hours of CPU optimization per scan, while voxel segmenters failed to prevent self-intersections in tight sulci.
attrs_en.核心想法: Drive 4 coupled template meshes simultaneously through multiple Euler-like deformation steps conditioned on multi-scale 3D CNN features sampled at vertex coordinates.
attrs_en.关键改进: Inter- and intra-surface geometric constraints preventing white/pial self-intersection + 1,000× speedup (<20 seconds vs. hours in FreeSurfer).
attrs_en.医学适配: High-speed neuroimaging baseline for cortical thickness analysis, Alzheimer's atrophy tracking, and large biobank processing.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Domain-specialized explicit surface landmark; severe brain tumors or strokes that disrupt normal cortical topology remain challenging.

models.paper_title: Vox2Cortex: Fast Explicit Reconstruction of Cortical Surfaces from 3D MRI

models.title: LSTM
models.family_label: 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练
models.core_mech: 带门控的加性 cell memory 与 recurrent hidden state 分离，使长期信息可选择性保留和读出。
models.core_mech_en: Separates an additive linear cell memory state c_t (governed by forget and input gates) from the non-linear recurrent hidden state h_t to preserve long-term temporal gradients.
models.input_desc: 时间序列 x_1…x_T
models.input_en: Sequential physiological waveform or longitudinal clinical time series x_1 … x_T
models.output_desc: 逐时刻隐藏状态或序列级预测
models.output_en: Step-wise hidden states h_t or sequence-level diagnostic prediction

attrs.上一代瓶颈: vanilla RNN 长依赖中梯度消失或爆炸
attrs.核心想法: 用 cell state 和 input/forget/output gates 保留长期信息
attrs.关键改进: 带近恒等记忆通路的门控循环更新
attrs.医学适配: 长期用于小中型 ECG、EEG、EMG 与纵向临床序列
attrs.适用范围与证据: 仍是低数据序列基线；串行训练慢且长窗口扩展有限

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Vanilla RNNs multiplied recurrent weight matrices repeatedly across time, causing gradients to vanish or explode over >20 steps.
attrs_en.核心想法: Introduce a linear self-connected memory cell c_t regulated by multiplicative sigmoid input, forget, and output gates.
attrs_en.关键改进: Additive cell-state highway enabling gradient propagation across hundreds of time steps.
attrs_en.医学适配: Long-standing workhorse for 12-lead ECG arrhythmia classification, ICU vitals early-warning scores, and irregular EHR trajectories.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Reliable low-data sequential baseline; sequential step-by-step recurrence prevents parallel training across ultra-long multi-thousand-sample waveforms.

models.paper_title: Long Short-Term Memory

models.title: Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)
models.family_label: 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练
models.core_mech: 以因果、指数扩张的 1D 卷积残差块并行覆盖长历史，而不使用循环状态。
models.core_mech_en: Stacks 1D causal convolutions with exponentially increasing dilation factors d = 2^l inside residual blocks to cover long historical receptive fields in parallel.
models.input_desc: 长度 T 的多通道时间序列 X
models.input_en: Multi-channel continuous physiological time series X ∈ R^{C×T}
models.output_desc: 逐时刻或序列级预测
models.output_en: Causal step-wise sequence predictions or pooled episode classification

attrs.上一代瓶颈: RNN 串行计算且有效记忆长度不稳定
attrs.核心想法: 用 causal dilated 1D convolution 与 residual blocks 建模长序列
attrs.关键改进: 并行卷积、指数扩张感受野和稳定残差优化
attrs.医学适配: 成为 ECG/EEG 等生理信号强、便宜、稳定的 baseline
attrs.适用范围与证据: 长期实用；感受野由 dilation/depth 固定且全局自适应关系有限

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Recurrent networks (LSTM/GRU) could not parallelize across time during training and exhibited unstable effective memory horizons.
attrs_en.核心想法: Combine strict causal padding (no future leakage) with exponentially dilated 1D convolutions (d=1, 2, 4, 8…) and residual shortcuts.
attrs_en.关键改进: Full temporal parallelization during training + exact, deterministic receptive field calculation R = 1 + Σ (k−1)·d_l + low streaming memory.
attrs_en.医学适配: Highly competitive, fast, and stable baseline for continuous ECG, EEG seizure detection, PPG, and EMG envelope decoding.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Practical first-line waveform baseline; receptive field is fixed by network depth/dilation and weights remain static across inputs.

models.paper_title: An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling

models.title: HeartBEiT
models.family_label: 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练
models.core_mech: 将标准版式 ECG 渲染为图像，以 BEiT 式离散 masked-patch prediction 预训练专用 ViT。
models.core_mech_en: Renders standard 12-lead ECG waveforms as 2D layout images and pretrains a Vision Transformer via BEiT-style discrete masked patch token prediction on 8.5 million ECGs.
models.input_desc: 按标准版式渲染的 12 导联 ECG 图像
models.input_en: Standardized 2D image rendering of a 12-lead clinical electrocardiogram
models.output_desc: ECG 诊断分类概率或迁移表征
models.output_en: Pretrained ECG ViT representation for low-label arrhythmia, LVEF, and STEMI classification

attrs.上一代瓶颈: ImageNet 初始化与小型监督模型难覆盖 ECG 形态及标签稀缺
attrs.核心想法: 把 ECG 渲染为图像并用 BEiT 式 masked image modeling 进行大规模领域预训练
attrs.关键改进: 在 850 万 ECG、210 万患者上做领域 masked pretraining
attrs.医学适配: 提高 ECG 少标签迁移和外部分类表现
attrs.适用范围与证据: 证明领域预训练价值；渲染、截断和缩放可能损失精确采样、幅值及采集元数据，并依赖固定版式

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Small supervised ECG models overfit single-center cohorts, while natural-image ViT weights did not capture fine QRS/ST-segment morphology.
attrs_en.核心想法: Convert clinical 12-lead ECGs into standardized 2D visual plots and pretrain a ViT to reconstruct masked waveform patches via discrete visual tokens.
attrs_en.关键改进: Large-scale in-domain masked pretraining across 8.5M ECGs from 2.1M patients, directly compatible with printed/scanned paper ECGs.
attrs_en.医学适配: Improves label-efficient transfer for reduced LVEF screening, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and myocardial infarction detection.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Demonstrates the power of scale in ECG SSL; rasterizing 1D voltage time series into 2D pixels discards microvolt resolution and ties the model to a fixed plot layout.

models.paper_title: A Foundational Vision Transformer Improves Diagnostic Performance for Electrocardiograms

models.title: LaBraM
models.family_label: 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练
models.core_mech: 以 VQ neural tokenizer 提供离散 EEG patch 目标，再用跨通道/时间 Transformer 做 masked code prediction。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a vector-quantized (VQ) neural spectrum tokenizer to predict Fourier amplitude/phase spectra of EEG patches, then pretrains a cross-channel Transformer via masked code prediction.
models.input_desc: 多通道连续 EEG 片段及通道身份
models.input_en: Multi-channel continuous EEG recordings with arbitrary montage channel counts and recording lengths
models.output_desc: 通用 EEG 表征与下游分类/检测输出
models.output_en: Universal EEG representation transferable across seizure detection, sleep staging, emotion, and motor BCI

attrs.上一代瓶颈: 电极数、记录长度和任务差异使一任务一模型难迁移
attrs.核心想法: 以 channel patches、VQ neural tokenizer 和 masked code prediction 统一异质 EEG
attrs.关键改进: 跨约 20 个数据集、约 2500 小时 EEG 预训练离散神经信号 tokenizer 与 Transformer
attrs.医学适配: 支持 EEG 分类、检测和 BCI 的迁移与少样本学习
attrs.适用范围与证据: 原论文在四类下游任务报告优势；跨设备、跨人群和独立临床验证仍不足

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: EEG datasets vary wildly in electrode montage (16 to 128 channels), sampling rates, and low SNR, preventing cross-dataset pretraining.
attrs_en.核心想法: Segment each EEG channel into fixed-duration temporal patches, learn a discrete neural codebook predicting frequency amplitude/phase, and pretrain a Transformer with spatial+temporal embeddings via masked code prediction.
attrs_en.关键改进: Spectrum-guided discrete neural tokenizer + factorized electrode-spatial and temporal embeddings unifying ~2,500 hours across 20 heterogeneous EEG cohorts.
attrs_en.医学适配: Canonical foundation model for cross-montage EEG abnormality classification, event detection, and brain–computer interfaces.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Significant methodological leap for heterogeneous neurophysiology; clinical cross-hospital sensitivity and false-alarm calibration require ongoing validation.

models.title: GRU
models.family_label: 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练
models.archetype: reset/update 双门控的循环状态更新
models.core_mech: GRU 用 reset/update 两门和单一隐藏状态完成记忆更新，结构比 LSTM 更简洁。
models.core_mech_en: Simplifies gated recurrence by merging cell and hidden states into a single vector h_t interpolated via an update gate z_t and a reset gate r_t.
models.input_desc: 时间序列 xt 与上一隐藏状态 ht−1
models.input_en: Sequential physiological or clinical feature vector x_t and previous hidden state h_{t-1}
models.output_desc: 当前隐藏状态 ht、全序列表示或逐时刻预测
models.output_en: Updated hidden state h_t or sequence prediction

attrs.上一代瓶颈: vanilla RNN 梯度不稳，LSTM 门控和状态较复杂
attrs.核心想法: 以 update/reset gates 控制隐藏状态保留与重置，简化门控循环结构
attrs.关键改进: 仅用单一隐藏状态和两类门，在保留长依赖能力时减少参数
attrs.医学适配: 常用于 ECG、EEG、生命体征和纵向临床序列的小数据基线
attrs.适用范围与证据: 仍是轻量时序基线；串行计算和超长依赖能力弱于现代并行模型

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: LSTM required three separate gates and dual state vectors, increasing parameter count and overfitting risk on small clinical cohorts.
attrs_en.核心想法: Eliminate the separate cell state and control memory retention versus new candidate overwriting with a single complementary update gate z_t.
attrs_en.关键改进: 25% fewer parameters than LSTM while retaining additive gradient highways via (1 − z_t) ⊙ h_{t-1}.
attrs_en.医学适配: Widely used in compact wearable biosignal monitors, GRU-D missing-value clinical EHR time series, and edge medical devices.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Lightweight recurrent baseline; like LSTM, remains bottlenecked by sequential step-by-step training on ultra-long sequences.

models.title: ECGFounder

models.archetype: 大规模 150 标签监督预训练的 RegNet-1D 多导联 ECG encoder
models.core_mech: ECGFounder 是 RegNet/Net1D 风格的 1D CNN foundation model，以超过千万波形和 150 类监督规模为核心，不应误写为通用 Transformer SSL。
models.core_mech_en: 1D RegNet-style residual CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation blocks pretrained via multi-label clinical supervision across >10 million 12-lead ECGs and 150 diagnostic categories.
models.input_desc: 标准化的 12 导联或适配后的任意单导联 ECG 波形
models.input_en: Raw multi-lead (12-lead) or lead-masked single-lead 1D ECG voltage waveform tensor
models.output_desc: 150 类诊断概率、通用 ECG embedding 与下游微调预测
models.output_en: 150-class diagnostic probability vector and general-purpose 1D ECG representation

attrs.上一代瓶颈: ECG 模型多依赖单中心小数据和任务专用标签，跨机构泛化有限
attrs.核心想法: 在超过千万份原始多导联 ECG 上预训练通用时序编码器并迁移多任务
attrs.关键改进: 利用卫生系统规模波形和多任务评测学习可复用 ECG 表征
attrs.医学适配: 用于心律失常、结构性心脏病和风险预测等 ECG 任务
attrs.适用范围与证据: 超大规模 ECG FM 代表；设备、群体公平性和前瞻效益仍需验证

attrs_en.上一代瓶颈: Prior ECG models were trained on narrow diagnostic subsets or small single-hospital cohorts, failing on rare arrhythmias and single-lead wearables.
attrs_en.核心想法: Scale a domain-engineered 1D CNN (Net1D / RegNet with SE channel attention and lead-dropout augmentation) across >10M clinical ECGs annotated with a 150-label hierarchical ontology.
attrs_en.关键改进: Massive 10M-waveform clinical supervision + lead-masking augmentation enabling seamless transfer from 12-lead hospital ECGs to single-lead wearable patches.
attrs_en.医学适配: High-performing open-weight ECG foundation baseline for arrhythmia diagnosis, structural heart disease screening, and wearable ECG triage.
attrs_en.适用范围与证据: Proves that a well-engineered 1D CNN at 10M-sample clinical scale rivals or outperforms complex Transformers; prospective clinical trial validation remains the next frontier.
